title: 熱氧化閘極介電層
summary: 以 4 階段、24 個工程工作包拆解氧化消耗、界面陷阱、漏電，完成圖解、對照、敏感度分析、故障判別、量測規劃與驗收。
summaryEn: Four stages and 24 work packages explore oxidation consumption, interface traps and leakage through diagrams, comparisons, sensitivity studies, fault diagnosis, measurement plans and acceptance reviews.
scope: 依公開原理編寫的雙語概念實作課；每步交付可審查的工程證據。24 步是學習拆解，不代表晶圓廠的完整配方。自行設定的數值須標為假設。題目不含可直接操作的化學混配、設備設定或量產公差；照片與外部影片為代表媒體，不是假稱每步實拍。
scopeEn: Bilingual conceptual exercises based on public principles, with reviewable evidence at each step. The 24 steps are a learning decomposition, not a complete fab recipe. Chosen numerical inputs must be labeled hypothetical. No directly operable chemical mixtures, equipment settings or production tolerances are supplied. Photos and external videos are representative media, not claimed as recordings of every step.

stages.title: 界面與氧化目的
stages.description: 在「界面與氧化目的」建立六項互補證據，逐一檢查材料、幾何、物理機制與適用限制。
stages.descriptionEn: Build six complementary evidence items for interface and oxidation purpose, checking materials, geometry, mechanisms and validity limits.

steps.title: 分辨成長與沉積
steps.objective: 完成「分辨成長與沉積」的因果圖，把氧化消耗、界面陷阱、漏電中的相關限制連到可觀察證據。
steps.objectiveEn: Complete a causal diagram for separate growth and deposition, connecting relevant limits in oxidation consumption, interface traps and leakage to observable evidence.
steps.instruction: 本步問題：分辨成長與沉積。畫一張含作用前後狀態的原創圖；以箭頭標出本步原理中的因果關係；圈出一項仍需量測的未知量。判讀依據：熱氧化消耗基板矽，外加沉積的材料來源不同。引用列出的原始資料；若使用數值，清楚標成自訂教學假設。
steps.instructionEn: Question for this step: Separate growth and deposition. Draw an original before/after diagram; mark the causal relationship in this step; circle one quantity still requiring measurement. Interpretation: Thermal oxidation consumes substrate silicon; deposition has another material source. Cite the listed primary material; label any chosen numbers as hypothetical educational inputs.
steps.observation: 檢查結果是否能支持「熱氧化消耗基板矽，外加沉積的材料來源不同。」；若證據不足，標記尚未確定並寫出缺少的量測。
steps.observationEn: Check whether the evidence supports: Thermal oxidation consumes substrate silicon; deposition has another material source. If insufficient, mark the conclusion unresolved and name the missing measurement.
steps.failure: 常見錯判：沉積循環數總能從第一循環精確線性外推。 應回到「分辨成長與沉積」的假設與採樣範圍，補足能區分機制的證據。
steps.failureEn: Common misinterpretation: Thickness always extrapolates linearly from the first cycle. Revisit assumptions and sampling for separate growth and deposition and add discriminating evidence.
steps.check: 交付「分辨成長與沉積」因果圖：圖中要有邊界、輸入、輸出與一項不能僅由圖決定的量。
steps.checkEn: Submit the causal diagram for separate growth and deposition: Show boundaries, inputs, outputs and one quantity that the diagram alone cannot determine.

knowledge.title: 分辨成長與沉積的原理
knowledge.text: 熱氧化消耗基板矽，外加沉積的材料來源不同。
knowledge.textEn: Thermal oxidation consumes substrate silicon; deposition has another material source.

knowledge.title: 本階段的機制與工程權衡
knowledge.text: 熱氧化形成的氧化物同時向原表面上下延伸；截面預算需分開記錄矽消耗與外部厚度增加。
knowledge.textEn: Thermal oxide extends above and below the original surface; separate silicon consumption from outward thickness increase.

quiz.question: 評估「分辨成長與沉積」時，哪項敘述可以採用？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is valid when evaluating separate growth and deposition?
options: 熱氧化消耗基板矽，外加沉積的材料來源不同。
沉積循環數總能從第一循環精確線性外推。
厚度相同就代表介面電性相同。
optionsEn: Thermal oxidation consumes substrate silicon; deposition has another material source.
Thickness always extrapolates linearly from the first cycle.
Equal thickness implies equal interface electrical quality.
quiz.explanation: 熱氧化消耗基板矽，外加沉積的材料來源不同。 熱氧化形成的氧化物同時向原表面上下延伸；截面預算需分開記錄矽消耗與外部厚度增加。
quiz.explanationEn: Thermal oxidation consumes substrate silicon; deposition has another material source. Thermal oxide extends above and below the original surface; separate silicon consumption from outward thickness increase.

steps.title: 界面位置移動
steps.objective: 完成「界面位置移動」的對照表，把氧化消耗、界面陷阱、漏電中的相關限制連到可觀察證據。
steps.objectiveEn: Complete a controlled comparison for track the moving interface, connecting relevant limits in oxidation consumption, interface traps and leakage to observable evidence.
steps.instruction: 本步問題：界面位置移動。建立兩個只改一項條件的假想案例；分開記錄可觀察差異與推測原因；說明如何用本步原理區分兩者。判讀依據：氧化後原表面不等於新的矽氧界面位置。引用列出的原始資料；若使用數值，清楚標成自訂教學假設。 自訂幾何模型：假設氧化物厚度 100 個單位、矽消耗為其 0.44 倍；以原表面為零畫出新界面與外表面。0.44 是近似體積換算，非本課量測值。
steps.instructionEn: Question for this step: Track the moving interface. Create two hypothetical cases differing in one condition; separate observations from proposed causes; use this step’s principle to distinguish them. Interpretation: The original surface differs from the final silicon-oxide interface. Cite the listed primary material; label any chosen numbers as hypothetical educational inputs. Hypothetical geometry: oxide thickness 100 units and silicon consumption 0.44 times that thickness. Mark the new interface and outer surface relative to the original surface. The 0.44 is an approximate volume conversion, not course measurement data.
steps.observation: 檢查結果是否能支持「氧化後原表面不等於新的矽氧界面位置。」；若證據不足，標記尚未確定並寫出缺少的量測。
steps.observationEn: Check whether the evidence supports: The original surface differs from the final silicon-oxide interface. If insufficient, mark the conclusion unresolved and name the missing measurement.
steps.failure: 常見錯判：沉積循環數總能從第一循環精確線性外推。 應回到「界面位置移動」的假設與採樣範圍，補足能區分機制的證據。
steps.failureEn: Common misinterpretation: Thickness always extrapolates linearly from the first cycle. Revisit assumptions and sampling for track the moving interface and add discriminating evidence.
steps.check: 交付「界面位置移動」對照表：交出兩案例、固定條件、預期差異及一項可能混淆因素。 同時交付算例的中間步驟或比較圖，並標示假設與模型限制。
steps.checkEn: Submit the controlled comparison for track the moving interface: Submit both cases, fixed conditions, predicted difference and one confounder. Also submit intermediate calculations or comparison diagrams with assumptions and model limits.

steps.title: 閘氧與場氧

steps.objectiveEn: Complete a sensitivity sketch for separate gate and field oxide, connecting relevant limits in oxidation consumption, interface traps and leakage to observable evidence.
steps.instruction: 本步問題：閘氧與場氧。選出本步的一項輸入及一項輸出；以自訂低、中、高三點畫趨勢；逐點標註假設，並寫出趨勢可能失效的條件。判讀依據：電容控制與區域隔離使用不同設計目標。引用列出的原始資料；若使用數值，清楚標成自訂教學假設。
steps.instructionEn: Question for this step: Separate gate and field oxide. Select one input and output for this step; sketch a hypothetical low/mid/high trend; label assumptions and state when the trend may fail. Interpretation: Gate capacitance and field isolation have different design targets. Cite the listed primary material; label any chosen numbers as hypothetical educational inputs.
steps.observation: 檢查結果是否能支持「電容控制與區域隔離使用不同設計目標。」；若證據不足，標記尚未確定並寫出缺少的量測。

steps.failure: 常見錯判：沉積循環數總能從第一循環精確線性外推。 應回到「閘氧與場氧」的假設與採樣範圍，補足能區分機制的證據。

steps.check: 交付「閘氧與場氧」敏感度草圖：圖須有變數、單位或無因次定義、三個假設點及適用範圍。
steps.checkEn: Submit the sensitivity sketch for separate gate and field oxide: Include variables, units or dimensionless definitions, three hypothetical points and validity limits.

steps.objectiveEn: Complete a fault-discrimination table for compare dry and wet oxidation, connecting relevant limits in oxidation consumption, interface traps and leakage to observable evidence.
steps.instruction: 本步問題：乾氧與濕氧。假設本步預期結果未出現；提出兩個不同機制；為各機制選一個能支持或否定的觀察，避免只重複同一量測。判讀依據：氧化氣氛改變成長速率及薄膜特性。引用列出的原始資料；若使用數值，清楚標成自訂教學假設。
steps.instructionEn: Question for this step: Compare dry and wet oxidation. Assume the expected result fails; propose two distinct mechanisms; choose an observation that supports or rejects each rather than repeating one measurement. Interpretation: Oxidizing ambient changes growth kinetics and film properties. Cite the listed primary material; label any chosen numbers as hypothetical educational inputs.
steps.observation: 檢查結果是否能支持「氧化氣氛改變成長速率及薄膜特性。」；若證據不足，標記尚未確定並寫出缺少的量測。

steps.check: 交付「乾氧與濕氧」故障判別表：至少列出兩個假說、各自的辨別證據及先檢查順序。
steps.checkEn: Submit the fault-discrimination table for compare dry and wet oxidation: List two hypotheses, discriminating evidence for each and a check order.

steps.instruction: 本步問題：原生氧化前史。針對本步定義待測量及採樣位置；列出解析度、背景與重複性；設計一個見證或空白，並說明檢出限如何限制結論。判讀依據：初始氧化層會改變短時間成長的起點。引用列出的原始資料；若使用數值，清楚標成自訂教學假設。
steps.instructionEn: Question for this step: Record initial oxide history. Define the measurand and sampling locations; list resolution, background and repeatability; design a witness or blank and explain detection-limit constraints. Interpretation: Initial oxide changes the starting condition for short growth. Cite the listed primary material; label any chosen numbers as hypothetical educational inputs.
steps.observation: 檢查結果是否能支持「初始氧化層會改變短時間成長的起點。」；若證據不足，標記尚未確定並寫出缺少的量測。

title: 高介電常數原子層沉積
summary: 以 4 階段、24 個工程工作包拆解EOT、飽和循環、三維覆蓋，完成圖解、對照、敏感度分析、故障判別、量測規劃與驗收。
summaryEn: Four stages and 24 work packages explore eot, saturated cycles and 3d coverage through diagrams, comparisons, sensitivity studies, fault diagnosis, measurement plans and acceptance reviews.
scope: 依公開原理編寫的雙語概念實作課；每步交付可審查的工程證據。24 步是學習拆解，不代表晶圓廠的完整配方。自行設定的數值須標為假設。題目不含可直接操作的化學混配、設備設定或量產公差；照片與外部影片為代表媒體，不是假稱每步實拍。
scopeEn: Bilingual conceptual exercises based on public principles, with reviewable evidence at each step. The 24 steps are a learning decomposition, not a complete fab recipe. Chosen numerical inputs must be labeled hypothetical. No directly operable chemical mixtures, equipment settings or production tolerances are supplied. Photos and external videos are representative media, not claimed as recordings of every step.

stages.title: 介電層與電容

stages.descriptionEn: Build six complementary evidence items for dielectric and capacitance, checking materials, geometry, mechanisms and validity limits.

steps.instruction: 本步問題：物理厚度與 EOT。畫一張含作用前後狀態的原創圖；以箭頭標出本步原理中的因果關係；圈出一項仍需量測的未知量。判讀依據：較高介電常數可在相同電容下容許較厚物理膜。引用列出的原始資料；若使用數值，清楚標成自訂教學假設。
steps.instructionEn: Question for this step: Separate thickness and EOT. Draw an original before/after diagram; mark the causal relationship in this step; circle one quantity still requiring measurement. Interpretation: Higher permittivity permits greater physical thickness at equal capacitance. Cite the listed primary material; label any chosen numbers as hypothetical educational inputs.
steps.observation: 檢查結果是否能支持「較高介電常數可在相同電容下容許較厚物理膜。」；若證據不足，標記尚未確定並寫出缺少的量測。
steps.observationEn: Check whether the evidence supports: Higher permittivity permits greater physical thickness at equal capacitance. If insufficient, mark the conclusion unresolved and name the missing measurement.
steps.failure: 常見錯判：沉積循環數總能從第一循環精確線性外推。 應回到「物理厚度與 EOT」的假設與採樣範圍，補足能區分機制的證據。
steps.failureEn: Common misinterpretation: Thickness always extrapolates linearly from the first cycle. Revisit assumptions and sampling for separate thickness and eot and add discriminating evidence.
steps.check: 交付「物理厚度與 EOT」因果圖：圖中要有邊界、輸入、輸出與一項不能僅由圖決定的量。
steps.checkEn: Submit the causal diagram for separate thickness and eot: Show boundaries, inputs, outputs and one quantity that the diagram alone cannot determine.

高電容增益需與散射及陷阱造成的劣化比較。
兩種介電堆疊只要 EOT 相同，其介面散射與有效遷移率就必定相同。
optionsEn: Higher gate capacitance alone proves higher carrier mobility without checking scattering or traps.
Capacitance gain must be compared with scattering and trap penalties.
Two dielectric stacks with equal EOT must have identical interface scattering and effective mobility.
quiz.explanation: 高電容增益需與散射及陷阱造成的劣化比較。 低 EOT、低漏電及低陷阱密度是不同目標；改變介面處理可能改善其中一項卻犧牲另一項。
quiz.explanationEn: Capacitance gain must be compared with scattering and trap penalties. Low EOT, leakage and trap density are distinct objectives; an interface treatment may improve one while compromising another.

title: 金屬閘極功函數工程
summary: 以 4 階段、24 個工程工作包拆解有效功函數、閾值分布、閘填充，完成圖解、對照、敏感度分析、故障判別、量測規劃與驗收。
summaryEn: Four stages and 24 work packages explore effective work function, threshold distribution and gate fill through diagrams, comparisons, sensitivity studies, fault diagnosis, measurement plans and acceptance reviews.
scope: 依公開原理編寫的雙語概念實作課；每步交付可審查的工程證據。24 步是學習拆解，不代表晶圓廠的完整配方。自行設定的數值須標為假設。題目不含可直接操作的化學混配、設備設定或量產公差；照片與外部影片為代表媒體，不是假稱每步實拍。
scopeEn: Bilingual conceptual exercises based on public principles, with reviewable evidence at each step. The 24 steps are a learning decomposition, not a complete fab recipe. Chosen numerical inputs must be labeled hypothetical. No directly operable chemical mixtures, equipment settings or production tolerances are supplied. Photos and external videos are representative media, not claimed as recordings of every step.

stages.descriptionEn: Build six complementary evidence items for band alignment and gates, checking materials, geometry, mechanisms and validity limits.

steps.instructionEn: Question for this step: Define vacuum work function. Draw an original before/after diagram; mark the causal relationship in this step; circle one quantity still requiring measurement. Interpretation: Vacuum work function need not equal effective work function in a device. Cite the listed primary material; label any chosen numbers as hypothetical educational inputs.
steps.observation: 檢查結果是否能支持「金屬真空功函數不必等於器件中的有效功函數。」；若證據不足，標記尚未確定並寫出缺少的量測。
steps.observationEn: Check whether the evidence supports: Vacuum work function need not equal effective work function in a device. If insufficient, mark the conclusion unresolved and name the missing measurement.
steps.failure: 常見錯判：沉積循環數總能從第一循環精確線性外推。 應回到「定義真空功函數」的假設與採樣範圍，補足能區分機制的證據。
steps.failureEn: Common misinterpretation: Thickness always extrapolates linearly from the first cycle. Revisit assumptions and sampling for define vacuum work function and add discriminating evidence.
steps.check: 交付「定義真空功函數」因果圖：圖中要有邊界、輸入、輸出與一項不能僅由圖決定的量。

steps.instructionEn: Question for this step: Locate residual-metal bridges. Combine this step with earlier stage evidence; propose two independent acceptance criteria; name one hold condition and the next confirming action. Interpretation: Local residues can electrically connect isolated gates. Cite the listed primary material; label any chosen numbers as hypothetical educational inputs. steps.instructionEn: Question for this step: Cross-check C-V and I-V. Draw an original before/after diagram; mark the causal relationship in this step; circle one quantity still requiring measurement. steps.failureEn: Common misinterpretation: Low bulk resistivity guarantees low interface contact resistance. Revisit assumptions and sampling for cross-check c-v and i-v and add discriminating evidence.
steps.check: 交付「C-V 與 I-V」因果圖：圖中要有邊界、輸入、輸出與一項不能僅由圖決定的量。
steps.checkEn: Submit the causal diagram for cross-check c-v and i-v: Show boundaries, inputs, outputs and one quantity that the diagram alone cannot determine.

Combine this step with earlier stage evidence; propose two independent acceptance criteria; name one hold condition and the next confirming action. Interpretation: Jointly assess work function, coverage, resistance, distributions and aging. Cite the listed primary material; label any chosen numbers as hypothetical educational inputs.

title: 離子佈植摻雜
summary: 以 4 階段、24 個工程工作包拆解劑量、射程、損傷及活化，完成圖解、對照、敏感度分析、故障判別、量測規劃與驗收。
summaryEn: Four stages and 24 work packages explore dose, range, damage and activation through diagrams, comparisons, sensitivity studies, fault diagnosis, measurement plans and acceptance reviews.
scope: 依公開原理編寫的雙語概念實作課；每步交付可審查的工程證據。24 步是學習拆解，不代表晶圓廠的完整配方。自行設定的數值須標為假設。題目不含可直接操作的化學混配、設備設定或量產公差；照片與外部影片為代表媒體，不是假稱每步實拍。
scopeEn: Bilingual conceptual exercises based on public principles, with reviewable evidence at each step. The 24 steps are a learning decomposition, not a complete fab recipe. Chosen numerical inputs must be labeled hypothetical. No directly operable chemical mixtures, equipment settings or production tolerances are supplied. Photos and external videos are representative media, not claimed as recordings of every step.

stages.title: 佈植目的與輪廓
stages.description: 在「佈植目的與輪廓」建立六項互補證據，逐一檢查材料、幾何、物理機制與適用限制。
stages.descriptionEn: Build six complementary evidence items for implant purpose and profiles, checking materials, geometry, mechanisms and validity limits.

steps.title: 劑量與濃度
steps.objective: 完成「劑量與濃度」的因果圖，把劑量、射程、損傷及活化中的相關限制連到可觀察證據。
steps.objectiveEn: Complete a causal diagram for separate dose and concentration, connecting relevant limits in dose, range, damage and activation to observable evidence.
steps.instruction: 本步問題：劑量與濃度。畫一張含作用前後狀態的原創圖；以箭頭標出本步原理中的因果關係；圈出一項仍需量測的未知量。判讀依據：面劑量與體濃度的單位及物理意義不同。引用列出的原始資料；若使用數值，清楚標成自訂教學假設。 自訂積分題：假設一段厚 10 nm 的均勻區濃度為 10^19 cm^-3；先把厚度換成 cm，再求面劑量，並解釋此方盒輪廓不是實際佈植高斯輪廓。
steps.instructionEn: Question for this step: Separate dose and concentration. Draw an original before/after diagram; mark the causal relationship in this step; circle one quantity still requiring measurement. Interpretation: Areal dose and volume concentration have different units and meanings. Cite the listed primary material; label any chosen numbers as hypothetical educational inputs. Hypothetical integral: a uniform 10 nm region has concentration 10^19 cm^-3. Convert thickness to cm and compute areal dose; explain why this box profile is not a real implantation Gaussian.
steps.observation: 檢查結果是否能支持「面劑量與體濃度的單位及物理意義不同。」；若證據不足，標記尚未確定並寫出缺少的量測。
steps.observationEn: Check whether the evidence supports: Areal dose and volume concentration have different units and meanings. If insufficient, mark the conclusion unresolved and name the missing measurement.
steps.failure: 常見錯判：峰值溫度相同便有相同擴散預算。 應回到「劑量與濃度」的假設與採樣範圍，補足能區分機制的證據。
steps.failureEn: Common misinterpretation: Equal peak temperatures imply equal diffusion budgets. Revisit assumptions and sampling for separate dose and concentration and add discriminating evidence.
steps.check: 交付「劑量與濃度」因果圖：圖中要有邊界、輸入、輸出與一項不能僅由圖決定的量。 同時交付算例的中間步驟或比較圖，並標示假設與模型限制。
steps.checkEn: Submit the causal diagram for separate dose and concentration: Show boundaries, inputs, outputs and one quantity that the diagram alone cannot determine. Also submit intermediate calculations or comparison diagrams with assumptions and model limits.

knowledge.title: 劑量與濃度的原理
knowledge.text: 面劑量與體濃度的單位及物理意義不同。
knowledge.textEn: Areal dose and volume concentration have different units and meanings.

knowledge.title: 本階段的機制與工程權衡
knowledge.text: 面劑量是深度濃度的積分；相同劑量可透過不同射程展寬形成不同峰值濃度。
knowledge.textEn: Areal dose is the depth integral of concentration; equal doses can have different peaks because of range spread.

optionsEn: Areal dose and volume concentration have different units and meanings.
Equal peak temperatures imply equal diffusion budgets.
Chemical dopant concentration equals active carrier concentration.

steps.failureEn: Common misinterpretation: Equal peak temperatures imply equal diffusion budgets. Revisit assumptions and sampling for choose dopant roles and add discriminating evidence.
steps.check: 交付「摻雜種類」對照表：交出兩案例、固定條件、預期差異及一項可能混淆因素。
steps.checkEn: Submit the controlled comparison for choose dopant roles: Submit both cases, fixed conditions, predicted difference and one confounder.

knowledge.textEn: SIMS gives chemical profiles while electrical measurements reflect active carriers and mobility; align depth and area before comparing.

title: 快速熱退火
summary: 以 4 階段、24 個工程工作包拆解溫度時間軌跡、擴散、片電阻，完成圖解、對照、敏感度分析、故障判別、量測規劃與驗收。
summaryEn: Four stages and 24 work packages explore temperature-time history, diffusion and sheet resistance through diagrams, comparisons, sensitivity studies, fault diagnosis, measurement plans and acceptance reviews.
scope: 依公開原理編寫的雙語概念實作課；每步交付可審查的工程證據。24 步是學習拆解，不代表晶圓廠的完整配方。自行設定的數值須標為假設。題目不含可直接操作的化學混配、設備設定或量產公差；照片與外部影片為代表媒體，不是假稱每步實拍。
scopeEn: Bilingual conceptual exercises based on public principles, with reviewable evidence at each step. The 24 steps are a learning decomposition, not a complete fab recipe. Chosen numerical inputs must be labeled hypothetical. No directly operable chemical mixtures, equipment settings or production tolerances are supplied. Photos and external videos are representative media, not claimed as recordings of every step.

steps.title: 活化與擴散

steps.instructionEn: Question for this step: Separate activation and diffusion. Draw an original before/after diagram; mark the causal relationship in this step; circle one quantity still requiring measurement. Interpretation: Activation changes carrier availability while diffusion changes spatial distribution. Cite the listed primary material; label any chosen numbers as hypothetical educational inputs.
steps.observation: 檢查結果是否能支持「活化提高載子可用性，擴散改變空間分布。」；若證據不足，標記尚未確定並寫出缺少的量測。
steps.observationEn: Check whether the evidence supports: Activation changes carrier availability while diffusion changes spatial distribution. If insufficient, mark the conclusion unresolved and name the missing measurement.
steps.failure: 常見錯判：峰值溫度相同便有相同擴散預算。 應回到「活化與擴散」的假設與採樣範圍，補足能區分機制的證據。
steps.failureEn: Common misinterpretation: Equal peak temperatures imply equal diffusion budgets. Revisit assumptions and sampling for separate activation and diffusion and add discriminating evidence.
steps.check: 交付「活化與擴散」因果圖：圖中要有邊界、輸入、輸出與一項不能僅由圖決定的量。

title: 雷射尖峰退火
summary: 以 4 階段、24 個工程工作包拆解光斑掃描、局部熱峰、圖案吸收，完成圖解、對照、敏感度分析、故障判別、量測規劃與驗收。
summaryEn: Four stages and 24 work packages explore beam scanning, local thermal peaks and patterned absorption through diagrams, comparisons, sensitivity studies, fault diagnosis, measurement plans and acceptance reviews.
scope: 依公開原理編寫的雙語概念實作課；每步交付可審查的工程證據。24 步是學習拆解，不代表晶圓廠的完整配方。自行設定的數值須標為假設。題目不含可直接操作的化學混配、設備設定或量產公差；照片與外部影片為代表媒體，不是假稱每步實拍。
scopeEn: Bilingual conceptual exercises based on public principles, with reviewable evidence at each step. The 24 steps are a learning decomposition, not a complete fab recipe. Chosen numerical inputs must be labeled hypothetical. No directly operable chemical mixtures, equipment settings or production tolerances are supplied. Photos and external videos are representative media, not claimed as recordings of every step.

steps.title: 毫秒與奈秒

steps.objectiveEn: Complete a causal diagram for separate millisecond and nanosecond regimes, connecting relevant limits in beam scanning, local thermal peaks and patterned absorption to observable evidence.

steps.instructionEn: Question for this step: Separate millisecond and nanosecond regimes. Draw an original before/after diagram; mark the causal relationship in this step; circle one quantity still requiring measurement. Interpretation: Different pulse durations cannot be treated as the same thermal process. Cite the listed primary material; label any chosen numbers as hypothetical educational inputs.

steps.failureEn: Common misinterpretation: Equal peak temperatures imply equal diffusion budgets. Revisit assumptions and sampling for separate millisecond and nanosecond regimes and add discriminating evidence.
steps.check: 交付「毫秒與奈秒」因果圖：圖中要有邊界、輸入、輸出與一項不能僅由圖決定的量。
steps.checkEn: Submit the causal diagram for separate millisecond and nanosecond regimes: Show boundaries, inputs, outputs and one quantity that the diagram alone cannot determine.

knowledge.textEn: Metal and dielectric patterns differ optically, so representative validation needs patterned wafers beyond bare-silicon calibration.

title: 擴散爐均勻性控制
summary: 以 4 階段、24 個工程工作包拆解片位熱場、邊界條件、擴散輪廓，完成圖解、對照、敏感度分析、故障判別、量測規劃與驗收。
summaryEn: Four stages and 24 work packages explore slot thermal fields, boundary conditions and diffusion profiles through diagrams, comparisons, sensitivity studies, fault diagnosis, measurement plans and acceptance reviews.
scope: 依公開原理編寫的雙語概念實作課；每步交付可審查的工程證據。24 步是學習拆解，不代表晶圓廠的完整配方。自行設定的數值須標為假設。題目不含可直接操作的化學混配、設備設定或量產公差；照片與外部影片為代表媒體，不是假稱每步實拍。
scopeEn: Bilingual conceptual exercises based on public principles, with reviewable evidence at each step. The 24 steps are a learning decomposition, not a complete fab recipe. Chosen numerical inputs must be labeled hypothetical. No directly operable chemical mixtures, equipment settings or production tolerances are supplied. Photos and external videos are representative media, not claimed as recordings of every step.

stages.descriptionEn: Build six complementary evidence items for furnace and boundaries, checking materials, geometry, mechanisms and validity limits.

steps.instructionEn: Question for this step: Map batch positions. Draw an original before/after diagram; mark the causal relationship in this step; circle one quantity still requiring measurement. Interpretation: Front, middle and rear slots sample different thermal and flow conditions. Cite the listed primary material; label any chosen numbers as hypothetical educational inputs.
steps.observation: 檢查結果是否能支持「前中後片位是不同的熱與流體採樣位置。」；若證據不足，標記尚未確定並寫出缺少的量測。

steps.check: 交付「批次位置圖」因果圖：圖中要有邊界、輸入、輸出與一項不能僅由圖決定的量。

knowledge.text: 有限源保持總劑量，固定表面源持續補充摻雜；兩種擴散模型採用不同守恆及邊界條件。
knowledge.textEn: Finite sources conserve dose while fixed-surface sources replenish dopants; the models have different conservation and boundary conditions.

steps.instructionEn: Question for this step: Separate radial and axial maps. Draw an original before/after diagram; mark the causal relationship in this step; circle one quantity still requiring measurement. Interpretation: Report within-wafer radial and slot-to-slot axial variation separately. Cite the listed primary material; label any chosen numbers as hypothetical educational inputs.
steps.observation: 檢查結果是否能支持「片內徑向變異與片間軸向變異應分開報告。」；若證據不足，標記尚未確定並寫出缺少的量測。

steps.failureEn: Common misinterpretation: Empty-furnace uniformity proves loaded-wafer uniformity. Revisit assumptions and sampling for separate radial and axial maps and add discriminating evidence.
steps.check: 交付「徑向與軸向圖」因果圖：圖中要有邊界、輸入、輸出與一項不能僅由圖決定的量。
steps.checkEn: Submit the causal diagram for separate radial and axial maps: Show boundaries, inputs, outputs and one quantity that the diagram alone cannot determine.

knowledge.title: 徑向與軸向圖的原理

knowledge.title: 本階段的機制與工程權衡
knowledge.text: 爐管軸向變異與片內徑向變異對應不同邊界，將兩者混成單一標準差可能遮蔽故障來源。

quiz.question: 評估「徑向與軸向圖」時，哪項敘述可以採用？

optionsEn: Report within-wafer radial and slot-to-slot axial variation separately.

Equal laser energy must produce equal thermal peaks.

title: 淺溝槽隔離製作
summary: 以 4 階段、24 個工程工作包拆解溝槽填充、隔離漏電、應力，完成圖解、對照、敏感度分析、故障判別、量測規劃與驗收。
summaryEn: Four stages and 24 work packages explore trench fill, isolation leakage and stress through diagrams, comparisons, sensitivity studies, fault diagnosis, measurement plans and acceptance reviews.
scope: 依公開原理編寫的雙語概念實作課；每步交付可審查的工程證據。24 步是學習拆解，不代表晶圓廠的完整配方。自行設定的數值須標為假設。題目不含可直接操作的化學混配、設備設定或量產公差；照片與外部影片為代表媒體，不是假稱每步實拍。
scopeEn: Bilingual conceptual exercises based on public principles, with reviewable evidence at each step. The 24 steps are a learning decomposition, not a complete fab recipe. Chosen numerical inputs must be labeled hypothetical. No directly operable chemical mixtures, equipment settings or production tolerances are supplied. Photos and external videos are representative media, not claimed as recordings of every step.

stages.title: 隔離幾何
stages.description: 在「隔離幾何」建立六項互補證據，逐一檢查材料、幾何、物理機制與適用限制。
stages.descriptionEn: Build six complementary evidence items for isolation geometry, checking materials, geometry, mechanisms and validity limits.

steps.instructionEn: Question for this step: Draw active-area boundaries. Draw an original before/after diagram; mark the causal relationship in this step; circle one quantity still requiring measurement. Interpretation: Isolation defines electrical boundaries between devices, not gate length. Cite the listed primary material; label any chosen numbers as hypothetical educational inputs.
steps.observation: 檢查結果是否能支持「隔離區定義元件間電性邊界而非閘長。」；若證據不足，標記尚未確定並寫出缺少的量測。
steps.observationEn: Check whether the evidence supports: Isolation defines electrical boundaries between devices, not gate length. If insufficient, mark the conclusion unresolved and name the missing measurement.

steps.failureEn: Common misinterpretation: Acceptable total current proves every channel is intact. Revisit assumptions and sampling for draw active-area boundaries and add discriminating evidence.
steps.check: 交付「主動區邊界」因果圖：圖中要有邊界、輸入、輸出與一項不能僅由圖決定的量。
steps.checkEn: Submit the causal diagram for draw active-area boundaries: Show boundaries, inputs, outputs and one quantity that the diagram alone cannot determine.

steps.title: 溝槽側壁角

steps.instructionEn: Question for this step: Measure trench sidewall angle. steps.observation: 檢查結果是否能支持「側壁形狀會改變入口封閉與填充風險。」；若證據不足，標記尚未確定並寫出缺少的量測。

knowledge.title: 溝槽側壁角的原理

knowledge.textEn: Sidewall shape changes opening closure and fill risk.

knowledge.title: 本階段的機制與工程權衡
knowledge.text: 側壁形狀與襯層消耗會改變填充前的實際開口，所以設計圖寬度不能直接代替沉積入口寬度。
knowledge.textEn: Sidewall shape and liner consumption change the prefill opening, so layout width is not necessarily deposition-entry width.

quiz.question: 評估「溝槽側壁角」時，哪項敘述可以採用？

Geometric integrity eliminates the need for leakage measurements.
Doubling contact area must halve all series resistance.

steps.checkEn: Submit the controlled comparison for inspect trench-bottom residue: Submit both cases, fixed conditions, predicted difference and one confounder.

title: 應變矽通道整合
summary: 以 4 階段、24 個工程工作包拆解應變張量、載子輸運、鬆弛，完成圖解、對照、敏感度分析、故障判別、量測規劃與驗收。
summaryEn: Four stages and 24 work packages explore strain tensors, carrier transport and relaxation through diagrams, comparisons, sensitivity studies, fault diagnosis, measurement plans and acceptance reviews.
scope: 依公開原理編寫的雙語概念實作課；每步交付可審查的工程證據。24 步是學習拆解，不代表晶圓廠的完整配方。自行設定的數值須標為假設。題目不含可直接操作的化學混配、設備設定或量產公差；照片與外部影片為代表媒體，不是假稱每步實拍。
scopeEn: Bilingual conceptual exercises based on public principles, with reviewable evidence at each step. The 24 steps are a learning decomposition, not a complete fab recipe. Chosen numerical inputs must be labeled hypothetical. No directly operable chemical mixtures, equipment settings or production tolerances are supplied. Photos and external videos are representative media, not claimed as recordings of every step.

stages.title: 應變與輸運
stages.description: 在「應變與輸運」建立六項互補證據，逐一檢查材料、幾何、物理機制與適用限制。
stages.descriptionEn: Build six complementary evidence items for strain and transport, checking materials, geometry, mechanisms and validity limits.

steps.title: 應力與應變

steps.objectiveEn: Complete a causal diagram for separate stress and strain, connecting relevant limits in strain tensors, carrier transport and relaxation to observable evidence.
steps.instruction: 本步問題：應力與應變。畫一張含作用前後狀態的原創圖；以箭頭標出本步原理中的因果關係；圈出一項仍需量測的未知量。判讀依據：應力是力學載荷，應變是相對形變。引用列出的原始資料；若使用數值，清楚標成自訂教學假設。 自訂小應變：長度由 100.00 變為 100.10 單位；計算軸向應變，再說明為何缺少彈性常數及邊界條件時不能唯一求應力。
steps.instructionEn: Question for this step: Separate stress and strain. Draw an original before/after diagram; mark the causal relationship in this step; circle one quantity still requiring measurement. Interpretation: Stress describes loading while strain describes relative deformation. Cite the listed primary material; label any chosen numbers as hypothetical educational inputs. Hypothetical small strain: length changes from 100.00 to 100.10 units. Calculate axial strain and explain why stress is not uniquely known without elastic constants and boundaries.
steps.observation: 檢查結果是否能支持「應力是力學載荷，應變是相對形變。」；若證據不足，標記尚未確定並寫出缺少的量測。
steps.observationEn: Check whether the evidence supports: Stress describes loading while strain describes relative deformation. If insufficient, mark the conclusion unresolved and name the missing measurement.
steps.failure: 常見錯判：沉積循環數總能從第一循環精確線性外推。 應回到「應力與應變」的假設與採樣範圍，補足能區分機制的證據。
steps.failureEn: Common misinterpretation: Thickness always extrapolates linearly from the first cycle. Revisit assumptions and sampling for separate stress and strain and add discriminating evidence.
steps.check: 交付「應力與應變」因果圖：圖中要有邊界、輸入、輸出與一項不能僅由圖決定的量。 同時交付算例的中間步驟或比較圖，並標示假設與模型限制。
steps.checkEn: Submit the causal diagram for separate stress and strain: Show boundaries, inputs, outputs and one quantity that the diagram alone cannot determine. Also submit intermediate calculations or comparison diagrams with assumptions and model limits.

knowledge.title: 應力與應變的原理
knowledge.text: 應力是力學載荷，應變是相對形變。
knowledge.textEn: Stress describes loading while strain describes relative deformation.

knowledge.title: 本階段的機制與工程權衡
knowledge.text: 應變對輸運的作用依賴方向、載子及能帶；「增加應力」沒有脫離方向與材料的普遍正面意義。
knowledge.textEn: Strain effects depend on direction, carriers and bands; increasing stress has no universal benefit independent of material and direction.

厚度相同就代表介面電性相同。

Thickness always extrapolates linearly from the first cycle.

steps.instructionEn: Question for this step: Trace embedded stressors. knowledge.textEn: Neighboring structures can change stress around otherwise equal devices.

knowledge.title: 本階段的機制與工程權衡
knowledge.text: 遷移率提高的收益會受接觸及互連限制；元件電流與電路延遲應分層驗證而非直接同比換算。
knowledge.textEn: Contact and interconnect limits constrain mobility gains; validate device current and circuit delay separately rather than scaling them proportionally.

quiz.question: 評估「版圖相依性」時，哪項敘述可以採用？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is valid when evaluating assess layout dependence?
options: 低塊材電阻率保證低界面接觸電阻。
鄰近結構可能改變相同元件的應力環境。
較快成長永遠改善圖案選擇性。
optionsEn: Low bulk resistivity guarantees low interface contact resistance.
Neighboring structures can change stress around otherwise equal devices.
Faster growth always improves pattern selectivity.
quiz.explanation: 鄰近結構可能改變相同元件的應力環境。 遷移率提高的收益會受接觸及互連限制；元件電流與電路延遲應分層驗證而非直接同比換算。
quiz.explanationEn: Neighboring structures can change stress around otherwise equal devices. Contact and interconnect limits constrain mobility gains; validate device current and circuit delay separately rather than scaling them proportionally.

steps.title: 應變整合結論
steps.objective: 完成「應變整合結論」的工程驗收單，把應變張量、載子輸運、鬆弛中的相關限制連到可觀察證據。
steps.objectiveEn: Complete a engineering acceptance sheet for review strain integration, connecting relevant limits in strain tensors, carrier transport and relaxation to observable evidence.
steps.instruction: 本步問題：應變整合結論。整合本步及本階段先前證據；提出兩項彼此不同的接受條件；再列一個會讓你暫緩放行的結果及下一個確認動作。判讀依據：需將輸運收益與缺陷、漏電及版圖變異一起呈現。引用列出的原始資料；若使用數值，清楚標成自訂教學假設。
steps.instructionEn: Question for this step: Review strain integration. Combine this step with earlier stage evidence; propose two independent acceptance criteria; name one hold condition and the next confirming action. Interpretation: Report transport gains with defects, leakage and layout variation. Cite the listed primary material; label any chosen numbers as hypothetical educational inputs.
steps.observation: 檢查結果是否能支持「需將輸運收益與缺陷、漏電及版圖變異一起呈現。」；若證據不足，標記尚未確定並寫出缺少的量測。
steps.observationEn: Check whether the evidence supports: Report transport gains with defects, leakage and layout variation. If insufficient, mark the conclusion unresolved and name the missing measurement.
steps.failure: 常見錯判：低塊材電阻率保證低界面接觸電阻。 應回到「應變整合結論」的假設與採樣範圍，補足能區分機制的證據。
steps.failureEn: Common misinterpretation: Low bulk resistivity guarantees low interface contact resistance. Revisit assumptions and sampling for review strain integration and add discriminating evidence.
steps.check: 交付「應變整合結論」工程驗收單：驗收單需有原理、兩項證據、保留疑問及前後模組交接。
steps.checkEn: Submit the engineering acceptance sheet for review strain integration: The sheet needs the principle, two evidence items, open questions and module handoff.

title: 矽鍺選擇性磊晶
summary: 以 4 階段、24 個工程工作包拆解選擇性磊晶、晶面、活化接觸，完成圖解、對照、敏感度分析、故障判別、量測規劃與驗收。
summaryEn: Four stages and 24 work packages explore selective epitaxy, facets and activated contacts through diagrams, comparisons, sensitivity studies, fault diagnosis, measurement plans and acceptance reviews.
scope: 依公開原理編寫的雙語概念實作課；每步交付可審查的工程證據。24 步是學習拆解，不代表晶圓廠的完整配方。自行設定的數值須標為假設。題目不含可直接操作的化學混配、設備設定或量產公差；照片與外部影片為代表媒體，不是假稱每步實拍。
scopeEn: Bilingual conceptual exercises based on public principles, with reviewable evidence at each step. The 24 steps are a learning decomposition, not a complete fab recipe. Chosen numerical inputs must be labeled hypothetical. No directly operable chemical mixtures, equipment settings or production tolerances are supplied. Photos and external videos are representative media, not claimed as recordings of every step.

stages.title: 選擇性與晶格
stages.description: 在「選擇性與晶格」建立六項互補證據，逐一檢查材料、幾何、物理機制與適用限制。
stages.descriptionEn: Build six complementary evidence items for selectivity and lattice, checking materials, geometry, mechanisms and validity limits.

steps.title: 選擇性定義
steps.objective: 完成「選擇性定義」的因果圖，把選擇性磊晶、晶面、活化接觸中的相關限制連到可觀察證據。
steps.objectiveEn: Complete a causal diagram for define selectivity, connecting relevant limits in selective epitaxy, facets and activated contacts to observable evidence.
steps.instruction: 本步問題：選擇性定義。畫一張含作用前後狀態的原創圖；以箭頭標出本步原理中的因果關係；圈出一項仍需量測的未知量。判讀依據：在矽上成長且在介電層抑制成核是兩個需驗證的條件。引用列出的原始資料；若使用數值，清楚標成自訂教學假設。
steps.instructionEn: Question for this step: Define selectivity. Draw an original before/after diagram; mark the causal relationship in this step; circle one quantity still requiring measurement. Interpretation: Growth on silicon and suppressed dielectric nucleation both need evidence. Cite the listed primary material; label any chosen numbers as hypothetical educational inputs.
steps.observation: 檢查結果是否能支持「在矽上成長且在介電層抑制成核是兩個需驗證的條件。」；若證據不足，標記尚未確定並寫出缺少的量測。
steps.observationEn: Check whether the evidence supports: Growth on silicon and suppressed dielectric nucleation both need evidence. If insufficient, mark the conclusion unresolved and name the missing measurement.
steps.failure: 常見錯判：沉積循環數總能從第一循環精確線性外推。 應回到「選擇性定義」的假設與採樣範圍，補足能區分機制的證據。
steps.failureEn: Common misinterpretation: Thickness always extrapolates linearly from the first cycle. Revisit assumptions and sampling for define selectivity and add discriminating evidence.
steps.check: 交付「選擇性定義」因果圖：圖中要有邊界、輸入、輸出與一項不能僅由圖決定的量。
steps.checkEn: Submit the causal diagram for define selectivity: Show boundaries, inputs, outputs and one quantity that the diagram alone cannot determine.

knowledge.title: 選擇性定義的原理
knowledge.text: 在矽上成長且在介電層抑制成核是兩個需驗證的條件。
knowledge.textEn: Growth on silicon and suppressed dielectric nucleation both need evidence.

knowledge.title: 本階段的機制與工程權衡
knowledge.text: 選擇性磊晶同時追求目標表面成長及非目標表面不成核，必須報告兩種表面的結果。
knowledge.textEn: Selective epitaxy requires growth on target surfaces and suppressed nucleation elsewhere; report both surface outcomes.

quiz.question: 評估「選擇性定義」時，哪項敘述可以採用？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is valid when evaluating define selectivity?
options: 在矽上成長且在介電層抑制成核是兩個需驗證的條件。
沉積循環數總能從第一循環精確線性外推。
厚度相同就代表介面電性相同。
optionsEn: Growth on silicon and suppressed dielectric nucleation both need evidence.
Thickness always extrapolates linearly from the first cycle.
Equal thickness implies equal interface electrical quality.
quiz.explanation: 在矽上成長且在介電層抑制成核是兩個需驗證的條件。 選擇性磊晶同時追求目標表面成長及非目標表面不成核，必須報告兩種表面的結果。
quiz.explanationEn: Growth on silicon and suppressed dielectric nucleation both need evidence. Selective epitaxy requires growth on target surfaces and suppressed nucleation elsewhere; report both surface outcomes.

steps.title: 鍺比例

steps.objectiveEn: Complete a controlled comparison for set germanium fraction, connecting relevant limits in selective epitaxy, facets and activated contacts to observable evidence.
steps.instruction: 本步問題：鍺比例。建立兩個只改一項條件的假想案例；分開記錄可觀察差異與推測原因；說明如何用本步原理區分兩者。判讀依據：鍺比例同時影響晶格、能帶及材料穩定性。引用列出的原始資料；若使用數值，清楚標成自訂教學假設。
steps.instructionEn: Question for this step: Set germanium fraction. Create two hypothetical cases differing in one condition; separate observations from proposed causes; use this step’s principle to distinguish them. Interpretation: Germanium fraction affects lattice, bands and material stability. Cite the listed primary material; label any chosen numbers as hypothetical educational inputs.
steps.observation: 檢查結果是否能支持「鍺比例同時影響晶格、能帶及材料穩定性。」；若證據不足，標記尚未確定並寫出缺少的量測。
steps.observationEn: Check whether the evidence supports: Germanium fraction affects lattice, bands and material stability. If insufficient, mark the conclusion unresolved and name the missing measurement.
steps.failure: 常見錯判：沉積循環數總能從第一循環精確線性外推。 應回到「鍺比例」的假設與採樣範圍，補足能區分機制的證據。
steps.failureEn: Common misinterpretation: Thickness always extrapolates linearly from the first cycle. Revisit assumptions and sampling for set germanium fraction and add discriminating evidence.
steps.check: 交付「鍺比例」對照表：交出兩案例、固定條件、預期差異及一項可能混淆因素。
steps.checkEn: Submit the controlled comparison for set germanium fraction: Submit both cases, fixed conditions, predicted difference and one confounder.

steps.instruction: 本步問題：種晶表面。選出本步的一項輸入及一項輸出；以自訂低、中、高三點畫趨勢；逐點標註假設，並寫出趨勢可能失效的條件。判讀依據：殘氧化層會阻礙預期晶體延續。引用列出的原始資料；若使用數值，清楚標成自訂教學假設。
steps.instructionEn: Question for this step: Identify seed surfaces. Select one input and output for this step; sketch a hypothetical low/mid/high trend; label assumptions and state when the trend may fail. Interpretation: Residual oxide impedes intended crystalline continuation. Cite the listed primary material; label any chosen numbers as hypothetical educational inputs.
steps.observation: 檢查結果是否能支持「殘氧化層會阻礙預期晶體延續。」；若證據不足，標記尚未確定並寫出缺少的量測。
steps.observationEn: Check whether the evidence supports: Residual oxide impedes intended crystalline continuation. If insufficient, mark the conclusion unresolved and name the missing measurement.
steps.failure: 常見錯判：沉積循環數總能從第一循環精確線性外推。 應回到「種晶表面」的假設與採樣範圍，補足能區分機制的證據。
steps.failureEn: Common misinterpretation: Thickness always extrapolates linearly from the first cycle. Revisit assumptions and sampling for identify seed surfaces and add discriminating evidence.
steps.check: 交付「種晶表面」敏感度草圖：圖須有變數、單位或無因次定義、三個假設點及適用範圍。
steps.checkEn: Submit the sensitivity sketch for identify seed surfaces: Include variables, units or dimensionless definitions, three hypothetical points and validity limits.

steps.objectiveEn: Complete a fault-discrimination table for define opening geometry, connecting relevant limits in selective epitaxy, facets and activated contacts to observable evidence.
steps.instruction: 本步問題：開口幾何。假設本步預期結果未出現；提出兩個不同機制；為各機制選一個能支持或否定的觀察，避免只重複同一量測。判讀依據：側壁角及暴露晶面會影響最終晶面形貌。引用列出的原始資料；若使用數值，清楚標成自訂教學假設。
steps.instructionEn: Question for this step: Define opening geometry. Assume the expected result fails; propose two distinct mechanisms; choose an observation that supports or rejects each rather than repeating one measurement. Interpretation: Sidewall angle and exposed planes affect final facets. Cite the listed primary material; label any chosen numbers as hypothetical educational inputs.
steps.observation: 檢查結果是否能支持「側壁角及暴露晶面會影響最終晶面形貌。」；若證據不足，標記尚未確定並寫出缺少的量測。

steps.check: 交付「開口幾何」故障判別表：至少列出兩個假說、各自的辨別證據及先檢查順序。
steps.checkEn: Submit the fault-discrimination table for define opening geometry: List two hypotheses, discriminating evidence for each and a check order.

steps.instruction: 本步問題：摻雜與成長。針對本步定義待測量及採樣位置；列出解析度、背景與重複性；設計一個見證或空白，並說明檢出限如何限制結論。判讀依據：原位摻雜可能改變成長動力學。引用列出的原始資料；若使用數值，清楚標成自訂教學假設。
steps.instructionEn: Question for this step: Couple doping and growth. Define the measurand and sampling locations; list resolution, background and repeatability; design a witness or blank and explain detection-limit constraints. Interpretation: In-situ doping can change growth kinetics. Cite the listed primary material; label any chosen numbers as hypothetical educational inputs.
steps.observation: 檢查結果是否能支持「原位摻雜可能改變成長動力學。」；若證據不足，標記尚未確定並寫出缺少的量測。

steps.instructionEn: Question for this step: Set thermal-budget bounds. Combine this step with earlier stage evidence; propose two independent acceptance criteria; name one hold condition and the next confirming action. Interpretation: Adjacent gates and underlying materials constrain thermal history. Cite the listed primary material; label any chosen numbers as hypothetical educational inputs.
steps.observation: 檢查結果是否能支持「鄰近閘與底層材料限制可採用的熱歷程。」；若證據不足，標記尚未確定並寫出缺少的量測。

steps.check: 交付「表面前清潔」因果圖：圖中要有邊界、輸入、輸出與一項不能僅由圖決定的量。

title: 平面 CMOS 製程整合
summary: 以 4 階段、24 個工程工作包拆解井區、接面及互補電路連通，完成圖解、對照、敏感度分析、故障判別、量測規劃與驗收。
summaryEn: Four stages and 24 work packages explore wells, junctions and complementary-circuit connectivity through diagrams, comparisons, sensitivity studies, fault diagnosis, measurement plans and acceptance reviews.
scope: 依公開原理編寫的雙語概念實作課；每步交付可審查的工程證據。24 步是學習拆解，不代表晶圓廠的完整配方。自行設定的數值須標為假設。題目不含可直接操作的化學混配、設備設定或量產公差；照片與外部影片為代表媒體，不是假稱每步實拍。
scopeEn: Bilingual conceptual exercises based on public principles, with reviewable evidence at each step. The 24 steps are a learning decomposition, not a complete fab recipe. Chosen numerical inputs must be labeled hypothetical. No directly operable chemical mixtures, equipment settings or production tolerances are supplied. Photos and external videos are representative media, not claimed as recordings of every step.

stages.title: CMOS 功能與隔離
stages.description: 在「CMOS 功能與隔離」建立六項互補證據，逐一檢查材料、幾何、物理機制與適用限制。
stages.descriptionEn: Build six complementary evidence items for cmos function and isolation, checking materials, geometry, mechanisms and validity limits.

steps.title: 互補反相器
steps.objective: 完成「互補反相器」的因果圖，把井區、接面及互補電路連通中的相關限制連到可觀察證據。
steps.objectiveEn: Complete a causal diagram for draw a complementary inverter, connecting relevant limits in wells, junctions and complementary-circuit connectivity to observable evidence.
steps.instruction: 本步問題：互補反相器。畫一張含作用前後狀態的原創圖；以箭頭標出本步原理中的因果關係；圈出一項仍需量測的未知量。判讀依據：NMOS 與 PMOS 的連接決定靜態邏輯功能。引用列出的原始資料；若使用數值，清楚標成自訂教學假設。
steps.instructionEn: Question for this step: Draw a complementary inverter. Draw an original before/after diagram; mark the causal relationship in this step; circle one quantity still requiring measurement. Interpretation: NMOS and PMOS connectivity determines static logic function. Cite the listed primary material; label any chosen numbers as hypothetical educational inputs.
steps.observation: 檢查結果是否能支持「NMOS 與 PMOS 的連接決定靜態邏輯功能。」；若證據不足，標記尚未確定並寫出缺少的量測。
steps.observationEn: Check whether the evidence supports: NMOS and PMOS connectivity determines static logic function. If insufficient, mark the conclusion unresolved and name the missing measurement.
steps.failure: 常見錯判：總電流合格就證明每個通道都完整。 應回到「互補反相器」的假設與採樣範圍，補足能區分機制的證據。
steps.failureEn: Common misinterpretation: Acceptable total current proves every channel is intact. Revisit assumptions and sampling for draw a complementary inverter and add discriminating evidence.
steps.check: 交付「互補反相器」因果圖：圖中要有邊界、輸入、輸出與一項不能僅由圖決定的量。
steps.checkEn: Submit the causal diagram for draw a complementary inverter: Show boundaries, inputs, outputs and one quantity that the diagram alone cannot determine.

knowledge.title: 互補反相器的原理
knowledge.text: NMOS 與 PMOS 的連接決定靜態邏輯功能。
knowledge.textEn: NMOS and PMOS connectivity determines static logic function.

knowledge.title: 本階段的機制與工程權衡
knowledge.text: 反相器功能來自互補拉高與拉低路徑，井與本體接點則協助維持電位及抑制寄生作用。
knowledge.textEn: An inverter uses complementary pull-up and pull-down paths, while wells and body ties maintain potentials and suppress parasitics.

quiz.question: 評估「互補反相器」時，哪項敘述可以採用？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is valid when evaluating draw a complementary inverter?
options: NMOS 與 PMOS 的連接決定靜態邏輯功能。
總電流合格就證明每個通道都完整。
頂面膜厚代表所有側壁與底部厚度。
optionsEn: NMOS and PMOS connectivity determines static logic function.
Acceptable total current proves every channel is intact.
Top thickness represents all sidewall and bottom thicknesses.
quiz.explanation: NMOS 與 PMOS 的連接決定靜態邏輯功能。 反相器功能來自互補拉高與拉低路徑，井與本體接點則協助維持電位及抑制寄生作用。
quiz.explanationEn: NMOS and PMOS connectivity determines static logic function. An inverter uses complementary pull-up and pull-down paths, while wells and body ties maintain potentials and suppress parasitics.

steps.check: 交付「井區與基板」對照表：交出兩案例、固定條件、預期差異及一項可能混淆因素。
steps.checkEn: Submit the controlled comparison for assign wells and substrate: Submit both cases, fixed conditions, predicted difference and one confounder.

steps.instructionEn: Question for this step: Map mask hierarchy. Select one input and output for this step; sketch a hypothetical low/mid/high trend; label assumptions and state when the trend may fail. steps.instruction: 本步問題：隔離與寄生。假設本步預期結果未出現；提出兩個不同機制；為各機制選一個能支持或否定的觀察，避免只重複同一量測。判讀依據：隔離不足可能產生原電路圖未畫出的路徑。引用列出的原始資料；若使用數值，清楚標成自訂教學假設。
steps.instructionEn: Question for this step: Map isolation and parasitics. Assume the expected result fails; propose two distinct mechanisms; choose an observation that supports or rejects each rather than repeating one measurement. Interpretation: Insufficient isolation can create paths absent from the intended schematic. Cite the listed primary material; label any chosen numbers as hypothetical educational inputs.
steps.observation: 檢查結果是否能支持「隔離不足可能產生原電路圖未畫出的路徑。」；若證據不足，標記尚未確定並寫出缺少的量測。

title: 鰭式電晶體製造
summary: 以 4 階段、24 個工程工作包拆解鰭形貌、三面閘及量化驅動，完成圖解、對照、敏感度分析、故障判別、量測規劃與驗收。
summaryEn: Four stages and 24 work packages explore fin geometry, three-sided gates and quantized drive through diagrams, comparisons, sensitivity studies, fault diagnosis, measurement plans and acceptance reviews.
scope: 依公開原理編寫的雙語概念實作課；每步交付可審查的工程證據。24 步是學習拆解，不代表晶圓廠的完整配方。自行設定的數值須標為假設。題目不含可直接操作的化學混配、設備設定或量產公差；照片與外部影片為代表媒體，不是假稱每步實拍。
scopeEn: Bilingual conceptual exercises based on public principles, with reviewable evidence at each step. The 24 steps are a learning decomposition, not a complete fab recipe. Chosen numerical inputs must be labeled hypothetical. No directly operable chemical mixtures, equipment settings or production tolerances are supplied. Photos and external videos are representative media, not claimed as recordings of every step.

Draw an original before/after diagram; mark the causal relationship in this step; circle one quantity still requiring measurement. knowledge.textEn: Top-bottom width differences alter fields and effective cross-section.

knowledge.title: 本階段的機制與工程權衡
knowledge.text: 鰭寬、側壁角與隔離回蝕高度共同定義通道截面，三者量測應配準到同一位置。
knowledge.textEn: Fin width, taper and isolation recess jointly define the channel section and need co-registered measurements.

quiz.question: 評估「鰭側壁角」時，哪項敘述可以採用？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is valid when evaluating measure fin taper?
options: 幾何完整即可省略漏電量測。
上下寬度差會改變電場與有效截面。
接觸面積加倍必定使全部串聯電阻減半。
optionsEn: Geometric integrity eliminates the need for leakage measurements.
Top-bottom width differences alter fields and effective cross-section.
Doubling contact area must halve all series resistance.
quiz.explanation: 上下寬度差會改變電場與有效截面。 鰭寬、側壁角與隔離回蝕高度共同定義通道截面，三者量測應配準到同一位置。
quiz.explanationEn: Top-bottom width differences alter fields and effective cross-section. Fin width, taper and isolation recess jointly define the channel section and need co-registered measurements.

steps.title: 鰭粗糙度
steps.objective: 完成「鰭粗糙度」的敏感度草圖，把鰭形貌、三面閘及量化驅動中的相關限制連到可觀察證據。
steps.objectiveEn: Complete a sensitivity sketch for map fin roughness, connecting relevant limits in fin geometry, three-sided gates and quantized drive to observable evidence.
steps.instruction: 本步問題：鰭粗糙度。選出本步的一項輸入及一項輸出；以自訂低、中、高三點畫趨勢；逐點標註假設，並寫出趨勢可能失效的條件。判讀依據：邊緣起伏可轉為局部通道寬度變異。引用列出的原始資料；若使用數值，清楚標成自訂教學假設。
steps.instructionEn: Question for this step: Map fin roughness. Select one input and output for this step; sketch a hypothetical low/mid/high trend; label assumptions and state when the trend may fail. Interpretation: Edge fluctuations translate into local channel-width variation. Cite the listed primary material; label any chosen numbers as hypothetical educational inputs.
steps.observation: 檢查結果是否能支持「邊緣起伏可轉為局部通道寬度變異。」；若證據不足，標記尚未確定並寫出缺少的量測。
steps.observationEn: Check whether the evidence supports: Edge fluctuations translate into local channel-width variation. If insufficient, mark the conclusion unresolved and name the missing measurement.
steps.failure: 常見錯判：幾何完整即可省略漏電量測。 應回到「鰭粗糙度」的假設與採樣範圍，補足能區分機制的證據。
steps.failureEn: Common misinterpretation: Geometric integrity eliminates the need for leakage measurements. Revisit assumptions and sampling for map fin roughness and add discriminating evidence.
steps.check: 交付「鰭粗糙度」敏感度草圖：圖須有變數、單位或無因次定義、三個假設點及適用範圍。
steps.checkEn: Submit the sensitivity sketch for map fin roughness: Include variables, units or dimensionless definitions, three hypothetical points and validity limits.

steps.objective: 完成「隔離填充」的故障判別表，把鰭形貌、三面閘及量化驅動中的相關限制連到可觀察證據。

steps.instruction: 本步問題：隔離填充。假設本步預期結果未出現；提出兩個不同機制；為各機制選一個能支持或否定的觀察，避免只重複同一量測。判讀依據：鰭間填充要避免空洞與不均應力。引用列出的原始資料；若使用數值，清楚標成自訂教學假設。
steps.instructionEn: Question for this step: Inspect isolation fill. Assume the expected result fails; propose two distinct mechanisms; choose an observation that supports or rejects each rather than repeating one measurement. Interpretation: Inter-fin fill must avoid voids and nonuniform stress. Cite the listed primary material; label any chosen numbers as hypothetical educational inputs.
steps.observation: 檢查結果是否能支持「鰭間填充要避免空洞與不均應力。」；若證據不足，標記尚未確定並寫出缺少的量測。

steps.failureEn: Common misinterpretation: Geometric integrity eliminates the need for leakage measurements. Revisit assumptions and sampling for inspect isolation fill and add discriminating evidence.
steps.check: 交付「隔離填充」故障判別表：至少列出兩個假說、各自的辨別證據及先檢查順序。
steps.checkEn: Submit the fault-discrimination table for inspect isolation fill: List two hypotheses, discriminating evidence for each and a check order.

steps.instruction: 本步問題：隔離回蝕。針對本步定義待測量及採樣位置；列出解析度、背景與重複性；設計一個見證或空白，並說明檢出限如何限制結論。判讀依據：回蝕高度決定暴露鰭高。引用列出的原始資料；若使用數值，清楚標成自訂教學假設。
steps.instructionEn: Question for this step: Control isolation recess evidence. Define the measurand and sampling locations; list resolution, background and repeatability; design a witness or blank and explain detection-limit constraints. Interpretation: Isolation recess defines exposed fin height. Cite the listed primary material; label any chosen numbers as hypothetical educational inputs.
steps.observation: 檢查結果是否能支持「回蝕高度決定暴露鰭高。」；若證據不足，標記尚未確定並寫出缺少的量測。

steps.check: 交付「隔離回蝕」量測規劃：提供採樣座標、量測單位、對照與不確定度來源。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan for control isolation recess evidence: Provide sampling coordinates, units, controls and uncertainty sources.

steps.objectiveEn: Complete a engineering acceptance sheet for define fin cuts, connecting relevant limits in fin geometry, three-sided gates and quantized drive to observable evidence.
steps.instruction: 本步問題：鰭切割。整合本步及本階段先前證據；提出兩項彼此不同的接受條件；再列一個會讓你暫緩放行的結果及下一個確認動作。判讀依據：切割位置決定哪些鰭區實際連通。引用列出的原始資料；若使用數值，清楚標成自訂教學假設。
steps.instructionEn: Question for this step: Define fin cuts. Combine this step with earlier stage evidence; propose two independent acceptance criteria; name one hold condition and the next confirming action. Interpretation: Fin cuts define actual connectivity between fin regions. Cite the listed primary material; label any chosen numbers as hypothetical educational inputs.
steps.observation: 檢查結果是否能支持「切割位置決定哪些鰭區實際連通。」；若證據不足，標記尚未確定並寫出缺少的量測。
steps.observationEn: Check whether the evidence supports: Fin cuts define actual connectivity between fin regions. If insufficient, mark the conclusion unresolved and name the missing measurement.
steps.failure: 常見錯判：幾何完整即可省略漏電量測。 應回到「鰭切割」的假設與採樣範圍，補足能區分機制的證據。
steps.failureEn: Common misinterpretation: Geometric integrity eliminates the need for leakage measurements. Revisit assumptions and sampling for define fin cuts and add discriminating evidence.
steps.check: 交付「鰭切割」工程驗收單：驗收單需有原理、兩項證據、保留疑問及前後模組交接。
steps.checkEn: Submit the engineering acceptance sheet for define fin cuts: The sheet needs the principle, two evidence items, open questions and module handoff.

stages.title: 三維閘與接觸
stages.description: 在「三維閘與接觸」建立六項互補證據，逐一檢查材料、幾何、物理機制與適用限制。
stages.descriptionEn: Build six complementary evidence items for 3d gates and contacts, checking materials, geometry, mechanisms and validity limits.

steps.title: 三維介電覆蓋
steps.objective: 完成「三維介電覆蓋」的因果圖，把鰭形貌、三面閘及量化驅動中的相關限制連到可觀察證據。
steps.objectiveEn: Complete a causal diagram for assess 3d dielectric coverage, connecting relevant limits in fin geometry, three-sided gates and quantized drive to observable evidence.
steps.instruction: 本步問題：三維介電覆蓋。畫一張含作用前後狀態的原創圖；以箭頭標出本步原理中的因果關係；圈出一項仍需量測的未知量。判讀依據：頂部膜厚合格不代表側壁合格。引用列出的原始資料；若使用數值，清楚標成自訂教學假設。
steps.instructionEn: Question for this step: Assess 3D dielectric coverage. Draw an original before/after diagram; mark the causal relationship in this step; circle one quantity still requiring measurement. Interpretation: Acceptable top thickness does not prove sidewall coverage. Cite the listed primary material; label any chosen numbers as hypothetical educational inputs.
steps.observation: 檢查結果是否能支持「頂部膜厚合格不代表側壁合格。」；若證據不足，標記尚未確定並寫出缺少的量測。
steps.observationEn: Check whether the evidence supports: Acceptable top thickness does not prove sidewall coverage. If insufficient, mark the conclusion unresolved and name the missing measurement.
steps.failure: 常見錯判：節點名稱就是實體閘長的量測值。 應回到「三維介電覆蓋」的假設與採樣範圍，補足能區分機制的證據。
steps.failureEn: Common misinterpretation: The node name is a measured physical gate length. Revisit assumptions and sampling for assess 3d dielectric coverage and add discriminating evidence.
steps.check: 交付「三維介電覆蓋」因果圖：圖中要有邊界、輸入、輸出與一項不能僅由圖決定的量。
steps.checkEn: Submit the causal diagram for assess 3d dielectric coverage: Show boundaries, inputs, outputs and one quantity that the diagram alone cannot determine.

knowledge.title: 三維介電覆蓋的原理
knowledge.text: 頂部膜厚合格不代表側壁合格。
knowledge.textEn: Acceptable top thickness does not prove sidewall coverage.

knowledge.title: 本階段的機制與工程權衡
knowledge.text: 三維閘堆疊增加側壁及角落界面，單一平面監控片不能完全代表成核、覆蓋與填充。
knowledge.textEn: Three-dimensional gates add sidewall and corner interfaces; one planar monitor cannot fully represent nucleation, coverage and fill.

quiz.question: 評估「三維介電覆蓋」時，哪項敘述可以採用？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is valid when evaluating assess 3d dielectric coverage?
options: 頂部膜厚合格不代表側壁合格。
節點名稱就是實體閘長的量測值。
模擬最佳值可直接當成量產良率。
optionsEn: Acceptable top thickness does not prove sidewall coverage.
The node name is a measured physical gate length.
The best simulation value directly represents production yield.
quiz.explanation: 頂部膜厚合格不代表側壁合格。 三維閘堆疊增加側壁及角落界面，單一平面監控片不能完全代表成核、覆蓋與填充。
quiz.explanationEn: Acceptable top thickness does not prove sidewall coverage. Three-dimensional gates add sidewall and corner interfaces; one planar monitor cannot fully represent nucleation, coverage and fill.

steps.objectiveEn: Complete a controlled comparison for inspect replacement-gate cavities, connecting relevant limits in fin geometry, three-sided gates and quantized drive to observable evidence.
steps.instruction: 本步問題：替換閘腔。建立兩個只改一項條件的假想案例；分開記錄可觀察差異與推測原因；說明如何用本步原理區分兩者。判讀依據：窄腔需容納介電層、功函數層與填充金屬。引用列出的原始資料；若使用數值，清楚標成自訂教學假設。
steps.instructionEn: Question for this step: Inspect replacement-gate cavities. Create two hypothetical cases differing in one condition; separate observations from proposed causes; use this step’s principle to distinguish them. Interpretation: Narrow cavities must accommodate dielectric, work-function and fill layers. Cite the listed primary material; label any chosen numbers as hypothetical educational inputs.
steps.observation: 檢查結果是否能支持「窄腔需容納介電層、功函數層與填充金屬。」；若證據不足，標記尚未確定並寫出缺少的量測。
steps.observationEn: Check whether the evidence supports: Narrow cavities must accommodate dielectric, work-function and fill layers. If insufficient, mark the conclusion unresolved and name the missing measurement.

steps.failureEn: Common misinterpretation: The node name is a measured physical gate length. Revisit assumptions and sampling for inspect replacement-gate cavities and add discriminating evidence.
steps.check: 交付「替換閘腔」對照表：交出兩案例、固定條件、預期差異及一項可能混淆因素。
steps.checkEn: Submit the controlled comparison for inspect replacement-gate cavities: Submit both cases, fixed conditions, predicted difference and one confounder.

title: 環繞閘極奈米片電晶體
summary: 以 4 階段、24 個工程工作包拆解片間釋放、環繞閘及逐層差異，完成圖解、對照、敏感度分析、故障判別、量測規劃與驗收。
summaryEn: Four stages and 24 work packages explore inter-sheet release, wraparound gates and layer variation through diagrams, comparisons, sensitivity studies, fault diagnosis, measurement plans and acceptance reviews.
scope: 依公開原理編寫的雙語概念實作課；每步交付可審查的工程證據。24 步是學習拆解，不代表晶圓廠的完整配方。自行設定的數值須標為假設。題目不含可直接操作的化學混配、設備設定或量產公差；照片與外部影片為代表媒體，不是假稱每步實拍。
scopeEn: Bilingual conceptual exercises based on public principles, with reviewable evidence at each step. The 24 steps are a learning decomposition, not a complete fab recipe. Chosen numerical inputs must be labeled hypothetical. No directly operable chemical mixtures, equipment settings or production tolerances are supplied. Photos and external videos are representative media, not claimed as recordings of every step.

steps.title: 層間距預算

steps.objectiveEn: Complete a fault-discrimination table for budget inter-sheet spacing, connecting relevant limits in inter-sheet release, wraparound gates and layer variation to observable evidence.
steps.instruction: 本步問題：層間距預算。假設本步預期結果未出現；提出兩個不同機制；為各機制選一個能支持或否定的觀察，避免只重複同一量測。判讀依據：間距需容納介電、功函數及閘金屬。引用列出的原始資料；若使用數值，清楚標成自訂教學假設。 自訂間隙預算：片間距 20 個單位，兩側各需介電 2、功函數層 3；算中間剩餘填充空間，再讓每側功函數層各增加 1 單位檢查裕度。
steps.instructionEn: Question for this step: Budget inter-sheet spacing. Assume the expected result fails; propose two distinct mechanisms; choose an observation that supports or rejects each rather than repeating one measurement. Interpretation: Spacing must fit dielectric, work-function and gate metal. Cite the listed primary material; label any chosen numbers as hypothetical educational inputs. Hypothetical gap budget: spacing 20 units, each face needs dielectric 2 and work-function metal 3. Calculate remaining fill space and test margin after increasing each face’s work-function layer by 1 unit.
steps.observation: 檢查結果是否能支持「間距需容納介電、功函數及閘金屬。」；若證據不足，標記尚未確定並寫出缺少的量測。
steps.observationEn: Check whether the evidence supports: Spacing must fit dielectric, work-function and gate metal. If insufficient, mark the conclusion unresolved and name the missing measurement.
steps.failure: 常見錯判：總電流合格就證明每個通道都完整。 應回到「層間距預算」的假設與採樣範圍，補足能區分機制的證據。
steps.failureEn: Common misinterpretation: Acceptable total current proves every channel is intact. Revisit assumptions and sampling for budget inter-sheet spacing and add discriminating evidence.
steps.check: 交付「層間距預算」故障判別表：至少列出兩個假說、各自的辨別證據及先檢查順序。 同時交付算例的中間步驟或比較圖，並標示假設與模型限制。
steps.checkEn: Submit the fault-discrimination table for budget inter-sheet spacing: List two hypotheses, discriminating evidence for each and a check order. Also submit intermediate calculations or comparison diagrams with assumptions and model limits.

knowledge.title: 層間距預算的原理
knowledge.text: 間距需容納介電、功函數及閘金屬。
knowledge.textEn: Spacing must fit dielectric, work-function and gate metal.

knowledge.title: 本階段的機制與工程權衡
knowledge.text: 奈米片有效通道寬與片周長及片數相關，但片間空間同時限制閘金屬體積。
knowledge.textEn: Effective channel width relates to sheet perimeter and count, while inter-sheet spacing limits gate-metal volume.

quiz.question: 評估「層間距預算」時，哪項敘述可以採用？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is valid when evaluating budget inter-sheet spacing?
options: 間距需容納介電、功函數及閘金屬。
總電流合格就證明每個通道都完整。
頂面膜厚代表所有側壁與底部厚度。
optionsEn: Spacing must fit dielectric, work-function and gate metal.
Acceptable total current proves every channel is intact.
Top thickness represents all sidewall and bottom thicknesses.
quiz.explanation: 間距需容納介電、功函數及閘金屬。 奈米片有效通道寬與片周長及片數相關，但片間空間同時限制閘金屬體積。
quiz.explanationEn: Spacing must fit dielectric, work-function and gate metal. Effective channel width relates to sheet perimeter and count, while inter-sheet spacing limits gate-metal volume.

steps.title: 底部隔離
steps.objective: 完成「底部隔離」的量測規劃，把片間釋放、環繞閘及逐層差異中的相關限制連到可觀察證據。

steps.instructionEn: Question for this step: Define bottom isolation. Define the measurand and sampling locations; list resolution, background and repeatability; design a witness or blank and explain detection-limit constraints. Interpretation: Bottom parasitic conduction does not vanish merely because upper sheets are gated. Cite the listed primary material; label any chosen numbers as hypothetical educational inputs.

steps.check: 交付「底部隔離」量測規劃：提供採樣座標、量測單位、對照與不確定度來源。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan for define bottom isolation: Provide sampling coordinates, units, controls and uncertainty sources.

steps.instruction: 本步問題：堆疊均勻性。整合本步及本階段先前證據；提出兩項彼此不同的接受條件；再列一個會讓你暫緩放行的結果及下一個確認動作。判讀依據：各層厚度偏差可形成不同電性通道。引用列出的原始資料；若使用數值，清楚標成自訂教學假設。
steps.instructionEn: Question for this step: Map stack uniformity. Combine this step with earlier stage evidence; propose two independent acceptance criteria; name one hold condition and the next confirming action. Interpretation: Layer-thickness variation can create electrically different channels. Cite the listed primary material; label any chosen numbers as hypothetical educational inputs.
steps.observation: 檢查結果是否能支持「各層厚度偏差可形成不同電性通道。」；若證據不足，標記尚未確定並寫出缺少的量測。

steps.checkEn: Submit the engineering acceptance sheet for map stack uniformity: The sheet needs the principle, two evidence items, open questions and module handoff.

stages.title: 內間隔與源汲極
stages.description: 在「內間隔與源汲極」建立六項互補證據，逐一檢查材料、幾何、物理機制與適用限制。
stages.descriptionEn: Build six complementary evidence items for inner spacers and source-drain, checking materials, geometry, mechanisms and validity limits.

steps.title: 源汲極凹槽
steps.objective: 完成「源汲極凹槽」的因果圖，把片間釋放、環繞閘及逐層差異中的相關限制連到可觀察證據。
steps.objectiveEn: Complete a causal diagram for define source-drain recess, connecting relevant limits in inter-sheet release, wraparound gates and layer variation to observable evidence.
steps.instruction: 本步問題：源汲極凹槽。畫一張含作用前後狀態的原創圖；以箭頭標出本步原理中的因果關係；圈出一項仍需量測的未知量。判讀依據：凹槽會暴露各片端點並設定後續磊晶區域。引用列出的原始資料；若使用數值，清楚標成自訂教學假設。
steps.instructionEn: Question for this step: Define source-drain recess. Draw an original before/after diagram; mark the causal relationship in this step; circle one quantity still requiring measurement. Interpretation: The recess exposes sheet ends and defines subsequent epitaxial regions. Cite the listed primary material; label any chosen numbers as hypothetical educational inputs.
steps.observation: 檢查結果是否能支持「凹槽會暴露各片端點並設定後續磊晶區域。」；若證據不足，標記尚未確定並寫出缺少的量測。
steps.observationEn: Check whether the evidence supports: The recess exposes sheet ends and defines subsequent epitaxial regions. If insufficient, mark the conclusion unresolved and name the missing measurement.
steps.failure: 常見錯判：幾何完整即可省略漏電量測。 應回到「源汲極凹槽」的假設與採樣範圍，補足能區分機制的證據。
steps.failureEn: Common misinterpretation: Geometric integrity eliminates the need for leakage measurements. Revisit assumptions and sampling for define source-drain recess and add discriminating evidence.
steps.check: 交付「源汲極凹槽」因果圖：圖中要有邊界、輸入、輸出與一項不能僅由圖決定的量。
steps.checkEn: Submit the causal diagram for define source-drain recess: Show boundaries, inputs, outputs and one quantity that the diagram alone cannot determine.

knowledge.title: 源汲極凹槽的原理
knowledge.text: 凹槽會暴露各片端點並設定後續磊晶區域。
knowledge.textEn: The recess exposes sheet ends and defines subsequent epitaxial regions.

knowledge.title: 本階段的機制與工程權衡
knowledge.text: 內間隔在源汲極與可移除犧牲層間提供保護，使後續釋放能避免破壞電流進入端。
knowledge.textEn: Inner spacers protect the source-drain from removable sacrificial layers, preserving current-entry regions during release.

quiz.question: 評估「源汲極凹槽」時，哪項敘述可以採用？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is valid when evaluating define source-drain recess?
options: 凹槽會暴露各片端點並設定後續磊晶區域。
幾何完整即可省略漏電量測。
接觸面積加倍必定使全部串聯電阻減半。
optionsEn: The recess exposes sheet ends and defines subsequent epitaxial regions.
Geometric integrity eliminates the need for leakage measurements.
Doubling contact area must halve all series resistance.
quiz.explanation: 凹槽會暴露各片端點並設定後續磊晶區域。 內間隔在源汲極與可移除犧牲層間提供保護，使後續釋放能避免破壞電流進入端。
quiz.explanationEn: The recess exposes sheet ends and defines subsequent epitaxial regions. Inner spacers protect the source-drain from removable sacrificial layers, preserving current-entry regions during release.

steps.instruction: 本步問題：犧牲層側向凹蝕。建立兩個只改一項條件的假想案例；分開記錄可觀察差異與推測原因；說明如何用本步原理區分兩者。判讀依據：凹蝕深度決定內間隔層的可用長度。引用列出的原始資料；若使用數值，清楚標成自訂教學假設。
steps.instructionEn: Question for this step: Recess sacrificial layers laterally. Create two hypothetical cases differing in one condition; separate observations from proposed causes; use this step’s principle to distinguish them. Interpretation: Lateral recess determines available inner-spacer length. Cite the listed primary material; label any chosen numbers as hypothetical educational inputs.
steps.observation: 檢查結果是否能支持「凹蝕深度決定內間隔層的可用長度。」；若證據不足，標記尚未確定並寫出缺少的量測。
steps.observationEn: Check whether the evidence supports: Lateral recess determines available inner-spacer length. If insufficient, mark the conclusion unresolved and name the missing measurement.

steps.failureEn: Common misinterpretation: Geometric integrity eliminates the need for leakage measurements. Revisit assumptions and sampling for recess sacrificial layers laterally and add discriminating evidence.
steps.check: 交付「犧牲層側向凹蝕」對照表：交出兩案例、固定條件、預期差異及一項可能混淆因素。
steps.checkEn: Submit the controlled comparison for recess sacrificial layers laterally: Submit both cases, fixed conditions, predicted difference and one confounder.

steps.instructionEn: Question for this step: Inspect inner-spacer fill. Select one input and output for this step; sketch a hypothetical low/mid/high trend; label assumptions and state when the trend may fail. Interpretation: Voids or incomplete protection affect later release. Cite the listed primary material; label any chosen numbers as hypothetical educational inputs.
steps.observation: 檢查結果是否能支持「空洞或不完整保護會影響後續釋放。」；若證據不足，標記尚未確定並寫出缺少的量測。

steps.checkEn: Submit the sensitivity sketch for inspect inner-spacer fill: Include variables, units or dimensionless definitions, three hypothetical points and validity limits.

steps.instructionEn: Question for this step: Review GAA integration. Combine this step with earlier stage evidence; propose two independent acceptance criteria; name one hold condition and the next confirming action. Interpretation: Provide release, coverage, contact and variability evidence together. Cite the listed primary material; label any chosen numbers as hypothetical educational inputs.

steps.checkEn: Submit the engineering acceptance sheet for review gaa integration: The sheet needs the principle, two evidence items, open questions and module handoff.

title: 互補式堆疊電晶體研究流程
summary: 以 4 階段、24 個工程工作包拆解上下互補層、中介隔離及分層接觸，完成圖解、對照、敏感度分析、故障判別、量測規劃與驗收。
summaryEn: Four stages and 24 work packages explore complementary tiers, middle isolation and tier contacts through diagrams, comparisons, sensitivity studies, fault diagnosis, measurement plans and acceptance reviews.
scope: 依公開原理編寫的雙語概念實作課；每步交付可審查的工程證據。24 步是學習拆解，不代表晶圓廠的完整配方。自行設定的數值須標為假設。題目不含可直接操作的化學混配、設備設定或量產公差；照片與外部影片為代表媒體，不是假稱每步實拍。
scopeEn: Bilingual conceptual exercises based on public principles, with reviewable evidence at each step. The 24 steps are a learning decomposition, not a complete fab recipe. Chosen numerical inputs must be labeled hypothetical. No directly operable chemical mixtures, equipment settings or production tolerances are supplied. Photos and external videos are representative media, not claimed as recordings of every step.

stages.title: 互補堆疊架構
stages.description: 在「互補堆疊架構」建立六項互補證據，逐一檢查材料、幾何、物理機制與適用限制。
stages.descriptionEn: Build six complementary evidence items for complementary stacked architecture, checking materials, geometry, mechanisms and validity limits.

steps.title: 垂直互補配置
steps.objective: 完成「垂直互補配置」的因果圖，把上下互補層、中介隔離及分層接觸中的相關限制連到可觀察證據。
steps.objectiveEn: Complete a causal diagram for draw vertical complementary stacking, connecting relevant limits in complementary tiers, middle isolation and tier contacts to observable evidence.
steps.instruction: 本步問題：垂直互補配置。畫一張含作用前後狀態的原創圖；以箭頭標出本步原理中的因果關係；圈出一項仍需量測的未知量。判讀依據：CFET 堆疊 n 與 p 元件，不只是多片同極性通道。引用列出的原始資料；若使用數值，清楚標成自訂教學假設。
steps.instructionEn: Question for this step: Draw vertical complementary stacking. Draw an original before/after diagram; mark the causal relationship in this step; circle one quantity still requiring measurement. Interpretation: CFET stacks n and p devices, not merely multiple same-polarity channels. Cite the listed primary material; label any chosen numbers as hypothetical educational inputs.
steps.observation: 檢查結果是否能支持「CFET 堆疊 n 與 p 元件，不只是多片同極性通道。」；若證據不足，標記尚未確定並寫出缺少的量測。
steps.observationEn: Check whether the evidence supports: CFET stacks n and p devices, not merely multiple same-polarity channels. If insufficient, mark the conclusion unresolved and name the missing measurement.
steps.failure: 常見錯判：總電流合格就證明每個通道都完整。 應回到「垂直互補配置」的假設與採樣範圍，補足能區分機制的證據。
steps.failureEn: Common misinterpretation: Acceptable total current proves every channel is intact. Revisit assumptions and sampling for draw vertical complementary stacking and add discriminating evidence.
steps.check: 交付「垂直互補配置」因果圖：圖中要有邊界、輸入、輸出與一項不能僅由圖決定的量。
steps.checkEn: Submit the causal diagram for draw vertical complementary stacking: Show boundaries, inputs, outputs and one quantity that the diagram alone cannot determine.

knowledge.title: 垂直互補配置的原理
knowledge.text: CFET 堆疊 n 與 p 元件，不只是多片同極性通道。
knowledge.textEn: CFET stacks n and p devices, not merely multiple same-polarity channels.

knowledge.title: 本階段的機制與工程權衡
knowledge.text: CFET 以垂直方向取代部分平面 n-p 間距，但其面積收益取決於可實現的接觸與標準元件佈線。
knowledge.textEn: CFET replaces some lateral n-p spacing vertically, but area benefits depend on realizable contacts and cell routing.

quiz.question: 評估「垂直互補配置」時，哪項敘述可以採用？

options: CFET 堆疊 n 與 p 元件，不只是多片同極性通道。

optionsEn: CFET stacks n and p devices, not merely multiple same-polarity channels.
Acceptable total current proves every channel is intact.
Top thickness represents all sidewall and bottom thicknesses.
quiz.explanation: CFET 堆疊 n 與 p 元件，不只是多片同極性通道。 CFET 以垂直方向取代部分平面 n-p 間距，但其面積收益取決於可實現的接觸與標準元件佈線。
quiz.explanationEn: CFET stacks n and p devices, not merely multiple same-polarity channels. CFET replaces some lateral n-p spacing vertically, but area benefits depend on realizable contacts and cell routing.

steps.objectiveEn: Complete a controlled comparison for compare monolithic and sequential integration, connecting relevant limits in complementary tiers, middle isolation and tier contacts to observable evidence.
steps.instruction: 本步問題：單體與順序整合。建立兩個只改一項條件的假想案例；分開記錄可觀察差異與推測原因；說明如何用本步原理區分兩者。判讀依據：單次堆疊加工與先後形成元件有不同熱限制。引用列出的原始資料；若使用數值，清楚標成自訂教學假設。
steps.instructionEn: Question for this step: Compare monolithic and sequential integration. Create two hypothetical cases differing in one condition; separate observations from proposed causes; use this step’s principle to distinguish them. Interpretation: Single-stack and sequential device formation have different thermal constraints. Cite the listed primary material; label any chosen numbers as hypothetical educational inputs.
steps.observation: 檢查結果是否能支持「單次堆疊加工與先後形成元件有不同熱限制。」；若證據不足，標記尚未確定並寫出缺少的量測。

steps.checkEn: Submit the controlled comparison for compare monolithic and sequential integration: Submit both cases, fixed conditions, predicted difference and one confounder.

steps.title: 標準元件高度

steps.objectiveEn: Complete a sensitivity sketch for budget standard-cell height, connecting relevant limits in complementary tiers, middle isolation and tier contacts to observable evidence.

Interpretation: Removing lateral n-p separation does not eliminate routing space needs. Cite the listed primary material; label any chosen numbers as hypothetical educational inputs. Draw planar and CFET inverters with identical inputs and outputs. Mark source-drain, gates, VDD, VSS and output on each. Establish equivalent function through connectivity rather than shape.

Interpretation: Both device tiers need distinguishable electrical and contact tests. Cite the listed primary material; label any chosen numbers as hypothetical educational inputs.

steps.objective: 完成「對準誤差傳播」的工程驗收單，把上下互補層、中介隔離及分層接觸中的相關限制連到可觀察證據。
steps.objectiveEn: Complete a engineering acceptance sheet for propagate alignment error, connecting relevant limits in complementary tiers, middle isolation and tier contacts to observable evidence.
steps.instruction: 本步問題：對準誤差傳播。整合本步及本階段先前證據；提出兩項彼此不同的接受條件；再列一個會讓你暫緩放行的結果及下一個確認動作。判讀依據：不同模組的錯位需轉到同一三維座標。引用列出的原始資料；若使用數值，清楚標成自訂教學假設。
steps.instructionEn: Question for this step: Propagate alignment error. Combine this step with earlier stage evidence; propose two independent acceptance criteria; name one hold condition and the next confirming action. Interpretation: Module misalignments must be expressed in a common 3D frame. Cite the listed primary material; label any chosen numbers as hypothetical educational inputs.
steps.observation: 檢查結果是否能支持「不同模組的錯位需轉到同一三維座標。」；若證據不足，標記尚未確定並寫出缺少的量測。
steps.observationEn: Check whether the evidence supports: Module misalignments must be expressed in a common 3D frame. If insufficient, mark the conclusion unresolved and name the missing measurement.
steps.failure: 常見錯判：節點名稱就是實體閘長的量測值。 應回到「對準誤差傳播」的假設與採樣範圍，補足能區分機制的證據。
steps.failureEn: Common misinterpretation: The node name is a measured physical gate length. Revisit assumptions and sampling for propagate alignment error and add discriminating evidence.
steps.check: 交付「對準誤差傳播」工程驗收單：驗收單需有原理、兩項證據、保留疑問及前後模組交接。
steps.checkEn: Submit the engineering acceptance sheet for propagate alignment error: The sheet needs the principle, two evidence items, open questions and module handoff.

knowledge.text: 不同模組的錯位需轉到同一三維座標。

stages.description: 在「研究驗證」建立六項互補證據，逐一檢查材料、幾何、物理機制與適用限制。
stages.descriptionEn: Build six complementary evidence items for research validation, checking materials, geometry, mechanisms and validity limits.

steps.title: 分層 I-V 測試
steps.objective: 完成「分層 I-V 測試」的因果圖，把上下互補層、中介隔離及分層接觸中的相關限制連到可觀察證據。
steps.objectiveEn: Complete a causal diagram for test tier-resolved i-v, connecting relevant limits in complementary tiers, middle isolation and tier contacts to observable evidence.
steps.instruction: 本步問題：分層 I-V 測試。畫一張含作用前後狀態的原創圖；以箭頭標出本步原理中的因果關係；圈出一項仍需量測的未知量。判讀依據：只有合併輸出無法確認每層獨立功能。引用列出的原始資料；若使用數值，清楚標成自訂教學假設。
steps.instructionEn: Question for this step: Test tier-resolved I-V. Draw an original before/after diagram; mark the causal relationship in this step; circle one quantity still requiring measurement. Interpretation: Combined output alone cannot establish each tier's function. Cite the listed primary material; label any chosen numbers as hypothetical educational inputs.
steps.observation: 檢查結果是否能支持「只有合併輸出無法確認每層獨立功能。」；若證據不足，標記尚未確定並寫出缺少的量測。
steps.observationEn: Check whether the evidence supports: Combined output alone cannot establish each tier's function. If insufficient, mark the conclusion unresolved and name the missing measurement.
steps.failure: 常見錯判：單一中層截面可代表所有堆疊層。 應回到「分層 I-V 測試」的假設與採樣範圍，補足能區分機制的證據。
steps.failureEn: Common misinterpretation: One middle-layer section represents every stacked layer. Revisit assumptions and sampling for test tier-resolved i-v and add discriminating evidence.
steps.check: 交付「分層 I-V 測試」因果圖：圖中要有邊界、輸入、輸出與一項不能僅由圖決定的量。
steps.checkEn: Submit the causal diagram for test tier-resolved i-v: Show boundaries, inputs, outputs and one quantity that the diagram alone cannot determine.

knowledge.text: 只有合併輸出無法確認每層獨立功能。
knowledge.textEn: Combined output alone cannot establish each tier's function.

knowledge.text: 研究測試車展示功能後，仍需更多樣本驗證變異、存活率與可靠度，才能建立製造成熟度證據。
knowledge.textEn: After functional test-vehicle demonstrations, further samples are needed for variability, survival and reliability evidence.

低電阻可自動證明介電隔離完整。
optionsEn: Combined output alone cannot establish each tier's function.
One middle-layer section represents every stacked layer.
Low resistance automatically proves dielectric isolation.
