quiz.explanationEn: Combined output alone cannot establish each tier's function. After functional test-vehicle demonstrations, further samples are needed for variability, survival and reliability evidence.

steps.title: 反相器轉移曲線
steps.objective: 完成「反相器轉移曲線」的對照表，把上下互補層、中介隔離及分層接觸中的相關限制連到可觀察證據。
steps.objectiveEn: Complete a controlled comparison for assess inverter transfer, connecting relevant limits in complementary tiers, middle isolation and tier contacts to observable evidence.
steps.instruction: 本步問題：反相器轉移曲線。建立兩個只改一項條件的假想案例；分開記錄可觀察差異與推測原因；說明如何用本步原理區分兩者。本步反相器轉移曲線一律為自訂教學模型；在圖上標示假想 VDD 與輸入輸出，不將曲線歸屬為 imec 實測資料。判讀依據：互補特性需由完整電路連接與轉移曲線驗證。引用列出的原始資料；若使用數值，清楚標成自訂教學假設。
steps.instructionEn: Question for this step: Assess inverter transfer. Create two hypothetical cases differing in one condition; separate observations from proposed causes; use this step’s principle to distinguish them. All inverter transfer curves in this exercise are hypothetical teaching models. Label the assumed VDD, input and output; do not attribute these curves to imec measurements. Interpretation: Complementarity needs circuit connectivity and transfer-curve evidence. Cite the listed primary material; label any chosen numbers as hypothetical educational inputs.
steps.observation: 檢查結果是否能支持「互補特性需由完整電路連接與轉移曲線驗證。」；若證據不足，標記尚未確定並寫出缺少的量測。
steps.observationEn: Check whether the evidence supports: Complementarity needs circuit connectivity and transfer-curve evidence. If insufficient, mark the conclusion unresolved and name the missing measurement.
steps.failure: 常見錯判：上下層各自都有正常的電晶體電流曲線，就足以證明接成反相器後的轉移曲線正確。 應回到「反相器轉移曲線」的假設與採樣範圍，補足能區分機制的證據。
steps.failureEn: Common misinterpretation: Valid transistor current curves for both tiers alone prove that the connected inverter has a correct transfer curve. Revisit assumptions and sampling for assess inverter transfer and add discriminating evidence.
steps.check: 交付「反相器轉移曲線」對照表：交出兩案例、固定條件、預期差異及一項可能混淆因素。
steps.checkEn: Submit the controlled comparison for assess inverter transfer: Submit both cases, fixed conditions, predicted difference and one confounder.

quiz.question: 評估「反相器轉移曲線」時，哪項敘述可以採用？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is valid when evaluating assess inverter transfer?

互補特性需由完整電路連接與轉移曲線驗證。
轉移曲線只要穿過輸入與輸出皆為 VDD/2 的點，就不必再檢查轉換斜率或雜訊容限。
optionsEn: Valid transistor current curves for both tiers alone prove that the connected inverter has a correct transfer curve.
Complementarity needs circuit connectivity and transfer-curve evidence.
A transfer curve crossing the point where input and output both equal VDD/2 needs no further slope or noise-margin assessment.
quiz.explanation: 互補特性需由完整電路連接與轉移曲線驗證。 研究測試車展示功能後，仍需更多樣本驗證變異、存活率與可靠度，才能建立製造成熟度證據。
quiz.explanationEn: Complementarity needs circuit connectivity and transfer-curve evidence. After functional test-vehicle demonstrations, further samples are needed for variability, survival and reliability evidence.

steps.instruction: 本步問題：自熱與交互加熱。選出本步的一項輸入及一項輸出；以自訂低、中、高三點畫趨勢；逐點標註假設，並寫出趨勢可能失效的條件。判讀依據：一層發熱可能改變另一層的電性。引用列出的原始資料；若使用數值，清楚標成自訂教學假設。
steps.instructionEn: Question for this step: Assess mutual heating. Select one input and output for this step; sketch a hypothetical low/mid/high trend; label assumptions and state when the trend may fail. Interpretation: Heating one tier can alter the other's electrical behavior. Cite the listed primary material; label any chosen numbers as hypothetical educational inputs.
steps.observation: 檢查結果是否能支持「一層發熱可能改變另一層的電性。」；若證據不足，標記尚未確定並寫出缺少的量測。
steps.observationEn: Check whether the evidence supports: Heating one tier can alter the other's electrical behavior. If insufficient, mark the conclusion unresolved and name the missing measurement.

steps.failureEn: Common misinterpretation: One middle-layer section represents every stacked layer. Revisit assumptions and sampling for assess mutual heating and add discriminating evidence.
steps.check: 交付「自熱與交互加熱」敏感度草圖：圖須有變數、單位或無因次定義、三個假設點及適用範圍。

steps.objectiveEn: Complete a fault-discrimination table for separate demonstration from production, connecting relevant limits in complementary tiers, middle isolation and tier contacts to observable evidence.
steps.instruction: 本步問題：研究展示與量產。假設本步預期結果未出現；提出兩個不同機制；為各機制選一個能支持或否定的觀察，避免只重複同一量測。判讀依據：單一功能測試車不等於量產良率證明。引用列出的原始資料；若使用數值，清楚標成自訂教學假設。
steps.instructionEn: Question for this step: Separate demonstration from production. Assume the expected result fails; propose two distinct mechanisms; choose an observation that supports or rejects each rather than repeating one measurement. Interpretation: A functional test vehicle is not evidence of production yield. Cite the listed primary material; label any chosen numbers as hypothetical educational inputs.

steps.checkEn: Submit the fault-discrimination table for separate demonstration from production: List two hypotheses, discriminating evidence for each and a check order.

steps.instructionEn: Question for this step: Compare research generations. Interpretation: Cross-study comparisons need matched geometry, bias and extraction definitions. Cite the listed primary material; label any chosen numbers as hypothetical educational inputs.

steps.objectiveEn: Complete a engineering acceptance sheet for assemble a cfet evidence map, connecting relevant limits in complementary tiers, middle isolation and tier contacts to observable evidence.
steps.instruction: 本步問題：CFET 證據地圖。整合本步及本階段先前證據；提出兩項彼此不同的接受條件；再列一個會讓你暫緩放行的結果及下一個確認動作。判讀依據：隔離、雙極性、接觸、電路與重現性需分層報告。引用列出的原始資料；若使用數值，清楚標成自訂教學假設。
steps.instructionEn: Question for this step: Assemble a CFET evidence map. Combine this step with earlier stage evidence; propose two independent acceptance criteria; name one hold condition and the next confirming action. Interpretation: Report isolation, both polarities, contacts, circuits and repeatability separately. Cite the listed primary material; label any chosen numbers as hypothetical educational inputs.
steps.observation: 檢查結果是否能支持「隔離、雙極性、接觸、電路與重現性需分層報告。」；若證據不足，標記尚未確定並寫出缺少的量測。
steps.observationEn: Check whether the evidence supports: Report isolation, both polarities, contacts, circuits and repeatability separately. If insufficient, mark the conclusion unresolved and name the missing measurement.
steps.failure: 常見錯判：單一中層截面可代表所有堆疊層。 應回到「CFET 證據地圖」的假設與採樣範圍，補足能區分機制的證據。
steps.failureEn: Common misinterpretation: One middle-layer section represents every stacked layer. Revisit assumptions and sampling for assemble a cfet evidence map and add discriminating evidence.
steps.check: 交付「CFET 證據地圖」工程驗收單：驗收單需有原理、兩項證據、保留疑問及前後模組交接。
steps.checkEn: Submit the engineering acceptance sheet for assemble a cfet evidence map: The sheet needs the principle, two evidence items, open questions and module handoff.

knowledge.text: 研究測試車展示功能後，仍需更多樣本驗證變異、存活率與可靠度，才能建立製造成熟度證據。
knowledge.textEn: After functional test-vehicle demonstrations, further samples are needed for variability, survival and reliability evidence.

quiz.question: 評估「CFET 證據地圖」時，哪項敘述可以採用？

options: 單一中層截面可代表所有堆疊層。

隔離、雙極性、接觸、電路與重現性需分層報告。

title: 埋入式電源軌整合
summary: 以 4 階段、24 個工程工作包拆解埋軌隔離、熱相容及壓降，完成圖解、對照、敏感度分析、故障判別、量測規劃與驗收。
summaryEn: Four stages and 24 work packages explore rail isolation, thermal compatibility and voltage drop through diagrams, comparisons, sensitivity studies, fault diagnosis, measurement plans and acceptance reviews.
scope: 依公開原理編寫的雙語概念實作課；每步交付可審查的工程證據。24 步是學習拆解，不代表晶圓廠的完整配方。自行設定的數值須標為假設。題目不含可直接操作的化學混配、設備設定或量產公差；照片與外部影片為代表媒體，不是假稱每步實拍。
scopeEn: Bilingual conceptual exercises based on public principles, with reviewable evidence at each step. The 24 steps are a learning decomposition, not a complete fab recipe. Chosen numerical inputs must be labeled hypothetical. No directly operable chemical mixtures, equipment settings or production tolerances are supplied. Photos and external videos are representative media, not claimed as recordings of every step.

stages.title: 電源路徑
stages.description: 在「電源路徑」建立六項互補證據，逐一檢查材料、幾何、物理機制與適用限制。
stages.descriptionEn: Build six complementary evidence items for power pathways, checking materials, geometry, mechanisms and validity limits.

steps.title: 電源與訊號分離
steps.objective: 完成「電源與訊號分離」的因果圖，把埋軌隔離、熱相容及壓降中的相關限制連到可觀察證據。
steps.objectiveEn: Complete a causal diagram for separate power and signals, connecting relevant limits in rail isolation, thermal compatibility and voltage drop to observable evidence.
steps.instruction: 本步問題：電源與訊號分離。畫一張含作用前後狀態的原創圖；以箭頭標出本步原理中的因果關係；圈出一項仍需量測的未知量。判讀依據：埋入式軌改變電源位置，訊號仍需獨立連通。引用列出的原始資料；若使用數值，清楚標成自訂教學假設。
steps.instructionEn: Question for this step: Separate power and signals. Draw an original before/after diagram; mark the causal relationship in this step; circle one quantity still requiring measurement. Interpretation: Buried rails relocate power while signals still need separate connectivity. Cite the listed primary material; label any chosen numbers as hypothetical educational inputs.
steps.observation: 檢查結果是否能支持「埋入式軌改變電源位置，訊號仍需獨立連通。」；若證據不足，標記尚未確定並寫出缺少的量測。
steps.observationEn: Check whether the evidence supports: Buried rails relocate power while signals still need separate connectivity. If insufficient, mark the conclusion unresolved and name the missing measurement.
steps.failure: 常見錯判：總電流合格就證明每個通道都完整。 應回到「電源與訊號分離」的假設與採樣範圍，補足能區分機制的證據。
steps.failureEn: Common misinterpretation: Acceptable total current proves every channel is intact. Revisit assumptions and sampling for separate power and signals and add discriminating evidence.
steps.check: 交付「電源與訊號分離」因果圖：圖中要有邊界、輸入、輸出與一項不能僅由圖決定的量。
steps.checkEn: Submit the causal diagram for separate power and signals: Show boundaries, inputs, outputs and one quantity that the diagram alone cannot determine.

knowledge.title: 電源與訊號分離的原理
knowledge.text: 埋入式軌改變電源位置，訊號仍需獨立連通。
knowledge.textEn: Buried rails relocate power while signals still need separate connectivity.

knowledge.title: 本階段的機制與工程權衡
knowledge.text: 埋入軌是一種局部供電結構；電源從正面或背面進入是另一個設計維度，需以完整回路判定。
knowledge.textEn: A buried rail is a local power structure; frontside or backside entry is a separate design dimension requiring a complete loop.

quiz.question: 評估「電源與訊號分離」時，哪項敘述可以採用？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is valid when evaluating separate power and signals?
options: 埋入式軌改變電源位置，訊號仍需獨立連通。
總電流合格就證明每個通道都完整。
頂面膜厚代表所有側壁與底部厚度。
optionsEn: Buried rails relocate power while signals still need separate connectivity.
Acceptable total current proves every channel is intact.
Top thickness represents all sidewall and bottom thicknesses.
quiz.explanation: 埋入式軌改變電源位置，訊號仍需獨立連通。 埋入軌是一種局部供電結構；電源從正面或背面進入是另一個設計維度，需以完整回路判定。
quiz.explanationEn: Buried rails relocate power while signals still need separate connectivity. A buried rail is a local power structure; frontside or backside entry is a separate design dimension requiring a complete loop.

steps.title: 正面與背面入口
steps.objective: 完成「正面與背面入口」的對照表，把埋軌隔離、熱相容及壓降中的相關限制連到可觀察證據。
steps.objectiveEn: Complete a controlled comparison for compare front and back access, connecting relevant limits in rail isolation, thermal compatibility and voltage drop to observable evidence.
steps.instruction: 本步問題：正面與背面入口。建立兩個只改一項條件的假想案例；分開記錄可觀察差異與推測原因；說明如何用本步原理區分兩者。判讀依據：有埋入軌不代表必然由背面供電。引用列出的原始資料；若使用數值，清楚標成自訂教學假設。
steps.instructionEn: Question for this step: Compare front and back access. Create two hypothetical cases differing in one condition; separate observations from proposed causes; use this step’s principle to distinguish them. Interpretation: Buried rails do not necessarily imply backside delivery. Cite the listed primary material; label any chosen numbers as hypothetical educational inputs.
steps.observation: 檢查結果是否能支持「有埋入軌不代表必然由背面供電。」；若證據不足，標記尚未確定並寫出缺少的量測。
steps.observationEn: Check whether the evidence supports: Buried rails do not necessarily imply backside delivery. If insufficient, mark the conclusion unresolved and name the missing measurement.
steps.failure: 常見錯判：總電流合格就證明每個通道都完整。 應回到「正面與背面入口」的假設與採樣範圍，補足能區分機制的證據。
steps.failureEn: Common misinterpretation: Acceptable total current proves every channel is intact. Revisit assumptions and sampling for compare front and back access and add discriminating evidence.
steps.check: 交付「正面與背面入口」對照表：交出兩案例、固定條件、預期差異及一項可能混淆因素。
steps.checkEn: Submit the controlled comparison for compare front and back access: Submit both cases, fixed conditions, predicted difference and one confounder.

steps.objective: 完成「電流回路」的敏感度草圖，把埋軌隔離、熱相容及壓降中的相關限制連到可觀察證據。
steps.objectiveEn: Complete a sensitivity sketch for trace the complete current loop, connecting relevant limits in rail isolation, thermal compatibility and voltage drop to observable evidence.
steps.instruction: 本步問題：電流回路。選出本步的一項輸入及一項輸出；以自訂低、中、高三點畫趨勢；逐點標註假設，並寫出趨勢可能失效的條件。判讀依據：VDD 與回流路徑都貢獻元件壓降。引用列出的原始資料；若使用數值，清楚標成自訂教學假設。
steps.instructionEn: Question for this step: Trace the complete current loop. Select one input and output for this step; sketch a hypothetical low/mid/high trend; label assumptions and state when the trend may fail. Interpretation: Both supply and return contribute to device voltage drop. Cite the listed primary material; label any chosen numbers as hypothetical educational inputs.
steps.observation: 檢查結果是否能支持「VDD 與回流路徑都貢獻元件壓降。」；若證據不足，標記尚未確定並寫出缺少的量測。
steps.observationEn: Check whether the evidence supports: Both supply and return contribute to device voltage drop. If insufficient, mark the conclusion unresolved and name the missing measurement.
steps.failure: 常見錯判：總電流合格就證明每個通道都完整。 應回到「電流回路」的假設與採樣範圍，補足能區分機制的證據。
steps.failureEn: Common misinterpretation: Acceptable total current proves every channel is intact. Revisit assumptions and sampling for trace the complete current loop and add discriminating evidence.
steps.check: 交付「電流回路」敏感度草圖：圖須有變數、單位或無因次定義、三個假設點及適用範圍。
steps.checkEn: Submit the sensitivity sketch for trace the complete current loop: Include variables, units or dimensionless definitions, three hypothetical points and validity limits.

steps.objectiveEn: Complete a fault-discrimination table for budget cell tracks, connecting relevant limits in rail isolation, thermal compatibility and voltage drop to observable evidence.
steps.instruction: 本步問題：標準元件軌道。假設本步預期結果未出現；提出兩個不同機制；為各機制選一個能支持或否定的觀察，避免只重複同一量測。判讀依據：釋出的配線軌道需經實際佈線才能確認收益。引用列出的原始資料；若使用數值，清楚標成自訂教學假設。
steps.instructionEn: Question for this step: Budget cell tracks. Assume the expected result fails; propose two distinct mechanisms; choose an observation that supports or rejects each rather than repeating one measurement. Interpretation: Released tracks need routing verification to establish benefits. Cite the listed primary material; label any chosen numbers as hypothetical educational inputs.
steps.observation: 檢查結果是否能支持「釋出的配線軌道需經實際佈線才能確認收益。」；若證據不足，標記尚未確定並寫出缺少的量測。

steps.checkEn: Submit the fault-discrimination table for budget cell tracks: List two hypotheses, discriminating evidence for each and a check order.

quiz.question: 評估「隔離溝槽」時，哪項敘述可以採用？

steps.title: 軌接觸落點

steps.instructionEn: Question for this step: Place rail contacts. Draw an original before/after diagram; mark the causal relationship in this step; circle one quantity still requiring measurement. steps.check: 交付「軌接觸落點」因果圖：圖中要有邊界、輸入、輸出與一項不能僅由圖決定的量。

title: 次二奈米邏輯製程研究
summary: 以 4 階段、24 個工程工作包拆解比較基準、架構權衡及證據成熟度，完成圖解、對照、敏感度分析、故障判別、量測規劃與驗收。
summaryEn: Four stages and 24 work packages explore comparison baselines, architecture tradeoffs and evidence maturity through diagrams, comparisons, sensitivity studies, fault diagnosis, measurement plans and acceptance reviews.
scope: 依公開原理編寫的雙語概念實作課；每步交付可審查的工程證據。24 步是學習拆解，不代表晶圓廠的完整配方。自行設定的數值須標為假設。題目不含可直接操作的化學混配、設備設定或量產公差；照片與外部影片為代表媒體，不是假稱每步實拍。
scopeEn: Bilingual conceptual exercises based on public principles, with reviewable evidence at each step. The 24 steps are a learning decomposition, not a complete fab recipe. Chosen numerical inputs must be labeled hypothetical. No directly operable chemical mixtures, equipment settings or production tolerances are supplied. Photos and external videos are representative media, not claimed as recordings of every step.

title: 奈米片內側間隔層製作
summary: 以 4 階段、24 個工程工作包拆解側向凹蝕、低介電填充及釋放保護，完成圖解、對照、敏感度分析、故障判別、量測規劃與驗收。
summaryEn: Four stages and 24 work packages explore lateral recess, low-k fill and release protection through diagrams, comparisons, sensitivity studies, fault diagnosis, measurement plans and acceptance reviews.
scope: 依公開原理編寫的雙語概念實作課；每步交付可審查的工程證據。24 步是學習拆解，不代表晶圓廠的完整配方。自行設定的數值須標為假設。題目不含可直接操作的化學混配、設備設定或量產公差；照片與外部影片為代表媒體，不是假稱每步實拍。
scopeEn: Bilingual conceptual exercises based on public principles, with reviewable evidence at each step. The 24 steps are a learning decomposition, not a complete fab recipe. Chosen numerical inputs must be labeled hypothetical. No directly operable chemical mixtures, equipment settings or production tolerances are supplied. Photos and external videos are representative media, not claimed as recordings of every step.

Draw an original before/after diagram; mark the causal relationship in this step; circle one quantity still requiring measurement. title: 源汲極接觸電阻控制
summary: 以 4 階段、24 個工程工作包拆解活化、界面及比接觸電阻抽取，完成圖解、對照、敏感度分析、故障判別、量測規劃與驗收。
summaryEn: Four stages and 24 work packages explore activation, interfaces and specific contact-resistivity extraction through diagrams, comparisons, sensitivity studies, fault diagnosis, measurement plans and acceptance reviews.
scope: 依公開原理編寫的雙語概念實作課；每步交付可審查的工程證據。24 步是學習拆解，不代表晶圓廠的完整配方。自行設定的數值須標為假設。題目不含可直接操作的化學混配、設備設定或量產公差；照片與外部影片為代表媒體，不是假稱每步實拍。
scopeEn: Bilingual conceptual exercises based on public principles, with reviewable evidence at each step. The 24 steps are a learning decomposition, not a complete fab recipe. Chosen numerical inputs must be labeled hypothetical. No directly operable chemical mixtures, equipment settings or production tolerances are supplied. Photos and external videos are representative media, not claimed as recordings of every step.

stages.title: 電阻分解
stages.description: 在「電阻分解」建立六項互補證據，逐一檢查材料、幾何、物理機制與適用限制。
stages.descriptionEn: Build six complementary evidence items for resistance decomposition, checking materials, geometry, mechanisms and validity limits.

steps.title: 電阻與比接觸電阻

steps.objectiveEn: Complete a causal diagram for separate resistance and resistivity, connecting relevant limits in activation, interfaces and specific contact-resistivity extraction to observable evidence.
steps.instruction: 本步問題：電阻與比接觸電阻。畫一張含作用前後狀態的原創圖；以箭頭標出本步原理中的因果關係；圈出一項仍需量測的未知量。判讀依據：接觸電阻與比接觸電阻的單位不同。引用列出的原始資料；若使用數值，清楚標成自訂教學假設。
steps.instructionEn: Question for this step: Separate resistance and resistivity. Draw an original before/after diagram; mark the causal relationship in this step; circle one quantity still requiring measurement. Interpretation: Contact resistance and specific contact resistivity have different units. Cite the listed primary material; label any chosen numbers as hypothetical educational inputs.
steps.observation: 檢查結果是否能支持「接觸電阻與比接觸電阻的單位不同。」；若證據不足，標記尚未確定並寫出缺少的量測。
steps.observationEn: Check whether the evidence supports: Contact resistance and specific contact resistivity have different units. If insufficient, mark the conclusion unresolved and name the missing measurement.
steps.failure: 常見錯判：沉積循環數總能從第一循環精確線性外推。 應回到「電阻與比接觸電阻」的假設與採樣範圍，補足能區分機制的證據。
steps.failureEn: Common misinterpretation: Thickness always extrapolates linearly from the first cycle. Revisit assumptions and sampling for separate resistance and resistivity and add discriminating evidence.
steps.check: 交付「電阻與比接觸電阻」因果圖：圖中要有邊界、輸入、輸出與一項不能僅由圖決定的量。

knowledge.text: 接觸電流可集中在入口附近，傳輸長度將片電阻與界面電阻相連，幾何面積不一定全都有效。

steps.instructionEn: Question for this step: Separate channel and access paths. Create two hypothetical cases differing in one condition; separate observations from proposed causes; use this step’s principle to distinguish them. Interpretation: Total resistance includes channel, source-drain, interfaces and metal. Cite the listed primary material; label any chosen numbers as hypothetical educational inputs.

steps.title: TLM 長度陣列

steps.instruction: 本步問題：TLM 長度陣列。畫一張含作用前後狀態的原創圖；以箭頭標出本步原理中的因果關係；圈出一項仍需量測的未知量。判讀依據：不同間距的電阻斜率與截距提供不同資訊。引用列出的原始資料；若使用數值，清楚標成自訂教學假設。 自訂長接觸 TLM：總電阻對間距的直線截距為 20 Ω。於兩接觸相同且寄生已去除假設下，求單接觸電阻；說明未有寬度與片電阻時不能直接得到比接觸電阻。
steps.instructionEn: Question for this step: Lay out a TLM array. Draw an original before/after diagram; mark the causal relationship in this step; circle one quantity still requiring measurement. Interpretation: Resistance slope and intercept across spacings provide different information. Cite the listed primary material; label any chosen numbers as hypothetical educational inputs. Hypothetical long-contact TLM: resistance-versus-spacing intercept is 20 Ω. With equal contacts and removed parasitics, find one contact resistance; explain why width and sheet resistance are still needed for specific contact resistivity.
steps.observation: 檢查結果是否能支持「不同間距的電阻斜率與截距提供不同資訊。」；若證據不足，標記尚未確定並寫出缺少的量測。
steps.observationEn: Check whether the evidence supports: Resistance slope and intercept across spacings provide different information. If insufficient, mark the conclusion unresolved and name the missing measurement.
steps.failure: 常見錯判：高介電常數保證沒有漏電及陷阱。 應回到「TLM 長度陣列」的假設與採樣範圍，補足能區分機制的證據。
steps.failureEn: Common misinterpretation: High permittivity guarantees no leakage or traps. Revisit assumptions and sampling for lay out a tlm array and add discriminating evidence.
steps.check: 交付「TLM 長度陣列」因果圖：圖中要有邊界、輸入、輸出與一項不能僅由圖決定的量。 同時交付算例的中間步驟或比較圖，並標示假設與模型限制。
steps.checkEn: Submit the causal diagram for lay out a tlm array: Show boundaries, inputs, outputs and one quantity that the diagram alone cannot determine. Also submit intermediate calculations or comparison diagrams with assumptions and model limits.

quiz.explanationEn: Initially low resistance cannot replace long-term stability checks. Distribution tails matter differently; median, spread and failure fraction characterize a lot better than its minimum resistance alone.

Define the measurand and sampling locations; list resolution, background and repeatability; design a witness or blank and explain detection-limit constraints. Interpretation: Separate contact changes from channel-mobility changes. Cite the listed primary material; label any chosen numbers as hypothetical educational inputs.

steps.check: 交付「元件效能歸因」量測規劃：提供採樣座標、量測單位、對照與不確定度來源。

steps.instruction: 本步問題：接觸改善報告。整合本步及本階段先前證據；提出兩項彼此不同的接受條件；再列一個會讓你暫緩放行的結果及下一個確認動作。判讀依據：方法、幾何、活化、分布及可靠度都需可追溯。引用列出的原始資料；若使用數值，清楚標成自訂教學假設。
steps.instructionEn: Question for this step: Report contact improvement. Combine this step with earlier stage evidence; propose two independent acceptance criteria; name one hold condition and the next confirming action. Interpretation: Method, geometry, activation, distributions and reliability must be traceable. Cite the listed primary material; label any chosen numbers as hypothetical educational inputs.

title: 自我對準接觸孔製程
summary: 以 4 階段、24 個工程工作包拆解套刻容忍、間隔保護及接觸導通，完成圖解、對照、敏感度分析、故障判別、量測規劃與驗收。
summaryEn: Four stages and 24 work packages explore overlay tolerance, spacer protection and contact continuity through diagrams, comparisons, sensitivity studies, fault diagnosis, measurement plans and acceptance reviews.
scope: 依公開原理編寫的雙語概念實作課；每步交付可審查的工程證據。24 步是學習拆解，不代表晶圓廠的完整配方。自行設定的數值須標為假設。題目不含可直接操作的化學混配、設備設定或量產公差；照片與外部影片為代表媒體，不是假稱每步實拍。
scopeEn: Bilingual conceptual exercises based on public principles, with reviewable evidence at each step. The 24 steps are a learning decomposition, not a complete fab recipe. Chosen numerical inputs must be labeled hypothetical. No directly operable chemical mixtures, equipment settings or production tolerances are supplied. Photos and external videos are representative media, not claimed as recordings of every step.

stages.title: 接觸與套刻
stages.description: 在「接觸與套刻」建立六項互補證據，逐一檢查材料、幾何、物理機制與適用限制。
stages.descriptionEn: Build six complementary evidence items for contacts and overlay, checking materials, geometry, mechanisms and validity limits.

steps.title: 自對準的含義
steps.objective: 完成「自對準的含義」的因果圖，把套刻容忍、間隔保護及接觸導通中的相關限制連到可觀察證據。
steps.objectiveEn: Complete a causal diagram for define self-alignment, connecting relevant limits in overlay tolerance, spacer protection and contact continuity to observable evidence.
steps.instruction: 本步問題：自對準的含義。畫一張含作用前後狀態的原創圖；以箭頭標出本步原理中的因果關係；圈出一項仍需量測的未知量。判讀依據：自對準利用材料或結構邊界而非完全取消套刻。引用列出的原始資料；若使用數值，清楚標成自訂教學假設。
steps.instructionEn: Question for this step: Define self-alignment. Draw an original before/after diagram; mark the causal relationship in this step; circle one quantity still requiring measurement. Interpretation: Self-alignment uses material or structural boundaries rather than eliminating overlay. Cite the listed primary material; label any chosen numbers as hypothetical educational inputs.
steps.observation: 檢查結果是否能支持「自對準利用材料或結構邊界而非完全取消套刻。」；若證據不足，標記尚未確定並寫出缺少的量測。
steps.observationEn: Check whether the evidence supports: Self-alignment uses material or structural boundaries rather than eliminating overlay. If insufficient, mark the conclusion unresolved and name the missing measurement.
steps.failure: 常見錯判：沉積循環數總能從第一循環精確線性外推。 應回到「自對準的含義」的假設與採樣範圍，補足能區分機制的證據。
steps.failureEn: Common misinterpretation: Thickness always extrapolates linearly from the first cycle. Revisit assumptions and sampling for define self-alignment and add discriminating evidence.
steps.check: 交付「自對準的含義」因果圖：圖中要有邊界、輸入、輸出與一項不能僅由圖決定的量。
steps.checkEn: Submit the causal diagram for define self-alignment: Show boundaries, inputs, outputs and one quantity that the diagram alone cannot determine.

knowledge.title: 自對準的含義的原理
knowledge.text: 自對準利用材料或結構邊界而非完全取消套刻。
knowledge.textEn: Self-alignment uses material or structural boundaries rather than eliminating overlay.

knowledge.title: 本階段的機制與工程權衡
knowledge.text: 自對準保護來自材料選擇性及結構重疊，套刻偏移仍可能縮小落點或增加角落暴露。
knowledge.textEn: Self-alignment relies on material selectivity and overlap; overlay shifts can still reduce landing area or expose corners.

quiz.question: 評估「自對準的含義」時，哪項敘述可以採用？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is valid when evaluating define self-alignment?
options: 自對準利用材料或結構邊界而非完全取消套刻。
沉積循環數總能從第一循環精確線性外推。
厚度相同就代表介面電性相同。
optionsEn: Self-alignment uses material or structural boundaries rather than eliminating overlay.
Thickness always extrapolates linearly from the first cycle.
Equal thickness implies equal interface electrical quality.
quiz.explanation: 自對準利用材料或結構邊界而非完全取消套刻。 自對準保護來自材料選擇性及結構重疊，套刻偏移仍可能縮小落點或增加角落暴露。
quiz.explanationEn: Self-alignment uses material or structural boundaries rather than eliminating overlay. Self-alignment relies on material selectivity and overlap; overlay shifts can still reduce landing area or expose corners.

steps.instruction: 本步問題：接觸目標區。建立兩個只改一項條件的假想案例；分開記錄可觀察差異與推測原因；說明如何用本步原理區分兩者。判讀依據：接觸需連到源汲極且避開閘金屬。引用列出的原始資料；若使用數值，清楚標成自訂教學假設。
steps.instructionEn: Question for this step: Mark contact targets. Create two hypothetical cases differing in one condition; separate observations from proposed causes; use this step’s principle to distinguish them. Interpretation: Contacts must reach source-drain while avoiding gate metal. Cite the listed primary material; label any chosen numbers as hypothetical educational inputs.

steps.check: 交付「接觸目標區」對照表：交出兩案例、固定條件、預期差異及一項可能混淆因素。
steps.checkEn: Submit the controlled comparison for mark contact targets: Submit both cases, fixed conditions, predicted difference and one confounder.

steps.title: 閘帽與間隔層

steps.objectiveEn: Complete a sensitivity sketch for assign caps and spacers, connecting relevant limits in overlay tolerance, spacer protection and contact continuity to observable evidence.
steps.instruction: 本步問題：閘帽與間隔層。選出本步的一項輸入及一項輸出；以自訂低、中、高三點畫趨勢；逐點標註假設，並寫出趨勢可能失效的條件。判讀依據：閘帽與間隔層共同提供蝕刻保護。引用列出的原始資料；若使用數值，清楚標成自訂教學假設。
steps.instructionEn: Question for this step: Assign caps and spacers. Select one input and output for this step; sketch a hypothetical low/mid/high trend; label assumptions and state when the trend may fail. Interpretation: Gate caps and spacers jointly provide etch protection. Cite the listed primary material; label any chosen numbers as hypothetical educational inputs.
steps.observation: 檢查結果是否能支持「閘帽與間隔層共同提供蝕刻保護。」；若證據不足，標記尚未確定並寫出缺少的量測。

steps.check: 交付「閘帽與間隔層」敏感度草圖：圖須有變數、單位或無因次定義、三個假設點及適用範圍。
steps.checkEn: Submit the sensitivity sketch for assign caps and spacers: Include variables, units or dimensionless definitions, three hypothetical points and validity limits.

steps.title: 套刻容忍圖

steps.objectiveEn: Complete a fault-discrimination table for draw overlay-tolerance maps, connecting relevant limits in overlay tolerance, spacer protection and contact continuity to observable evidence.
steps.instruction: 本步問題：套刻容忍圖。假設本步預期結果未出現；提出兩個不同機制；為各機制選一個能支持或否定的觀察，避免只重複同一量測。判讀依據：幾何容忍需同時計入孔寬與保護層剩餘量。引用列出的原始資料；若使用數值，清楚標成自訂教學假設。 自訂一維落點：目標區寬 40、孔寬 20 單位；先求完全落入的中心偏移上限，再討論為何選擇性保護只能改變部分失效邊界。
steps.instructionEn: Question for this step: Draw overlay-tolerance maps. Assume the expected result fails; propose two distinct mechanisms; choose an observation that supports or rejects each rather than repeating one measurement. Interpretation: Tolerance includes opening width and remaining protective material. Cite the listed primary material; label any chosen numbers as hypothetical educational inputs. Hypothetical 1D landing: target width 40 and opening width 20 units. Find the center-offset limit for full landing, then explain why selective protection changes only some failure boundaries.
steps.observation: 檢查結果是否能支持「幾何容忍需同時計入孔寬與保護層剩餘量。」；若證據不足，標記尚未確定並寫出缺少的量測。

steps.checkEn: Submit the fault-discrimination table for draw overlay-tolerance maps: List two hypotheses, discriminating evidence for each and a check order. Also submit intermediate calculations or comparison diagrams with assumptions and model limits.

steps.instruction: 本步問題：阻障完整性。整合本步及本階段先前證據；提出兩項彼此不同的接受條件；再列一個會讓你暫緩放行的結果及下一個確認動作。判讀依據：低電阻填充仍需防止材料向鄰近區擴散。引用列出的原始資料；若使用數值，清楚標成自訂教學假設。
steps.instructionEn: Question for this step: Assess barrier continuity. Combine this step with earlier stage evidence; propose two independent acceptance criteria; name one hold condition and the next confirming action. Interpretation: Low-resistance fill still needs diffusion containment. Cite the listed primary material; label any chosen numbers as hypothetical educational inputs.
steps.observation: 檢查結果是否能支持「低電阻填充仍需防止材料向鄰近區擴散。」；若證據不足，標記尚未確定並寫出缺少的量測。
steps.observationEn: Check whether the evidence supports: Low-resistance fill still needs diffusion containment. If insufficient, mark the conclusion unresolved and name the missing measurement.
steps.failure: 常見錯判：高介電常數保證沒有漏電及陷阱。 應回到「阻障完整性」的假設與採樣範圍，補足能區分機制的證據。
steps.failureEn: Common misinterpretation: High permittivity guarantees no leakage or traps. Revisit assumptions and sampling for assess barrier continuity and add discriminating evidence.
steps.check: 交付「阻障完整性」工程驗收單：驗收單需有原理、兩項證據、保留疑問及前後模組交接。
steps.checkEn: Submit the engineering acceptance sheet for assess barrier continuity: The sheet needs the principle, two evidence items, open questions and module handoff.

knowledge.title: 阻障完整性的原理
knowledge.text: 低電阻填充仍需防止材料向鄰近區擴散。
knowledge.textEn: Low-resistance fill still needs diffusion containment.

knowledge.title: 本階段的機制與工程權衡
knowledge.text: 接觸襯層可保護界面卻消耗導體截面，填充完成後仍需檢查空洞與實際連通面積。
knowledge.textEn: Contact liners protect interfaces but consume conductor area; inspect voids and actual connected area after filling.

quiz.question: 評估「阻障完整性」時，哪項敘述可以採用？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is valid when evaluating assess barrier continuity?
options: 高介電常數保證沒有漏電及陷阱。
去除上層材料不需檢查下層損失。
低電阻填充仍需防止材料向鄰近區擴散。
optionsEn: High permittivity guarantees no leakage or traps.
Removing an upper layer needs no lower-layer loss check.
Low-resistance fill still needs diffusion containment.

steps.title: 開路與高阻

steps.instruction: 本步問題：開路與高阻。畫一張含作用前後狀態的原創圖；以箭頭標出本步原理中的因果關係；圈出一項仍需量測的未知量。判讀依據：完全開路與部分接觸不良需要不同診斷。引用列出的原始資料；若使用數值，清楚標成自訂教學假設。
steps.instructionEn: Question for this step: Separate opens and high resistance. steps.failureEn: Common misinterpretation: Low bulk resistivity guarantees low interface contact resistance. Revisit assumptions and sampling for separate opens and high resistance and add discriminating evidence.
steps.check: 交付「開路與高阻」因果圖：圖中要有邊界、輸入、輸出與一項不能僅由圖決定的量。
steps.checkEn: Submit the causal diagram for separate opens and high resistance: Show boundaries, inputs, outputs and one quantity that the diagram alone cannot determine.

knowledge.title: 本階段的機制與工程權衡
knowledge.text: 導通、閘隔離及鄰孔隔離是不同電路條件；一種接觸鏈測試不能取代所有漏電與短路檢查。
knowledge.textEn: Continuity, gate isolation and neighbor isolation are different conditions; one chain test cannot replace all leakage and short checks.

Create two hypothetical cases differing in one condition; separate observations from proposed causes; use this step’s principle to distinguish them. steps.checkEn: Submit the controlled comparison for test gate-contact shorts: Submit both cases, fixed conditions, predicted difference and one confounder.

Assume the expected result fails; propose two distinct mechanisms; choose an observation that supports or rejects each rather than repeating one measurement. knowledge.text: 導通、隔離、填充及套刻裕度必須一起驗證。

knowledge.text: 導通、閘隔離及鄰孔隔離是不同電路條件；一種接觸鏈測試不能取代所有漏電與短路檢查。

title: 深紫外光阻塗佈
summary: 以 4 階段、24 個工程工作包拆解塗佈流動、邊珠、膜厚與缺陷，完成圖解、對照、敏感度分析、故障判別、量測規劃與驗收。
summaryEn: Four stages and 24 work packages explore coating flow, edge bead, thickness and defects through diagrams, comparisons, sensitivity studies, fault diagnosis, measurement plans and acceptance reviews.
scope: 依公開原理編寫的雙語概念實作課；每步交付可審查的工程證據。24 步是學習拆解，不代表晶圓廠的完整配方。自行設定的數值須標為假設。題目不含可直接操作的化學混配、設備設定或量產公差；照片與外部影片為代表媒體，不是假稱每步實拍。
scopeEn: Bilingual conceptual exercises based on public principles, with reviewable evidence at each step. The 24 steps are a learning decomposition, not a complete fab recipe. Chosen numerical inputs must be labeled hypothetical. No directly operable chemical mixtures, equipment settings or production tolerances are supplied. Photos and external videos are representative media, not claimed as recordings of every step.

stages.title: 光阻與基板

stages.descriptionEn: Build six complementary evidence items for resist and substrate, checking materials, geometry, mechanisms and validity limits.

steps.title: 曝光波長匹配

steps.instructionEn: Question for this step: Match exposure wavelength. Draw an original before/after diagram; mark the causal relationship in this step; circle one quantity still requiring measurement. Interpretation: DUV resist selection needs wavelength-specific data, not appearance. Cite the listed primary material; label any chosen numbers as hypothetical educational inputs.

steps.observationEn: Check whether the evidence supports: DUV resist selection needs wavelength-specific data, not appearance. If insufficient, mark the conclusion unresolved and name the missing measurement.
steps.failure: 常見錯判：相同最終轉速一定得到相同膜厚分布。 應回到「曝光波長匹配」的假設與採樣範圍，補足能區分機制的證據。
steps.failureEn: Common misinterpretation: Equal final spin speed always gives equal thickness maps. Revisit assumptions and sampling for match exposure wavelength and add discriminating evidence.
steps.check: 交付「曝光波長匹配」因果圖：圖中要有邊界、輸入、輸出與一項不能僅由圖決定的量。
steps.checkEn: Submit the causal diagram for match exposure wavelength: Show boundaries, inputs, outputs and one quantity that the diagram alone cannot determine.

knowledge.title: 本階段的機制與工程權衡
knowledge.text: 旋塗的流動受黏度、離心效應與溶劑揮發共同影響，材料換批後應重新確認曲線而非只沿用轉速。
knowledge.textEn: Spin flow depends on viscosity, centrifugal effects and evaporation; a material-lot change requires curve verification beyond reusing speed.

Equal final spin speed always gives equal thickness maps.
Softbake and PEB are the same chemical step.

steps.instruction: 本步問題：旋轉與膜厚。假設本步預期結果未出現；提出兩個不同機制；為各機制選一個能支持或否定的觀察，避免只重複同一量測。判讀依據：經驗膜厚關係僅在指定材料與範圍內適用。引用列出的原始資料；若使用數值，清楚標成自訂教學假設。 僅作經驗模型練習：假設 h∝ω^-1/2；把轉速加倍，求相對膜厚，再列黏度、揮發及加速度改變時必須重新校準的原因。
steps.instructionEn: Question for this step: Analyze spin-thickness trends. Interpretation: Empirical spin-thickness relations apply only within specified materials and ranges. Cite the listed primary material; label any chosen numbers as hypothetical educational inputs. steps.observation: 檢查結果是否能支持「經驗膜厚關係僅在指定材料與範圍內適用。」；若證據不足，標記尚未確定並寫出缺少的量測。

knowledge.text: 邊緣厚膜會影響後續接觸、污染及曝光可用區。
knowledge.textEn: Edge beads affect downstream contact, contamination and usable exposure area.

knowledge.title: 本階段的機制與工程權衡
knowledge.text: 液膜在鋪展與乾燥間轉換，前段加速度及排風因此可能改變最終厚度，即使終轉速不變。
knowledge.textEn: The film transitions from spreading to drying, so acceleration and exhaust can alter final thickness even at fixed final speed.

quiz.question: 評估「邊珠形成」時，哪項敘述可以採用？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is valid when evaluating inspect edge-bead formation?
options: 曝光劑量相同就能排除所有尺寸差。
頂視開口就證明孔底完全沒有殘膠。
邊緣厚膜會影響後續接觸、污染及曝光可用區。
optionsEn: Equal dose rules out every dimensional difference.
A top-view opening proves no bottom scum.
Edge beads affect downstream contact, contamination and usable exposure area.
quiz.explanation: 邊緣厚膜會影響後續接觸、污染及曝光可用區。 液膜在鋪展與乾燥間轉換，前段加速度及排風因此可能改變最終厚度，即使終轉速不變。
quiz.explanationEn: Edge beads affect downstream contact, contamination and usable exposure area. The film transitions from spreading to drying, so acceleration and exhaust can alter final thickness even at fixed final speed.

stages.title: 缺陷及膜厚
stages.description: 在「缺陷及膜厚」建立六項互補證據，逐一檢查材料、幾何、物理機制與適用限制。
stages.descriptionEn: Build six complementary evidence items for defects and thickness, checking materials, geometry, mechanisms and validity limits.

steps.title: 邊珠去除
steps.objective: 完成「邊珠去除」的因果圖，把塗佈流動、邊珠、膜厚與缺陷中的相關限制連到可觀察證據。
steps.objectiveEn: Complete a causal diagram for define edge-bead removal evidence, connecting relevant limits in coating flow, edge bead, thickness and defects to observable evidence.
steps.instruction: 本步問題：邊珠去除。畫一張含作用前後狀態的原創圖；以箭頭標出本步原理中的因果關係；圈出一項仍需量測的未知量。判讀依據：去除寬度需兼顧邊緣潔淨與有效面積。引用列出的原始資料；若使用數值，清楚標成自訂教學假設。
steps.instructionEn: Question for this step: Define edge-bead removal evidence. Draw an original before/after diagram; mark the causal relationship in this step; circle one quantity still requiring measurement. Interpretation: Removal width balances edge cleanliness and usable area. Cite the listed primary material; label any chosen numbers as hypothetical educational inputs.
steps.observation: 檢查結果是否能支持「去除寬度需兼顧邊緣潔淨與有效面積。」；若證據不足，標記尚未確定並寫出缺少的量測。
steps.observationEn: Check whether the evidence supports: Removal width balances edge cleanliness and usable area. If insufficient, mark the conclusion unresolved and name the missing measurement.
steps.failure: 常見錯判：較低劑量必定同時改善解析度與粗糙度。 應回到「邊珠去除」的假設與採樣範圍，補足能區分機制的證據。
steps.failureEn: Common misinterpretation: Lower dose must improve resolution and roughness together. Revisit assumptions and sampling for define edge-bead removal evidence and add discriminating evidence.
steps.check: 交付「邊珠去除」因果圖：圖中要有邊界、輸入、輸出與一項不能僅由圖決定的量。
steps.checkEn: Submit the causal diagram for define edge-bead removal evidence: Show boundaries, inputs, outputs and one quantity that the diagram alone cannot determine.

knowledge.title: 邊珠去除的原理
knowledge.text: 去除寬度需兼顧邊緣潔淨與有效面積。
knowledge.textEn: Removal width balances edge cleanliness and usable area.

knowledge.title: 本階段的機制與工程權衡
knowledge.text: 邊珠、背面殘留與氣泡具有不同空間形態，缺陷分類應保留位置而不只計算總數。
knowledge.textEn: Edge beads, backside residues and bubbles have different spatial signatures; retain locations rather than only total defect counts.

quiz.question: 評估「邊珠去除」時，哪項敘述可以採用？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is valid when evaluating define edge-bead removal evidence?
options: 去除寬度需兼顧邊緣潔淨與有效面積。
較低劑量必定同時改善解析度與粗糙度。
平均線寬合格即可忽略橋接與缺孔。
optionsEn: Removal width balances edge cleanliness and usable area.
Lower dose must improve resolution and roughness together.
Acceptable mean width permits ignoring bridges and missing holes.
quiz.explanation: 去除寬度需兼顧邊緣潔淨與有效面積。 邊珠、背面殘留與氣泡具有不同空間形態，缺陷分類應保留位置而不只計算總數。
quiz.explanationEn: Removal width balances edge cleanliness and usable area. Edge beads, backside residues and bubbles have different spatial signatures; retain locations rather than only total defect counts.

steps.instructionEn: Question for this step: Inspect backside contamination. Create two hypothetical cases differing in one condition; separate observations from proposed causes; use this step’s principle to distinguish them. Interpretation: Backside resist can transfer to chucks and later wafers. Cite the listed primary material; label any chosen numbers as hypothetical educational inputs.
steps.observation: 檢查結果是否能支持「背面光阻可轉移到吸盤與後續晶圓。」；若證據不足，標記尚未確定並寫出缺少的量測。
steps.observationEn: Check whether the evidence supports: Backside resist can transfer to chucks and later wafers. If insufficient, mark the conclusion unresolved and name the missing measurement.
steps.failure: 常見錯判：較低劑量必定同時改善解析度與粗糙度。 應回到「背面污染」的假設與採樣範圍，補足能區分機制的證據。
steps.failureEn: Common misinterpretation: Lower dose must improve resolution and roughness together. Revisit assumptions and sampling for inspect backside contamination and add discriminating evidence.
steps.check: 交付「背面污染」對照表：交出兩案例、固定條件、預期差異及一項可能混淆因素。
steps.checkEn: Submit the controlled comparison for inspect backside contamination: Submit both cases, fixed conditions, predicted difference and one confounder.

steps.instruction: 本步問題：氣泡缺陷。選出本步的一項輸入及一項輸出；以自訂低、中、高三點畫趨勢；逐點標註假設，並寫出趨勢可能失效的條件。判讀依據：氣泡與固體粒子需分開建立缺陷類別。引用列出的原始資料；若使用數值，清楚標成自訂教學假設。
steps.instructionEn: Question for this step: Identify bubbles. Select one input and output for this step; sketch a hypothetical low/mid/high trend; label assumptions and state when the trend may fail. Interpretation: Bubbles and solid particles require separate defect classes. Cite the listed primary material; label any chosen numbers as hypothetical educational inputs.
steps.observation: 檢查結果是否能支持「氣泡與固體粒子需分開建立缺陷類別。」；若證據不足，標記尚未確定並寫出缺少的量測。

steps.check: 交付「氣泡缺陷」敏感度草圖：圖須有變數、單位或無因次定義、三個假設點及適用範圍。
steps.checkEn: Submit the sensitivity sketch for identify bubbles: Include variables, units or dimensionless definitions, three hypothetical points and validity limits.

steps.objectiveEn: Complete a fault-discrimination table for interpret radial striations, connecting relevant limits in coating flow, edge bead, thickness and defects to observable evidence.
steps.instruction: 本步問題：放射條紋。假設本步預期結果未出現；提出兩個不同機制；為各機制選一個能支持或否定的觀察，避免只重複同一量測。判讀依據：條紋應與旋轉、氣流及乾燥條件對照。引用列出的原始資料；若使用數值，清楚標成自訂教學假設。
steps.instructionEn: Question for this step: Interpret radial striations. Assume the expected result fails; propose two distinct mechanisms; choose an observation that supports or rejects each rather than repeating one measurement. Interpretation: Striations should be compared with rotation, airflow and drying conditions. Cite the listed primary material; label any chosen numbers as hypothetical educational inputs.
steps.observation: 檢查結果是否能支持「條紋應與旋轉、氣流及乾燥條件對照。」；若證據不足，標記尚未確定並寫出缺少的量測。

steps.check: 交付「放射條紋」故障判別表：至少列出兩個假說、各自的辨別證據及先檢查順序。
steps.checkEn: Submit the fault-discrimination table for interpret radial striations: List two hypotheses, discriminating evidence for each and a check order.

steps.instruction: 本步問題：台階覆蓋。針對本步定義待測量及採樣位置；列出解析度、背景與重複性；設計一個見證或空白，並說明檢出限如何限制結論。判讀依據：平面均勻膜不保證台階角落也有足夠厚度。引用列出的原始資料；若使用數值，清楚標成自訂教學假設。
steps.instructionEn: Question for this step: Assess topographic coverage. Define the measurand and sampling locations; list resolution, background and repeatability; design a witness or blank and explain detection-limit constraints. Interpretation: Uniform planar films do not guarantee sufficient corner coverage. Cite the listed primary material; label any chosen numbers as hypothetical educational inputs.
steps.observation: 檢查結果是否能支持「平面均勻膜不保證台階角落也有足夠厚度。」；若證據不足，標記尚未確定並寫出缺少的量測。

steps.check: 交付「台階覆蓋」量測規劃：提供採樣座標、量測單位、對照與不確定度來源。

stages.title: 曝光交接
stages.description: 在「曝光交接」建立六項互補證據，逐一檢查材料、幾何、物理機制與適用限制。
stages.descriptionEn: Build six complementary evidence items for exposure handoff, checking materials, geometry, mechanisms and validity limits.

steps.title: 光學常數
steps.objective: 完成「光學常數」的因果圖，把塗佈流動、邊珠、膜厚與缺陷中的相關限制連到可觀察證據。
steps.objectiveEn: Complete a causal diagram for check optical constants, connecting relevant limits in coating flow, edge bead, thickness and defects to observable evidence.
steps.instruction: 本步問題：光學常數。畫一張含作用前後狀態的原創圖；以箭頭標出本步原理中的因果關係；圈出一項仍需量測的未知量。判讀依據：膜厚反演需要適用波長的折射率模型。引用列出的原始資料；若使用數值，清楚標成自訂教學假設。
steps.instructionEn: Question for this step: Check optical constants. Draw an original before/after diagram; mark the causal relationship in this step; circle one quantity still requiring measurement. Interpretation: Thickness extraction needs refractive-index models valid at the measurement wavelength. Cite the listed primary material; label any chosen numbers as hypothetical educational inputs.
steps.observation: 檢查結果是否能支持「膜厚反演需要適用波長的折射率模型。」；若證據不足，標記尚未確定並寫出缺少的量測。
steps.observationEn: Check whether the evidence supports: Thickness extraction needs refractive-index models valid at the measurement wavelength. If insufficient, mark the conclusion unresolved and name the missing measurement.
steps.failure: 常見錯判：顯影液相容性可由顏色直接判斷。 應回到「光學常數」的假設與採樣範圍，補足能區分機制的證據。
steps.failureEn: Common misinterpretation: Developer compatibility follows directly from color. Revisit assumptions and sampling for check optical constants and add discriminating evidence.
steps.check: 交付「光學常數」因果圖：圖中要有邊界、輸入、輸出與一項不能僅由圖決定的量。
steps.checkEn: Submit the causal diagram for check optical constants: Show boundaries, inputs, outputs and one quantity that the diagram alone cannot determine.

knowledge.title: 光學常數的原理
knowledge.text: 膜厚反演需要適用波長的折射率模型。
knowledge.textEn: Thickness extraction needs refractive-index models valid at the measurement wavelength.

knowledge.title: 本階段的機制與工程權衡
knowledge.text: 光阻膜厚與底層反射共同決定內部光場，塗佈端與曝光端需要共用光學堆疊版本。
knowledge.textEn: Resist thickness and underlying reflection determine the internal optical field; coating and exposure should share the stack version.

quiz.question: 評估「光學常數」時，哪項敘述可以採用？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is valid when evaluating check optical constants?
options: 膜厚反演需要適用波長的折射率模型。
顯影液相容性可由顏色直接判斷。
增加酸擴散永遠只會改善圖案。
optionsEn: Thickness extraction needs refractive-index models valid at the measurement wavelength.
Developer compatibility follows directly from color.
More acid diffusion can only improve patterns.
quiz.explanation: 膜厚反演需要適用波長的折射率模型。 光阻膜厚與底層反射共同決定內部光場，塗佈端與曝光端需要共用光學堆疊版本。
quiz.explanationEn: Thickness extraction needs refractive-index models valid at the measurement wavelength. Resist thickness and underlying reflection determine the internal optical field; coating and exposure should share the stack version.

steps.title: 反射與底層
steps.objective: 完成「反射與底層」的對照表，把塗佈流動、邊珠、膜厚與缺陷中的相關限制連到可觀察證據。
steps.objectiveEn: Complete a controlled comparison for assess substrate reflectivity, connecting relevant limits in coating flow, edge bead, thickness and defects to observable evidence.
steps.instruction: 本步問題：反射與底層。建立兩個只改一項條件的假想案例；分開記錄可觀察差異與推測原因；說明如何用本步原理區分兩者。判讀依據：基板反射會改變光阻內部曝光分布。引用列出的原始資料；若使用數值，清楚標成自訂教學假設。
steps.instructionEn: Question for this step: Assess substrate reflectivity. Create two hypothetical cases differing in one condition; separate observations from proposed causes; use this step’s principle to distinguish them. Interpretation: Substrate reflection changes exposure distribution within resist. Cite the listed primary material; label any chosen numbers as hypothetical educational inputs.
steps.observation: 檢查結果是否能支持「基板反射會改變光阻內部曝光分布。」；若證據不足，標記尚未確定並寫出缺少的量測。
steps.observationEn: Check whether the evidence supports: Substrate reflection changes exposure distribution within resist. If insufficient, mark the conclusion unresolved and name the missing measurement.
steps.failure: 常見錯判：顯影液相容性可由顏色直接判斷。 應回到「反射與底層」的假設與採樣範圍，補足能區分機制的證據。
steps.failureEn: Common misinterpretation: Developer compatibility follows directly from color. Revisit assumptions and sampling for assess substrate reflectivity and add discriminating evidence.
steps.check: 交付「反射與底層」對照表：交出兩案例、固定條件、預期差異及一項可能混淆因素。
steps.checkEn: Submit the controlled comparison for assess substrate reflectivity: Submit both cases, fixed conditions, predicted difference and one confounder.

steps.title: 底部抗反射層
steps.objective: 完成「底部抗反射層」的敏感度草圖，把塗佈流動、邊珠、膜厚與缺陷中的相關限制連到可觀察證據。

steps.instruction: 本步問題：底部抗反射層。選出本步的一項輸入及一項輸出；以自訂低、中、高三點畫趨勢；逐點標註假設，並寫出趨勢可能失效的條件。判讀依據：抗反射層需與光阻及後續蝕刻相容。引用列出的原始資料；若使用數值，清楚標成自訂教學假設。
steps.instructionEn: Question for this step: Assess bottom antireflection layers. Select one input and output for this step; sketch a hypothetical low/mid/high trend; label assumptions and state when the trend may fail. Interpretation: Antireflection layers must match resist and subsequent etching. Cite the listed primary material; label any chosen numbers as hypothetical educational inputs.

steps.check: 交付「底部抗反射層」敏感度草圖：圖須有變數、單位或無因次定義、三個假設點及適用範圍。
steps.checkEn: Submit the sensitivity sketch for assess bottom antireflection layers: Include variables, units or dimensionless definitions, three hypothetical points and validity limits.

steps.instruction: 本步問題：軟烤前等待。假設本步預期結果未出現；提出兩個不同機制；為各機制選一個能支持或否定的觀察，避免只重複同一量測。判讀依據：等待會改變溶劑殘留及流動。引用列出的原始資料；若使用數值，清楚標成自訂教學假設。
steps.instructionEn: Question for this step: Assess delay before softbake. Assume the expected result fails; propose two distinct mechanisms; choose an observation that supports or rejects each rather than repeating one measurement. Interpretation: Delay changes solvent content and flow. Cite the listed primary material; label any chosen numbers as hypothetical educational inputs.
steps.observation: 檢查結果是否能支持「等待會改變溶劑殘留及流動。」；若證據不足，標記尚未確定並寫出缺少的量測。

steps.checkEn: Submit the fault-discrimination table for assess delay before softbake: List two hypotheses, discriminating evidence for each and a check order.

steps.title: 膜厚與焦深

steps.objectiveEn: Complete a measurement plan for connect thickness and focus budget, connecting relevant limits in coating flow, edge bead, thickness and defects to observable evidence.
steps.instruction: 本步問題：膜厚與焦深。針對本步定義待測量及採樣位置；列出解析度、背景與重複性；設計一個見證或空白，並說明檢出限如何限制結論。判讀依據：過厚或不均勻的膜會增加圖案轉移的不確定度。引用列出的原始資料；若使用數值，清楚標成自訂教學假設。
steps.instructionEn: Question for this step: Connect thickness and focus budget. Define the measurand and sampling locations; list resolution, background and repeatability; design a witness or blank and explain detection-limit constraints. Interpretation: Excessive or uneven thickness increases pattern-transfer uncertainty. Cite the listed primary material; label any chosen numbers as hypothetical educational inputs.
steps.observation: 檢查結果是否能支持「過厚或不均勻的膜會增加圖案轉移的不確定度。」；若證據不足，標記尚未確定並寫出缺少的量測。

steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan for connect thickness and focus budget: Provide sampling coordinates, units, controls and uncertainty sources.

steps.instruction: 本步問題：DUV 塗佈交接。整合本步及本階段先前證據；提出兩項彼此不同的接受條件；再列一個會讓你暫緩放行的結果及下一個確認動作。判讀依據：膜厚、邊緣、背面及缺陷證據須一起交給曝光端。引用列出的原始資料；若使用數值，清楚標成自訂教學假設。
steps.instructionEn: Question for this step: Release the DUV coating. Combine this step with earlier stage evidence; propose two independent acceptance criteria; name one hold condition and the next confirming action. Interpretation: Thickness, edge, backside and defect evidence must accompany exposure handoff. Cite the listed primary material; label any chosen numbers as hypothetical educational inputs.
steps.observation: 檢查結果是否能支持「膜厚、邊緣、背面及缺陷證據須一起交給曝光端。」；若證據不足，標記尚未確定並寫出缺少的量測。

steps.check: 交付「DUV 塗佈交接」工程驗收單：驗收單需有原理、兩項證據、保留疑問及前後模組交接。
steps.checkEn: Submit the engineering acceptance sheet for release the duv coating: The sheet needs the principle, two evidence items, open questions and module handoff.

title: 光阻烘烤與顯影控制
summary: 以 4 階段、24 個工程工作包拆解軟烤、酸擴散、溶解與輪廓，完成圖解、對照、敏感度分析、故障判別、量測規劃與驗收。
summaryEn: Four stages and 24 work packages explore softbake, acid diffusion, dissolution and profiles through diagrams, comparisons, sensitivity studies, fault diagnosis, measurement plans and acceptance reviews.
scope: 依公開原理編寫的雙語概念實作課；每步交付可審查的工程證據。24 步是學習拆解，不代表晶圓廠的完整配方。自行設定的數值須標為假設。題目不含可直接操作的化學混配、設備設定或量產公差；照片與外部影片為代表媒體，不是假稱每步實拍。
scopeEn: Bilingual conceptual exercises based on public principles, with reviewable evidence at each step. The 24 steps are a learning decomposition, not a complete fab recipe. Chosen numerical inputs must be labeled hypothetical. No directly operable chemical mixtures, equipment settings or production tolerances are supplied. Photos and external videos are representative media, not claimed as recordings of every step.

stages.title: 烘烤機制

stages.descriptionEn: Build six complementary evidence items for bake mechanisms, checking materials, geometry, mechanisms and validity limits.

steps.title: 軟烤與 PEB

steps.objectiveEn: Complete a causal diagram for separate softbake and peb, connecting relevant limits in softbake, acid diffusion, dissolution and profiles to observable evidence.

steps.instructionEn: Question for this step: Separate softbake and PEB. Draw an original before/after diagram; mark the causal relationship in this step; circle one quantity still requiring measurement. Interpretation: Solvent removal and post-exposure reaction serve different functions. Cite the listed primary material; label any chosen numbers as hypothetical educational inputs.
steps.observation: 檢查結果是否能支持「除溶劑與曝光後反應是不同功能。」；若證據不足，標記尚未確定並寫出缺少的量測。
steps.observationEn: Check whether the evidence supports: Solvent removal and post-exposure reaction serve different functions. If insufficient, mark the conclusion unresolved and name the missing measurement.

steps.failureEn: Common misinterpretation: Equal final spin speed always gives equal thickness maps. Revisit assumptions and sampling for separate softbake and peb and add discriminating evidence.

knowledge.title: 軟烤與 PEB的原理

title: 化學放大型光阻設計
summary: 以 4 階段、24 個工程工作包拆解PAG、淬熄、反應擴散與隨機性，完成圖解、對照、敏感度分析、故障判別、量測規劃與驗收。
summaryEn: Four stages and 24 work packages explore pag, quenching, reaction-diffusion and stochasticity through diagrams, comparisons, sensitivity studies, fault diagnosis, measurement plans and acceptance reviews.
scope: 依公開原理編寫的雙語概念實作課；每步交付可審查的工程證據。24 步是學習拆解，不代表晶圓廠的完整配方。自行設定的數值須標為假設。題目不含可直接操作的化學混配、設備設定或量產公差；照片與外部影片為代表媒體，不是假稱每步實拍。
scopeEn: Bilingual conceptual exercises based on public principles, with reviewable evidence at each step. The 24 steps are a learning decomposition, not a complete fab recipe. Chosen numerical inputs must be labeled hypothetical. No directly operable chemical mixtures, equipment settings or production tolerances are supplied. Photos and external videos are representative media, not claimed as recordings of every step.

stages.title: 配方功能分工
stages.description: 在「配方功能分工」建立六項互補證據，逐一檢查材料、幾何、物理機制與適用限制。
stages.descriptionEn: Build six complementary evidence items for formulation functions, checking materials, geometry, mechanisms and validity limits.

steps.title: 放大機制定義

steps.objectiveEn: Complete a causal diagram for define amplification, connecting relevant limits in pag, quenching, reaction-diffusion and stochasticity to observable evidence.
steps.instruction: 本步問題：放大機制定義。畫一張含作用前後狀態的原創圖；以箭頭標出本步原理中的因果關係；圈出一項仍需量測的未知量。判讀依據：光生催化劑可啟動多次溶解度改變反應。引用列出的原始資料；若使用數值，清楚標成自訂教學假設。
steps.instructionEn: Question for this step: Define amplification. Draw an original before/after diagram; mark the causal relationship in this step; circle one quantity still requiring measurement. Interpretation: A photogenerated catalyst can initiate multiple solubility-changing reactions. Cite the listed primary material; label any chosen numbers as hypothetical educational inputs.
steps.observation: 檢查結果是否能支持「光生催化劑可啟動多次溶解度改變反應。」；若證據不足，標記尚未確定並寫出缺少的量測。
steps.observationEn: Check whether the evidence supports: A photogenerated catalyst can initiate multiple solubility-changing reactions. If insufficient, mark the conclusion unresolved and name the missing measurement.
steps.failure: 常見錯判：相同最終轉速一定得到相同膜厚分布。 應回到「放大機制定義」的假設與採樣範圍，補足能區分機制的證據。
steps.failureEn: Common misinterpretation: Equal final spin speed always gives equal thickness maps. Revisit assumptions and sampling for define amplification and add discriminating evidence.
steps.check: 交付「放大機制定義」因果圖：圖中要有邊界、輸入、輸出與一項不能僅由圖決定的量。
steps.checkEn: Submit the causal diagram for define amplification: Show boundaries, inputs, outputs and one quantity that the diagram alone cannot determine.

knowledge.title: 放大機制定義的原理
knowledge.text: 光生催化劑可啟動多次溶解度改變反應。
knowledge.textEn: A photogenerated catalyst can initiate multiple solubility-changing reactions.

knowledge.title: 本階段的機制與工程權衡
knowledge.text: 化學放大將光吸收與多次催化轉換連起來，但產酸效率、淬熄及溶解反應決定有效增益。
knowledge.textEn: Chemical amplification links absorption to multiple catalytic conversions, while acid yield, quenching and dissolution set effective gain.

Softbake and PEB are the same chemical step.
quiz.explanation: 光生催化劑可啟動多次溶解度改變反應。 化學放大將光吸收與多次催化轉換連起來，但產酸效率、淬熄及溶解反應決定有效增益。

steps.instructionEn: Question for this step: Assign protecting groups. summary: 以四階段、24 個工程判讀工作包，逐步研究吸收與反應路徑、塗膜與表面、曝光與統計、轉移與驗證；每步交付圖表、對照、計算或驗證紀錄。
summaryEn: Work through 24 engineering investigations in four stages: absorption and reaction, coating and surfaces, exposure and statistics, transfer and validation. Each step produces a diagram, comparison, calculation or verification record.
scope: 依公開原理編寫的教學課程；24 步是研究與工程判讀任務，不是完整晶圓廠配方或設備操作指令。自訂數據須標示假設，數值不代表任何廠商製程。課程內容完整提供繁體中文與英文。
scopeEn: Educational investigations based on public principles. These 24 steps are research and engineering-review tasks, not complete fab recipes or equipment operating instructions. Hypothetical data must be labeled and do not represent any vendor process. Full content is supplied in Traditional Chinese and English.

具體演算（全部數據為教學假設）：假設均勻膜的吸收係數 α=0.020 nm⁻¹、厚度 t=20 nm、入射光子數 100。計算 T=exp(-αt)=0.6703，約 67.0 個等效光子穿透、33.0 個被吸收；厚度改為 40 nm 時吸收比例為 55.1%。比較吸收增加與實際化學轉換兩件事，不能由此計算單獨宣告感度或缺陷率。
steps.instructionEn:
Calculate attenuation using an assumed absorption coefficient. Read the step sources and identify their actual material, pattern or tool scope. Complete the task using an educational sketch or explicitly hypothetical data. Build a cause–measurement table separating direct observations, model inferences and conclusions needing more evidence. Finally check your inference against this principle: Beer–Lambert modeling assumes a uniform film.

Worked example (all values are teaching assumptions): Assume a uniform-film absorption coefficient α=0.020 nm⁻¹, thickness t=20 nm and 100 incident equivalent photons. T=exp(-αt)=0.6703 gives 67.0 transmitted and 33.0 absorbed. At 40 nm, absorption becomes 55.1%. Separate increased absorption from chemical conversion; this calculation alone establishes neither sensitivity nor defect rate.

Report 33.0% and 55.1%, explicitly noting that reaction yield is unmeasured.

steps.objective: 透過本步證據判讀：劑量是電荷除以曝光面積。
steps.objectiveEn: Use this investigation to assess the following principle: Dose is charge divided by exposed area.
steps.instruction:
分別估算束流與駐留時間的劑量。先讀本步來源，標出其實際材料、圖形或工具適用範圍，再以教學草圖或明確假設資料完成任務。附上帶材料、方向與尺度標記的示意圖，圈出一處不能由圖單獨推論的量。最後以「劑量是電荷除以曝光面積。」檢查推論是否超出證據。

具體演算（全部數據為教學假設）：假設某圖元曝光面積為 100 μm²、所需總電荷為 0.20 nC、束流為 1.0 nA。先換算 100 μm²=10⁻⁶ cm²，再得面劑量 200 μC/cm²，理想駐留總時間 Q/I=0.20 s。另有 0.10 s 載台與資料開銷時，總時間是 0.30 s；不可把理想束流時間當作整體吞吐量。
steps.instructionEn:
Estimate dose from beam current and dwell time. Read the step sources and identify their actual material, pattern or tool scope. Complete the task using an educational sketch or explicitly hypothetical data. Attach a diagram labeled with materials, directions and scales; circle one quantity not inferable from the drawing alone. Finally check your inference against this principle: Dose is charge divided by exposed area.

Worked example (all values are teaching assumptions): Assume a 100 μm² exposed area, total charge 0.20 nC and beam current 1.0 nA. Convert the area to 10⁻⁶ cm²: dose is 200 μC/cm² and ideal beam time Q/I is 0.20 s. With 0.10 s of stage and data overhead, total time is 0.30 s; beam time alone is not throughput.
steps.observation:

Check the area conversion, 200 μC/cm² and 0.30 s, separating exposure and overhead.

knowledge.text: 束斑尺寸、位置與電流穩定度是不同性能量。
knowledge.textEn: Spot size, position and current stability are distinct metrics.

quiz.question: 完成「繪製載台誤差與偏轉誤差的分工」後，哪項判讀可靠？
quiz.questionEn: After "Separate stage and deflection errors", which interpretation is defensible?
options: 較小束斑必定代表較高吞吐量。
平均劑量相同即可忽略拼接。
大行程定位與小視場偏轉具有不同誤差來源。
optionsEn: A smaller beam spot necessarily means higher throughput.
Equal mean dose makes stitching irrelevant.
Long-range positioning and field deflection have different error sources.
quiz.explanation: 大行程定位與小視場偏轉具有不同誤差來源。 束斑尺寸、位置與電流穩定度是不同性能量。
quiz.explanationEn: Long-range positioning and field deflection have different error sources. Spot size, position and current stability are distinct metrics.

steps.instructionEn: Fit rotation and scale from a mark grid. Read the step sources and identify their actual material, pattern or tool scope. Complete the task using an educational sketch or explicitly hypothetical data. Build a cause–measurement table separating direct observations, model inferences and conclusions needing more evidence. Finally check your inference against this principle: The model needs sufficient independent marks.

title: 光罩缺陷檢測與修補
summary: 以四階段、24 個工程判讀工作包，逐步研究缺陷與成像、定位與分類、修補策略、再驗證；每步交付圖表、對照、計算或驗證紀錄。
summaryEn: Work through 24 engineering investigations in four stages: defects and imaging, localization and classification, repair strategy, requalification. Each step produces a diagram, comparison, calculation or verification record.
scope: 依公開原理編寫的教學課程；24 步是研究與工程判讀任務，不是完整晶圓廠配方或設備操作指令。自訂數據須標示假設，數值不代表任何廠商製程。課程內容完整提供繁體中文與英文。
scopeEn: Educational investigations based on public principles. These 24 steps are research and engineering-review tasks, not complete fab recipes or equipment operating instructions. Hypothetical data must be labeled and do not represent any vendor process. Full content is supplied in Traditional Chinese and English.

具體演算（全部數據為教學假設）：假設盲測標準片有 100 處已知缺陷及 100 處已知正常區。檢查器找出 90 處真缺陷，但將 5 處正常區誤報。列出 TP=90、FN=10、FP=5、TN=95；漏檢率為 10%，誤報率為 5%。若只報告 95 次警報，無法得知靈敏度；並須說明此結果只適用於標準片所涵蓋的缺陷尺寸與類型。
steps.instructionEn:
Calculate miss and false-alarm rates. Read the step sources and identify their actual material, pattern or tool scope. Complete the task using an educational sketch or explicitly hypothetical data. Use explicitly hypothetical data for one calculation or classification; retain units, denominators and intermediate results. Finally check your inference against this principle: Higher sensitivity can increase review burden.

Worked example (all values are teaching assumptions): A hypothetical blind standard contains 100 known defects and 100 clean sites. Inspection detects 90 true defects and falsely flags 5 clean sites: TP=90, FN=10, FP=5, TN=95. The miss rate is 10% and false-positive rate 5%. Reporting 95 alarms alone cannot establish sensitivity. The result applies only to the defect sizes and classes represented by the standard.

title: 相位移光罩工程
summary: 以四階段、24 個工程判讀工作包，逐步研究振幅與相位、光罩結構、成像窗口、量測與整合；每步交付圖表、對照、計算或驗證紀錄。
summaryEn: Work through 24 engineering investigations in four stages: amplitude and phase, mask structures, imaging window, metrology and integration. Each step produces a diagram, comparison, calculation or verification record.
scope: 依公開原理編寫的教學課程；24 步是研究與工程判讀任務，不是完整晶圓廠配方或設備操作指令。自訂數據須標示假設，數值不代表任何廠商製程。課程內容完整提供繁體中文與英文。
scopeEn: Educational investigations based on public principles. These 24 steps are research and engineering-review tasks, not complete fab recipes or equipment operating instructions. Hypothetical data must be labeled and do not represent any vendor process. Full content is supplied in Traditional Chinese and English.

stages.title: 振幅與相位
stages.description: 強度來自複數光場相加後取模平方，不能直接相加强度。
stages.descriptionEn: Intensity is the squared magnitude of summed complex fields, not a direct sum of intensities.

steps.title: 計算零與半週期相位差的合成強度
steps.titleEn: Calculate intensity at zero and half-cycle phase difference
steps.objective: 透過本步證據判讀：理想反相等振幅場可相消。
steps.objectiveEn: Use this investigation to assess the following principle: Ideal equal-amplitude opposing fields can cancel.
steps.instruction:
計算零與半週期相位差的合成強度。先讀本步來源，標出其實際材料、圖形或工具適用範圍，再以教學草圖或明確假設資料完成任務。建立兩種條件的對照表，分別寫出固定量、改變量與可量測的輸出。最後以「理想反相等振幅場可相消。」檢查推論是否超出證據。

具體演算（全部數據為教學假設）：假設兩束相干光的振幅皆為 1。相位差 0 時，I=|1+1|²=4；相位差 π 時，I=|1-1|²=0。若第二束振幅僅 0.8，反相後 I=|1-0.8|²=0.04，便不是完全黑暗。畫出複數向量，說明相位正確仍需要振幅匹配；此為兩束光模型，不是完整投影系統。
steps.instructionEn:
Calculate intensity at zero and half-cycle phase difference. Read the step sources and identify their actual material, pattern or tool scope. Complete the task using an educational sketch or explicitly hypothetical data. Build a two-condition comparison table listing fixed quantities, changed quantities and measurable outputs. Finally check your inference against this principle: Ideal equal-amplitude opposing fields can cancel.

Worked example (all values are teaching assumptions): Assume coherent fields with amplitudes 1 and 1. At phase difference 0, I=|1+1|²=4; at π, I=|1-1|²=0. If the second amplitude is 0.8, opposing fields give I=|1-0.8|²=0.04 rather than complete darkness. Draw complex vectors and explain why phase alone is insufficient without amplitude matching. This is a two-field model, not a complete projection system.

Finally check your inference against this principle: Phase labels must be compatible with pattern topology.

具體演算（全部數據為教學假設）：設目標晶圓邊緣 x=100 nm，初始模擬位置 x=94 nm。採用局部線性教學模型：4 倍縮小光罩的邊緣移動 +8 nm，晶圓邊緣只移動 +2 nm。一次修正後位置為 96 nm，帶符號誤差由 -6 nm 變為 -4 nm。不要把光罩 +8 nm 直接加到晶圓；實際 OPC 須重新模擬鄰近耦合，不能永遠沿用此固定斜率。
steps.instructionEn:
Update edges iteratively and track error convergence. Read the step sources and identify their actual material, pattern or tool scope. Complete the task using an educational sketch or explicitly hypothetical data. Build a cause–measurement table separating direct observations, model inferences and conclusions needing more evidence. Finally check your inference against this principle: Oversized updates can cause oscillation.

Worked example (all values are teaching assumptions): Let the wafer target edge be x=100 nm and the initial prediction x=94 nm. In a local linear teaching model with 4× mask reduction, moving a mask edge +8 nm shifts the wafer edge only +2 nm. The new prediction is 96 nm and signed error changes from -6 to -4 nm. Do not add mask displacement directly to the wafer. Real OPC needs neighborhood resimulation instead of assuming this slope always holds.

title: 反向微影計算
summary: 以四階段、24 個工程判讀工作包，逐步研究反問題定義、最佳化設計、可製造性、穩健驗證；每步交付圖表、對照、計算或驗證紀錄。
summaryEn: Work through 24 engineering investigations in four stages: inverse problem, optimization design, manufacturability, robust validation. Each step produces a diagram, comparison, calculation or verification record.
scope: 依公開原理編寫的教學課程；24 步是研究與工程判讀任務，不是完整晶圓廠配方或設備操作指令。自訂數據須標示假設，數值不代表任何廠商製程。課程內容完整提供繁體中文與英文。
scopeEn: Educational investigations based on public principles. These 24 steps are research and engineering-review tasks, not complete fab recipes or equipment operating instructions. Hypothetical data must be labeled and do not represent any vendor process. Full content is supplied in Traditional Chinese and English.

Changing weights changes the preferred solution.

title: 浸潤式微影製程
summary: 以四階段、24 個工程判讀工作包，逐步研究光學與液體、表面與液體介面、掃描與誤差、微影整合；每步交付圖表、對照、計算或驗證紀錄。
summaryEn: Work through 24 engineering investigations in four stages: optics and liquid, surface and liquid interfaces, scanning and error, lithographic integration. Each step produces a diagram, comparison, calculation or verification record.
scope: 依公開原理編寫的教學課程；24 步是研究與工程判讀任務，不是完整晶圓廠配方或設備操作指令。自訂數據須標示假設，數值不代表任何廠商製程。課程內容完整提供繁體中文與英文。
scopeEn: Educational investigations based on public principles. These 24 steps are research and engineering-review tasks, not complete fab recipes or equipment operating instructions. Hypothetical data must be labeled and do not represent any vendor process. Full content is supplied in Traditional Chinese and English.

steps.title: 比較解析度與焦深的縮放
steps.objective: 透過本步證據判讀：提高 NA 通常使焦深更敏感。
steps.objectiveEn: Use this investigation to assess the following principle: Higher NA generally tightens depth-of-focus sensitivity.
steps.instruction:
比較解析度與焦深的縮放。先讀本步來源，標出其實際材料、圖形或工具適用範圍，再以教學草圖或明確假設資料完成任務。用自訂並標明的假設資料做一個計算或分類例，保留單位、分母與中間結果。最後以「提高 NA 通常使焦深更敏感。」檢查推論是否超出證據。

具體演算（全部數據為教學假設）：假設波長、k₁、k₂ 都固定，只把 NA 從 1.00 改為 1.35。由 CD∝1/NA，CD 比值為 0.741；由 DOF∝1/NA²，焦深比值為 0.549。若原假想 CD=100 nm、DOF=200 nm，新值約為 74.1 nm、109.7 nm。這是相對縮放示例，不能視為特定掃描機的保證尺寸。
steps.instructionEn:
Compare resolution and depth-of-focus scaling. Read the step sources and identify their actual material, pattern or tool scope. Complete the task using an educational sketch or explicitly hypothetical data. Use explicitly hypothetical data for one calculation or classification; retain units, denominators and intermediate results. Finally check your inference against this principle: Higher NA generally tightens depth-of-focus sensitivity.

Worked example (all values are teaching assumptions): Hold wavelength, k₁ and k₂ fixed while changing NA from 1.00 to 1.35. CD∝1/NA gives a ratio of 0.741; DOF∝1/NA² gives 0.549. Hypothetical initial CD=100 nm and DOF=200 nm become approximately 74.1 nm and 109.7 nm. These are scaling examples, not scanner performance guarantees.
steps.observation:
提高 NA 通常使焦深更敏感。 本步須保留至少一項直接觀測與一項推論的區別。
同時報告解析度改善與焦深縮小，不可只選前者。
steps.observationEn:
Higher NA generally tightens depth-of-focus sensitivity. Preserve the distinction between at least one direct observation and one inference.
Report both improved resolution and reduced depth of focus.

本例驗收：同時報告解析度改善與焦深縮小，不可只選前者。

title: 極紫外曝光製程整合
summary: 以四階段、24 個工程判讀工作包，逐步研究系統與圖形、材料與光罩、窗口與缺陷、電性與整合；每步交付圖表、對照、計算或驗證紀錄。
summaryEn: Work through 24 engineering investigations in four stages: system and patterns, materials and masks, window and defects, electrical integration. Each step produces a diagram, comparison, calculation or verification record.
scope: 依公開原理編寫的教學課程；24 步是研究與工程判讀任務，不是完整晶圓廠配方或設備操作指令。自訂數據須標示假設，數值不代表任何廠商製程。課程內容完整提供繁體中文與英文。
scopeEn: Educational investigations based on public principles. These 24 steps are research and engineering-review tasks, not complete fab recipes or equipment operating instructions. Hypothetical data must be labeled and do not represent any vendor process. Full content is supplied in Traditional Chinese and English.

stages.description: EUV 以反射式光學與真空路徑成像，材料與光罩都參與成像誤差。
stages.descriptionEn: EUV uses reflective optics and vacuum paths; materials and masks both contribute imaging errors.

steps.instruction:
畫出光源至晶圓的反射路徑。先讀本步來源，標出其實際材料、圖形或工具適用範圍，再以教學草圖或明確假設資料完成任務。附上帶材料、方向與尺度標記的示意圖，圈出一處不能由圖單獨推論的量。最後以「EUV 光路各反射介面都影響能量。」檢查推論是否超出證據。

具體演算（全部數據為教學假設）：在假設的四面反射鏡教學光路中，每面能量反射率皆為 0.70，且忽略其他損失。總傳輸比例為 0.70⁴=0.2401；100 單位入射能量只剩 24.01 單位。若其中一面因污染變成 0.60，剩餘為 0.70³×0.60=20.58，較原來降低 14.3%。本例鏡數與反射率不是任何 EUV 機台規格。
steps.instructionEn:
Sketch the reflective source-to-wafer path. Read the step sources and identify their actual material, pattern or tool scope. Complete the task using an educational sketch or explicitly hypothetical data. Attach a diagram labeled with materials, directions and scales; circle one quantity not inferable from the drawing alone. Finally check your inference against this principle: Each reflecting interface affects EUV throughput.

Worked example (all values are teaching assumptions): In a hypothetical four-mirror path, each mirror has energy reflectivity 0.70 and other losses are ignored. Total transmission is 0.70⁴=0.2401, leaving 24.01 of 100 incident energy units. If one mirror falls to 0.60, the result is 0.70³×0.60=20.58, a 14.3% relative decrease. Mirror count and reflectivities are not specifications of any EUV scanner.
steps.observation:
EUV 光路各反射介面都影響能量。 本步須保留至少一項直接觀測與一項推論的區別。
用乘積得到 24.01 與 20.58，不可把反射率直接相加。
steps.observationEn:
Each reflecting interface affects EUV throughput. Preserve the distinction between at least one direct observation and one inference.
Use products to obtain 24.01 and 20.58; do not add reflectivities.
steps.failure: 若報告假設「EUV 可直接套用透射玻璃鏡頭。」，回到本階段原理重畫因果鏈，並補上反例或未量測項。
steps.failureEn: If the report assumes "EUV can directly use transmitting glass lenses.", revisit the stage principle, redraw the causal chain and add a counterexample or unmeasured quantity.

scope: 依公開原理編寫的教學課程；24 步是研究與工程判讀任務，不是完整晶圓廠配方或設備操作指令。自訂數據須標示假設，數值不代表任何廠商製程。課程內容完整提供繁體中文與英文。

steps.instruction:

具體演算（全部數據為教學假設）：設兩組交錯線條在完美對位時的左右間隙皆為 40 nm。第二組向右偏移 5 nm，而線寬不變，則左右間隙變成 45 nm 與 35 nm，平均仍為 40 nm。若最小間隙要求為 36 nm，這組圖形不合格，即使平均間隙完全正確。畫出帶方向的套刻向量與兩個間隙。

Complete the task using an educational sketch or explicitly hypothetical data. Attach a diagram labeled with materials, directions and scales; circle one quantity not inferable from the drawing alone. Finally check your inference against this principle: Relative displacement produces alternating spacing.

Worked example (all values are teaching assumptions): Two interleaved line sets have 40 nm gaps on both sides at ideal alignment. Shift the second set 5 nm right without changing widths: gaps become 45 and 35 nm while their mean remains 40 nm. A 36 nm minimum-gap requirement is violated despite the correct mean. Draw the signed overlay vector and both gaps.

summaryEn: Work through 24 engineering investigations in four stages: mandrels and multiplication, first spacer cycle, second cycle and cuts, errors and electrical tests. Each step produces a diagram, comparison, calculation or verification record.
scope: 依公開原理編寫的教學課程；24 步是研究與工程判讀任務，不是完整晶圓廠配方或設備操作指令。自訂數據須標示假設，數值不代表任何廠商製程。課程內容完整提供繁體中文與英文。

steps.instruction:

具體演算（全部數據為教學假設）：設理想骨架節距為 160 nm；每輪側壁倍增恰好使規則線群節距減半。第一輪為 80 nm，第二輪為 40 nm。這並不表示最終線寬是 40 nm：若目標線寬為 15 nm，名目間隙應為 25 nm。另標記切割光罩的位置需求，避免把四倍線密度誤解為完整電路已完成。

Draw initial mandrels and final fourfold line sets. Read the step sources and identify their actual material, pattern or tool scope. Complete the task using an educational sketch or explicitly hypothetical data. Attach a diagram labeled with materials, directions and scales; circle one quantity not inferable from the drawing alone. Finally check your inference against this principle: Mandrel period differs from final pitch.

Worked example (all values are teaching assumptions): Assume an ideal 160 nm mandrel pitch and each spacer multiplication exactly halves regular-line pitch. The first cycle gives 80 nm and the second 40 nm. Final linewidth is not therefore 40 nm: a 15 nm line leaves a nominal 25 nm gap. Also mark cut-mask placement requirements so fourfold line density is not mistaken for a completed circuit.

summaryEn: Work through 24 engineering investigations in four stages: self-assembly principles, guiding templates, defects and transfer, integration choices. Each step produces a diagram, comparison, calculation or verification record.
scope: 依公開原理編寫的教學課程；24 步是研究與工程判讀任務，不是完整晶圓廠配方或設備操作指令。自訂數據須標示假設，數值不代表任何廠商製程。課程內容完整提供繁體中文與英文。
scopeEn: Educational investigations based on public principles. These 24 steps are research and engineering-review tasks, not complete fab recipes or equipment operating instructions. Hypothetical data must be labeled and do not represent any vendor process. Full content is supplied in Traditional Chinese and English.

Complete the task using an educational sketch or explicitly hypothetical data. Build a two-condition comparison table listing fixed quantities, changed quantities and measurable outputs. Finally check your inference against this principle: Sample area limits supportable defect-rate claims.

Worked example (all values are teaching assumptions): Inspect 10⁶ hypothetical independent, identically distributed assembly sites and observe no defects. The approximate zero-event 95% upper bound 3/N is about 3×10⁻⁶, not zero. If spatial clustering reduces effective independent samples to 10⁵, the bound becomes about 3×10⁻⁵. Sketch dispersed and clustered sampling and explain the independence requirement.

summary: 以四階段、24 個工程判讀工作包，逐步研究模板與樹脂、填充與對位、固化與脫模、缺陷與轉移；每步交付圖表、對照、計算或驗證紀錄。

scope: 依公開原理編寫的教學課程；24 步是研究與工程判讀任務，不是完整晶圓廠配方或設備操作指令。自訂數據須標示假設，數值不代表任何廠商製程。課程內容完整提供繁體中文與英文。

steps.title: 依局部圖案體積規畫滴液分布
steps.titleEn: Plan droplets using local pattern volume
steps.objective: 透過本步證據判讀：均勻滴液未必得到均勻殘留層。
steps.objectiveEn: Use this investigation to assess the following principle: Uniform droplets need not yield uniform residual layers.
steps.instruction:
依局部圖案體積規畫滴液分布。先讀本步來源，標出其實際材料、圖形或工具適用範圍，再以教學草圖或明確假設資料完成任務。附上帶材料、方向與尺度標記的示意圖，圈出一處不能由圖單獨推論的量。最後以「均勻滴液未必得到均勻殘留層。」檢查推論是否超出證據。

具體演算（全部數據為教學假設）：假設模板凹槽總體積 100 μm³，壓印區面積 1000 μm²，目標殘留層厚度 0.020 μm。理想所需樹脂體積為 100+1000×0.020=120 μm³。若滴入 140 μm³且完全填充、沒有流出或收縮，殘留層為 (140-100)/1000=0.040 μm，即 40 nm。實際還需評估氣泡、收縮與局部密度，不能只用總體積保證均勻。
steps.instructionEn:
Plan droplets using local pattern volume. Read the step sources and identify their actual material, pattern or tool scope. Complete the task using an educational sketch or explicitly hypothetical data. Attach a diagram labeled with materials, directions and scales; circle one quantity not inferable from the drawing alone. Finally check your inference against this principle: Uniform droplets need not yield uniform residual layers.

Worked example (all values are teaching assumptions): Assume 100 μm³ of template-cavity volume, 1000 μm² imprint area and a target 0.020 μm residual layer. Ideal resin volume is 100+1000×0.020=120 μm³. Dispensing 140 μm³ with complete filling and no outflow or shrinkage yields (140-100)/1000=0.040 μm, or 40 nm, residual thickness. Bubbles, shrinkage and local density still matter; total volume does not guarantee uniformity.
steps.observation:
均勻滴液未必得到均勻殘留層。 本步須保留至少一項直接觀測與一項推論的區別。
算出 120 μm³與 40 nm，並列出體積守恆假設。
steps.observationEn:
Uniform droplets need not yield uniform residual layers. Preserve the distinction between at least one direct observation and one inference.
Calculate 120 μm³ and 40 nm and state the volume-conservation assumptions.
steps.failure: 若報告假設「樹脂越多就一定填充越完整且均勻。」，回到本階段原理重畫因果鏈，並補上反例或未量測項。
steps.failureEn: If the report assumes "More resin always improves filling and uniformity.", revisit the stage principle, redraw the causal chain and add a counterexample or unmeasured quantity.
steps.check:
交付「依局部圖案體積規畫滴液分布」的圖表或計算、採用來源、假設與單位；說明本步結論「均勻滴液未必得到均勻殘留層。」可由哪些證據支持，並保留一項限制。
本例驗收：算出 120 μm³與 40 nm，並列出體積守恆假設。
steps.checkEn:
Submit the diagram, table or calculation for "Plan droplets using local pattern volume", with sources, assumptions and units. Identify evidence supporting "Uniform droplets need not yield uniform residual layers." and retain one limitation.
Example acceptance: Calculate 120 μm³ and 40 nm and state the volume-conservation assumptions.

steps.title: 分開曝光時間與載台等待時間

steps.instruction:
分開曝光時間與載台等待時間。先讀本步來源，標出其實際材料、圖形或工具適用範圍，再以教學草圖或明確假設資料完成任務。列出一個可能混淆原因，提出能區分兩個解釋的對照或額外量測。最後以「寫入吞吐量包含非曝光時間。」檢查推論是否超出證據。

具體演算（全部數據為教學假設）：假設完整曝光面積為 1 mm²=0.01 cm²、面劑量 100 μC/cm²、束流 1 nA。總電荷為 1 μC，理想束流時間為 1000 s。再加 120 s 載台與資料開銷，總時間為 1120 s，約 18.7 min。這只是單一曝光面積的電荷帳本；不代表特定光阻配方或機台吞吐量。
steps.instructionEn:
Separate beam time from stage overhead. Read the step sources and identify their actual material, pattern or tool scope. Complete the task using an educational sketch or explicitly hypothetical data. List one plausible confounder and propose a control or measurement distinguishing two explanations. Finally check your inference against this principle: Writing throughput includes non-exposure time.

Worked example (all values are teaching assumptions): Assume a fully exposed area of 1 mm²=0.01 cm², dose 100 μC/cm² and current 1 nA. Total charge is 1 μC and ideal beam time 1000 s. Adding 120 s of stage/data overhead gives 1120 s, about 18.7 min. This is a charge ledger for one area, not a resist recipe or tool-throughput claim.

title: 套刻誤差量測與補償

summaryEn: Work through 24 engineering investigations in four stages: vectors and marks, error models, measurement quality, correction and validation. Each step produces a diagram, comparison, calculation or verification record.
scope: 依公開原理編寫的教學課程；24 步是研究與工程判讀任務，不是完整晶圓廠配方或設備操作指令。自訂數據須標示假設，數值不代表任何廠商製程。課程內容完整提供繁體中文與英文。
scopeEn: Educational investigations based on public principles. These 24 steps are research and engineering-review tasks, not complete fab recipes or equipment operating instructions. Hypothetical data must be labeled and do not represent any vendor process. Full content is supplied in Traditional Chinese and English.

steps.instruction:
