具體演算（全部數據為教學假設）：在簡化一維例中，x=-1 mm 的套刻位移為 +1 nm，x=+1 mm 為 +3 nm。擬合 Δx=t+s x，得到平移 t=2 nm、縮放 s=1 nm/mm=1 ppm。若 x=0 的保留點實測為 +4 nm，模型預測只有 +2 nm，殘差 +2 nm 提醒你兩個校準點不足以證明完整形變模型。
steps.instructionEn:
Identify scale from radial residuals. Read the step sources and identify their actual material, pattern or tool scope. Complete the task using an educational sketch or explicitly hypothetical data. Use explicitly hypothetical data for one calculation or classification; retain units, denominators and intermediate results. Finally check your inference against this principle: Magnification error is not constant translation.

Worked example (all values are teaching assumptions): In a one-dimensional example, overlay displacement is +1 nm at x=-1 mm and +3 nm at x=+1 mm. Fitting Δx=t+s x gives translation t=2 nm and scale s=1 nm/mm=1 ppm. If a held-out point at x=0 measures +4 nm, the model predicts only +2 nm and residual is +2 nm. Two calibration points do not establish a complete distortion model.

knowledge.text: 補償必須用保留位置或下一批次驗證，不能只看擬合殘差。
knowledge.textEn: Correction needs held-out sites or a subsequent lot, not only fit residuals.

quiz.question: 完成「將套刻結果連結到電性載具」後，哪項判讀可靠？
quiz.questionEn: After "Link overlay results to electrical test structures", which interpretation is defensible?
options: 校準資料殘差為零就表示沒有風險。
幾何誤差需對應功能容忍度。
線寬合格就能證明套刻合格。
optionsEn: Zero calibration residual means no risk.
Geometric error must relate to functional tolerance.
Passing linewidth proves acceptable overlay.
quiz.explanation: 幾何誤差需對應功能容忍度。 補償必須用保留位置或下一批次驗證，不能只看擬合殘差。
quiz.explanationEn: Geometric error must relate to functional tolerance. Correction needs held-out sites or a subsequent lot, not only fit residuals.

steps.title: 交付模型係數與不確定度報告
steps.objective: 透過本步證據判讀：可追溯補償需要資料、模型及限制。
steps.objectiveEn: Use this investigation to assess the following principle: Traceable correction needs data, model and limitations.
steps.instruction: 交付模型係數與不確定度報告。先讀本步來源，標出其實際材料、圖形或工具適用範圍，再以教學草圖或明確假設資料完成任務。完成一頁審查紀錄，列出接受條件、證據缺口與不應外推的範圍。最後以「可追溯補償需要資料、模型及限制。」檢查推論是否超出證據。
steps.instructionEn: Deliver model coefficients and uncertainty. Read the step sources and identify their actual material, pattern or tool scope. Complete the task using an educational sketch or explicitly hypothetical data. Complete a one-page review listing acceptance criteria, evidence gaps and limits on extrapolation. Finally check your inference against this principle: Traceable correction needs data, model and limitations.
steps.observation: 可追溯補償需要資料、模型及限制。 本步須保留至少一項直接觀測與一項推論的區別。
steps.observationEn: Traceable correction needs data, model and limitations. Preserve the distinction between at least one direct observation and one inference.
steps.failure: 若報告假設「校準資料殘差為零就表示沒有風險。」，回到本階段原理重畫因果鏈，並補上反例或未量測項。
steps.failureEn: If the report assumes "Zero calibration residual means no risk.", revisit the stage principle, redraw the causal chain and add a counterexample or unmeasured quantity.
steps.check: 交付「交付模型係數與不確定度報告」的圖表或計算、採用來源、假設與單位；說明本步結論「可追溯補償需要資料、模型及限制。」可由哪些證據支持，並保留一項限制。
steps.checkEn: Submit the diagram, table or calculation for "Deliver model coefficients and uncertainty", with sources, assumptions and units. Identify evidence supporting "Traceable correction needs data, model and limitations." and retain one limitation.

title: 曝光焦距與劑量控制
summary: 以四階段、24 個工程判讀工作包，逐步研究焦點劑量定義、窗口量測、感測與補償、變異與接受；每步交付圖表、對照、計算或驗證紀錄。
summaryEn: Work through 24 engineering investigations in four stages: focus and dose, window measurement, sensing and correction, variation and acceptance. Each step produces a diagram, comparison, calculation or verification record.
scope: 依公開原理編寫的教學課程；24 步是研究與工程判讀任務，不是完整晶圓廠配方或設備操作指令。自訂數據須標示假設，數值不代表任何廠商製程。課程內容完整提供繁體中文與英文。
scopeEn: Educational investigations based on public principles. These 24 steps are research and engineering-review tasks, not complete fab recipes or equipment operating instructions. Hypothetical data must be labeled and do not represent any vendor process. Full content is supplied in Traditional Chinese and English.

stages.title: 焦點劑量定義
stages.description: 焦距與劑量影響不同但會共同改變顯影輪廓。
stages.descriptionEn: Focus and dose have distinct effects that jointly change developed contours.

steps.title: 定義名目焦點與離焦符號
steps.titleEn: Define nominal focus and defocus signs
steps.objective: 透過本步證據判讀：焦點需有一致的參考面。
steps.objectiveEn: Use this investigation to assess the following principle: Focus needs a consistent reference plane.
steps.instruction: 定義名目焦點與離焦符號。先讀本步來源，標出其實際材料、圖形或工具適用範圍，再以教學草圖或明確假設資料完成任務。附上帶材料、方向與尺度標記的示意圖，圈出一處不能由圖單獨推論的量。最後以「焦點需有一致的參考面。」檢查推論是否超出證據。
steps.instructionEn: Define nominal focus and defocus signs. Read the step sources and identify their actual material, pattern or tool scope. Complete the task using an educational sketch or explicitly hypothetical data. Attach a diagram labeled with materials, directions and scales; circle one quantity not inferable from the drawing alone. Finally check your inference against this principle: Focus needs a consistent reference plane.
steps.observation: 焦點需有一致的參考面。 本步須保留至少一項直接觀測與一項推論的區別。
steps.observationEn: Focus needs a consistent reference plane. Preserve the distinction between at least one direct observation and one inference.
steps.failure: 若報告假設「焦距與劑量是完全相同的控制量。」，回到本階段原理重畫因果鏈，並補上反例或未量測項。
steps.failureEn: If the report assumes "Focus and dose are the same control variable.", revisit the stage principle, redraw the causal chain and add a counterexample or unmeasured quantity.
steps.check: 交付「定義名目焦點與離焦符號」的圖表或計算、採用來源、假設與單位；說明本步結論「焦點需有一致的參考面。」可由哪些證據支持，並保留一項限制。
steps.checkEn: Submit the diagram, table or calculation for "Define nominal focus and defocus signs", with sources, assumptions and units. Identify evidence supporting "Focus needs a consistent reference plane." and retain one limitation.

steps.title: 求多種圖形窗口的交集

steps.objective: 透過本步證據判讀：共同窗口可能比單圖形窗口更窄。

steps.instruction:
求多種圖形窗口的交集。先讀本步來源，標出其實際材料、圖形或工具適用範圍，再以教學草圖或明確假設資料完成任務。建立因果與量測對照表，區分直接觀測、模型推論與尚需額外證據的結論。最後以「共同窗口可能比單圖形窗口更窄。」檢查推論是否超出證據。

具體演算（全部數據為教學假設）：假設線條 A 的合格焦距範圍為 [-40,40] nm、正規化劑量 [0.90,1.10]；接觸孔 B 為 [-20,30] nm、劑量 [0.95,1.05]，並先忽略交互作用。共同窗口為 [-20,30]×[0.95,1.05]，幾何中心是焦距 +5 nm、劑量 1.00。點 (+35 nm,1.00) 對 A 合格卻對共同窗口不合格。
steps.instructionEn:
Intersect process windows for several patterns. Read the step sources and identify their actual material, pattern or tool scope. Complete the task using an educational sketch or explicitly hypothetical data. Build a cause–measurement table separating direct observations, model inferences and conclusions needing more evidence. Finally check your inference against this principle: The common window can be narrower than an individual one.

Worked example (all values are teaching assumptions): Assume line A passes at focus [-40,40] nm and normalized dose [0.90,1.10]; contact B passes at [-20,30] nm and [0.95,1.05], initially ignoring interactions. Their common window is [-20,30]×[0.95,1.05], with geometric center (+5 nm,1.00). The point (+35 nm,1.00) passes A but fails the common window.

Report the intersection and +5 nm/1.00 center, stating rectangular-window and no-interaction assumptions.

Finally check your inference against this principle: Temporal drift can mimic focus or dose effects.

title: 微影隨機缺陷分析
summary: 以四階段、24 個工程判讀工作包，逐步研究事件與機率、取樣與量測、來源分離、設計與接受；每步交付圖表、對照、計算或驗證紀錄。
summaryEn: Work through 24 engineering investigations in four stages: events and probability, sampling and metrology, source separation, design and acceptance. Each step produces a diagram, comparison, calculation or verification record.
scope: 依公開原理編寫的教學課程；24 步是研究與工程判讀任務，不是完整晶圓廠配方或設備操作指令。自訂數據須標示假設，數值不代表任何廠商製程。課程內容完整提供繁體中文與英文。
scopeEn: Educational investigations based on public principles. These 24 steps are research and engineering-review tasks, not complete fab recipes or equipment operating instructions. Hypothetical data must be labeled and do not represent any vendor process. Full content is supplied in Traditional Chinese and English.

stages.descriptionEn: Stochastic-defect analysis requires events, opportunities and independence assumptions.

steps.title: 計算零缺陷樣本的近似上限
steps.titleEn: Calculate an approximate upper bound after zero defects
steps.objective: 透過本步證據判讀：在獨立事件假設下，95%上限約為3除以樣本數。
steps.objectiveEn: Use this investigation to assess the following principle: For independent opportunities, the approximate 95% upper bound is 3 divided by sample count.
steps.instruction:
計算零缺陷樣本的近似上限。先讀本步來源，標出其實際材料、圖形或工具適用範圍，再以教學草圖或明確假設資料完成任務。附上帶材料、方向與尺度標記的示意圖，圈出一處不能由圖單獨推論的量。最後以「在獨立事件假設下，95%上限約為3除以樣本數。」檢查推論是否超出證據。

具體演算（全部數據為教學假設）：假設 N=100000 個獨立、同分布機會皆無缺陷。精確單側 95% 二項上限為 p=1-0.05^(1/N)=2.9957×10⁻⁵，近似 3/N=3.0×10⁻⁵。若報告 p=0，便超出資料支持範圍。另說明漏檢與空間相關會破壞此計算的假設；此範例沒有實際晶圓良率數據。
steps.instructionEn:
Calculate an approximate upper bound after zero defects. Read the step sources and identify their actual material, pattern or tool scope. Complete the task using an educational sketch or explicitly hypothetical data. Attach a diagram labeled with materials, directions and scales; circle one quantity not inferable from the drawing alone. Finally check your inference against this principle: For independent opportunities, the approximate 95% upper bound is 3 divided by sample count.

Worked example (all values are teaching assumptions): For N=100000 independent identically distributed opportunities with zero defects, the exact one-sided 95% binomial upper bound is p=1-0.05^(1/N)=2.9957×10⁻⁵; 3/N approximates it as 3.0×10⁻⁵. Reporting p=0 exceeds the evidence. Missed detections and spatial correlation violate assumptions; the example contains no measured wafer-yield data.

knowledge.title: 具體案例、推導與適用限制
knowledge.text: 假設 N=100000 個獨立、同分布機會皆無缺陷。精確單側 95% 二項上限為 p=1-0.05^(1/N)=2.9957×10⁻⁵，近似 3/N=3.0×10⁻⁵。若報告 p=0，便超出資料支持範圍。另說明漏檢與空間相關會破壞此計算的假設；此範例沒有實際晶圓良率數據。
knowledge.textEn: For N=100000 independent identically distributed opportunities with zero defects, the exact one-sided 95% binomial upper bound is p=1-0.05^(1/N)=2.9957×10⁻⁵; 3/N approximates it as 3.0×10⁻⁵. Reporting p=0 exceeds the evidence. Missed detections and spatial correlation violate assumptions; the example contains no measured wafer-yield data.

title: 反應式離子蝕刻
summary: 以四階段、24 個工程判讀工作包，逐步研究電漿與表面、輪廓與選擇性、端點與均勻性、損傷與轉移；每步交付圖表、對照、計算或驗證紀錄。
summaryEn: Work through 24 engineering investigations in four stages: plasma and surface, profile and selectivity, endpoint and uniformity, damage and transfer. Each step produces a diagram, comparison, calculation or verification record.
scope: 依公開原理編寫的教學課程；24 步是研究與工程判讀任務，不是完整晶圓廠配方或設備操作指令。自訂數據須標示假設，數值不代表任何廠商製程。課程內容完整提供繁體中文與英文。
scopeEn: Educational investigations based on public principles. These 24 steps are research and engineering-review tasks, not complete fab recipes or equipment operating instructions. Hypothetical data must be labeled and do not represent any vendor process. Full content is supplied in Traditional Chinese and English.

knowledge.text: 假設 20 s 內目標膜減少 100 nm、掩膜減少 10 nm。速率分別為 5.0 與 0.50 nm/s，選擇比為 10。若保持同速率再延長 4 s，目標膜多移除 20 nm、掩膜多損失 2 nm。說明此線性外推只適用於本假想穩態區間，不能忽略停止層與負載改變。
knowledge.textEn: Assume target loss of 100 nm and mask loss of 10 nm in 20 s. Rates are 5.0 and 0.50 nm/s, giving selectivity 10. Four extra seconds at the same rates remove 20 nm more target and 2 nm more mask. This linear extrapolation applies only to the hypothetical steady interval and cannot ignore stop layers or loading changes.

quiz.question: 完成「以兩材料速率計算選擇比」後，哪項判讀可靠？
quiz.questionEn: After "Calculate selectivity from two material rates", which interpretation is defensible?
options: 蝕刻最快就一定具有最好選擇性。
選擇比依材料對與條件定義。
亮度下降一定代表所有區域已蝕刻完成。
optionsEn: The fastest etch necessarily has the best selectivity.
Selectivity is defined for a material pair and conditions.
Falling brightness proves every region has finished etching.
quiz.explanation: 選擇比依材料對與條件定義。 速率、方向性與選擇性是不同指標，不能以單一速率排名。
quiz.explanationEn: Selectivity is defined for a material pair and conditions. Rate, directionality and selectivity are distinct and cannot be ranked by rate alone.

workedExample.textEn: Assume target loss of 100 nm and mask loss of 10 nm in 20 s. Rates are 5.0 and 0.50 nm/s, giving selectivity 10. Four extra seconds at the same rates remove 20 nm more target and 2 nm more mask. This linear extrapolation applies only to the hypothetical steady interval and cannot ignore stop layers or loading changes.
workedExample.check: 交付 5.0、0.50、10、20 nm 與 2 nm，分清速率和選擇比。
workedExample.checkEn: Report 5.0, 0.50, 10, 20 nm and 2 nm, distinguishing rates from selectivity.

title: 原子層蝕刻
summary: 以四階段、24 個工程判讀工作包，逐步研究自限制反應、循環與視窗、三維與選擇性、電性與效率；每步交付圖表、對照、計算或驗證紀錄。
summaryEn: Work through 24 engineering investigations in four stages: self-limiting reactions, cycles and windows, 3d and selectivity, electrical quality and efficiency. Each step produces a diagram, comparison, calculation or verification record.
scope: 依公開原理編寫的教學課程；24 步是研究與工程判讀任務，不是完整晶圓廠配方或設備操作指令。自訂數據須標示假設，數值不代表任何廠商製程。課程內容完整提供繁體中文與英文。
scopeEn: Educational investigations based on public principles. These 24 steps are research and engineering-review tasks, not complete fab recipes or equipment operating instructions. Hypothetical data must be labeled and do not represent any vendor process. Full content is supplied in Traditional Chinese and English.

stages.descriptionEn: ALE requires saturation and control evidence of self-limitation; cycling alone is insufficient.

具體演算（全部數據為教學假設）：設完整循環移除量 0.20 nm；僅改質對照 0.02 nm；僅移除對照 0.03 nm。本例定義協同分率 S=[E_full-(E_mod+E_remove)]/E_full，得到 S=0.75。即使 S 高，仍必須另畫暴露時間飽和曲線，因為協同性不單獨證明自限制；0.20 nm 也不代表恰好一個晶格層。
steps.instructionEn:
Compare full-cycle removal with controls. Read the step sources and identify their actual material, pattern or tool scope. Complete the task using an educational sketch or explicitly hypothetical data. List one plausible confounder and propose a control or measurement distinguishing two explanations. Finally check your inference against this principle: Full cycles must be distinguished from independent nonspecific removal.

Worked example (all values are teaching assumptions): Let full-cycle removal be 0.20 nm, modification-only removal 0.02 nm and removal-only control 0.03 nm. Define synergy S=[E_full-(E_mod+E_remove)]/E_full; S=0.75. High synergy still requires exposure-time saturation curves because synergy alone does not establish self-limitation. Nor does 0.20 nm necessarily equal one lattice plane.

以明示定義得到 75%，並保留飽和性尚需驗證的結論。

summaryEn: Work through 24 engineering investigations in four stages: deep-silicon geometry, cycling and cryogenics, depth and profile, integration and reliability. Each step produces a diagram, comparison, calculation or verification record.
scope: 依公開原理編寫的教學課程；24 步是研究與工程判讀任務，不是完整晶圓廠配方或設備操作指令。自訂數據須標示假設，數值不代表任何廠商製程。課程內容完整提供繁體中文與英文。

具體演算（全部數據為教學假設）：假設溝槽目標深度 100 μm、孔寬 5 μm，深寬比為 20。若矽對硬罩選擇比為 50，理想硬罩消耗為 2 μm；初始 2.5 μm 僅剩 0.5 μm。若另需 20% 等效過蝕刻，硬罩總消耗為 2.4 μm，只剩 0.1 μm。數值是假想預算，未包含均勻性與側向侵蝕。
steps.instructionEn:
Estimate mask-limited achievable depth. Read the step sources and identify their actual material, pattern or tool scope. Complete the task using an educational sketch or explicitly hypothetical data. Use explicitly hypothetical data for one calculation or classification; retain units, denominators and intermediate results. Finally check your inference against this principle: High selectivity still needs thickness margin.

Worked example (all values are teaching assumptions): Assume a 100 μm target depth and 5 μm width: aspect ratio is 20. At silicon-to-mask selectivity 50, ideal mask loss is 2 μm, leaving 0.5 μm from an initial 2.5 μm. Adding 20% equivalent overetch raises loss to 2.4 μm and leaves only 0.1 μm. These are hypothetical budgets excluding nonuniformity and lateral erosion.

Report AR=20 and 0.5/0.1 μm remainder, identifying the small-margin risk.

title: 高深寬比介電層蝕刻
summary: 以四階段、24 個工程判讀工作包，逐步研究介電堆疊、輸運與充電、輪廓控制、端點與功能；每步交付圖表、對照、計算或驗證紀錄。
summaryEn: Work through 24 engineering investigations in four stages: dielectric stacks, transport and charging, profile control, endpoint and function. Each step produces a diagram, comparison, calculation or verification record.
scope: 依公開原理編寫的教學課程；24 步是研究與工程判讀任務，不是完整晶圓廠配方或設備操作指令。自訂數據須標示假設，數值不代表任何廠商製程。課程內容完整提供繁體中文與英文。

Hypothetical data must be labeled and do not represent any vendor process. Full content is supplied in Traditional Chinese and English.

steps.title: 量測孔口、最大膨脹處與孔底
steps.titleEn: Measure opening, maximum bow and bottom
steps.objective: 透過本步證據判讀：單一截面寬度不足以描述弓形。
steps.objectiveEn: Use this investigation to assess the following principle: One width cannot characterize bowing.
steps.instruction:
量測孔口、最大膨脹處與孔底。先讀本步來源，標出其實際材料、圖形或工具適用範圍，再以教學草圖或明確假設資料完成任務。附上帶材料、方向與尺度標記的示意圖，圈出一處不能由圖單獨推論的量。最後以「單一截面寬度不足以描述弓形。」檢查推論是否超出證據。

具體演算（全部數據為教學假設）：假設介電孔深 1000 nm，孔口 100 nm，中段最大孔徑 120 nm，孔底最小孔徑 60 nm。以孔口計 AR=10，但以最小孔徑計有效幾何比為 16.7；中段相對孔口膨脹 20%。在同一截面標出三個量測位置，不能只用孔口照片宣告全孔垂直與等寬。
steps.instructionEn:
Measure opening, maximum bow and bottom. Read the step sources and identify their actual material, pattern or tool scope. Complete the task using an educational sketch or explicitly hypothetical data. Attach a diagram labeled with materials, directions and scales; circle one quantity not inferable from the drawing alone. Finally check your inference against this principle: One width cannot characterize bowing.

Worked example (all values are teaching assumptions): Assume a 1000 nm deep dielectric hole with 100 nm opening, 120 nm maximum mid-depth diameter and 60 nm minimum bottom diameter. Opening-based AR is 10, while the minimum-diameter ratio is 16.7; mid-depth bow is 20% relative to the opening. Mark all three sites in one section rather than declaring a straight, uniform hole from an opening image.
steps.observation:
單一截面寬度不足以描述弓形。 本步須保留至少一項直接觀測與一項推論的區別。
交付 10、16.7、20% 與三位置截面標記。
steps.observationEn:
One width cannot characterize bowing. Preserve the distinction between at least one direct observation and one inference.
Report 10, 16.7 and 20% with three labeled cross-sectional sites.
steps.failure: 若報告假設「孔口圓形可保證整孔筆直。」，回到本階段原理重畫因果鏈，並補上反例或未量測項。
steps.failureEn: If the report assumes "A circular opening guarantees a straight hole.", revisit the stage principle, redraw the causal chain and add a counterexample or unmeasured quantity.
steps.check:
交付「量測孔口、最大膨脹處與孔底」的圖表或計算、採用來源、假設與單位；說明本步結論「單一截面寬度不足以描述弓形。」可由哪些證據支持，並保留一項限制。
本例驗收：交付 10、16.7、20% 與三位置截面標記。
steps.checkEn:
Submit the diagram, table or calculation for "Measure opening, maximum bow and bottom", with sources, assumptions and units. Identify evidence supporting "One width cannot characterize bowing." and retain one limitation.
Example acceptance: Report 10, 16.7 and 20% with three labeled cross-sectional sites.

title: 選擇性矽鍺蝕刻
summary: 以四階段、24 個工程判讀工作包，逐步研究材料與選擇性、反應與幾何、釋放與表面、元件整合；每步交付圖表、對照、計算或驗證紀錄。
summaryEn: Work through 24 engineering investigations in four stages: materials and selectivity, reaction and geometry, release and surfaces, device integration. Each step produces a diagram, comparison, calculation or verification record.
scope: 依公開原理編寫的教學課程；24 步是研究與工程判讀任務，不是完整晶圓廠配方或設備操作指令。自訂數據須標示假設，數值不代表任何廠商製程。課程內容完整提供繁體中文與英文。
scopeEn: Educational investigations based on public principles. These 24 steps are research and engineering-review tasks, not complete fab recipes or equipment operating instructions. steps.instruction:
用兩材料損失定義選擇比。先讀本步來源，標出其實際材料、圖形或工具適用範圍，再以教學草圖或明確假設資料完成任務。用自訂並標明的假設資料做一個計算或分類例，保留單位、分母與中間結果。最後以「極小分母需要量測偵測限。」檢查推論是否超出證據。

具體演算（全部數據為教學假設）：假設同一處理後 SiGe 損失 100 nm，Si 損失 2.0 nm，選擇比為 50。若另一測試的 Si 損失低於 0.20 nm 偵測限，只能在量測前提下說明選擇比大於 500，不能報告無限大或矽零損失。另指出平面試片結果仍需在奈米間隙幾何重新驗證。
steps.instructionEn:
Define selectivity from loss of both materials. Read the step sources and identify their actual material, pattern or tool scope. Complete the task using an educational sketch or explicitly hypothetical data. Use explicitly hypothetical data for one calculation or classification; retain units, denominators and intermediate results. Finally check your inference against this principle: A very small denominator requires a detection limit.

Worked example (all values are teaching assumptions): Assume 100 nm SiGe loss and 2.0 nm Si loss in the same treatment: selectivity is 50. If another test has Si loss below a 0.20 nm detection limit, the measurement supports a lower bound above 500, not infinite selectivity or zero silicon loss. Blanket-sample results still need revalidation in nanogap geometry.

極小分母需要量測偵測限。 本步須保留至少一項直接觀測與一項推論的區別。
分別報告 50 與 >500，清楚標出偵測限。
steps.observationEn:
A very small denominator requires a detection limit. Preserve the distinction between at least one direct observation and one inference.
Report 50 and >500 separately and state the detection limit.

Total latency is 1.00 s, causing about 2.0 nm extra removal. A rate range of 1.8–2.2 nm/s gives 1.8–2.2 nm extra removal. State that residual post-stop chemistry is excluded.

title: 電漿增強化學氣相沉積
summary: 以四階段、24 個工程判讀工作包，逐步研究電漿與成膜、膜性與應力、三維覆蓋、整合與可靠度；每步交付圖表、對照、計算或驗證紀錄。
summaryEn: Work through 24 engineering investigations in four stages: plasma and growth, film properties and stress, 3d coverage, integration and reliability. Each step produces a diagram, comparison, calculation or verification record.
scope: 依公開原理編寫的教學課程；24 步是研究與工程判讀任務，不是完整晶圓廠配方或設備操作指令。自訂數據須標示假設，數值不代表任何廠商製程。課程內容完整提供繁體中文與英文。
scopeEn: Educational investigations based on public principles. These 24 steps are research and engineering-review tasks, not complete fab recipes or equipment operating instructions. Hypothetical data must be labeled and do not represent any vendor process. Full content is supplied in Traditional Chinese and English.

具體演算（全部數據為教學假設）：使用假想平行板電容 A=1.00 mm²、膜厚 t=1.00 μm、C=35.416 pF，忽略邊緣與寄生電容。由 εr=Ct/(ε0A)，ε0=8.854×10⁻¹² F/m，得到 εr=4.00。若未扣除 5 pF 寄生，表觀值約 4.565；這說明量測寄生不能直接歸因於膜成分。

Complete the task using an educational sketch or explicitly hypothetical data. Attach a diagram labeled with materials, directions and scales; circle one quantity not inferable from the drawing alone. Finally check your inference against this principle: Area, thickness and fringe effects need separation.

Worked example (all values are teaching assumptions): Use a hypothetical parallel-plate capacitor with A=1.00 mm², t=1.00 μm and C=35.416 pF, initially neglecting fringing and parasitics. εr=Ct/(ε0A), with ε0=8.854×10⁻¹² F/m, gives 4.00. An unremoved 5 pF parasitic gives an apparent 4.565, showing why parasitics cannot be attributed directly to film composition.

Show SI conversions, 4.00 and about 4.565, stating parasitic assumptions.

summaryEn: Work through 24 engineering investigations in four stages: thermal reaction and low pressure, batch and uniformity, materials and film properties, integration and quality. Each step produces a diagram, comparison, calculation or verification record.

knowledge.text: LPCVD 的速率受表面反應與氣體輸運共同限制。

quiz.questionEn: After "List wafer spacing and exposed surface load", which interpretation is defensible?

steps.title: 建立已加工元件的熱預算清單

steps.objective: 透過本步證據判讀：可沉積溫度受前段歷程限制。

steps.instruction: 建立已加工元件的熱預算清單。先讀本步來源，標出其實際材料、圖形或工具適用範圍，再以教學草圖或明確假設資料完成任務。完成一頁審查紀錄，列出接受條件、證據缺口與不應外推的範圍。最後以「可沉積溫度受前段歷程限制。」檢查推論是否超出證據。
steps.instructionEn: Build a thermal-budget list for processed devices. Read the step sources and identify their actual material, pattern or tool scope. Complete the task using an educational sketch or explicitly hypothetical data. Complete a one-page review listing acceptance criteria, evidence gaps and limits on extrapolation. Finally check your inference against this principle: Allowable temperature is constrained by earlier processing.
steps.observation: 可沉積溫度受前段歷程限制。 本步須保留至少一項直接觀測與一項推論的區別。
steps.observationEn: Allowable temperature is constrained by earlier processing. Preserve the distinction between at least one direct observation and one inference.
steps.failure: 若報告假設「降低壓力必定增加所有材料的沉積速率。」，回到本階段原理重畫因果鏈，並補上反例或未量測項。
steps.failureEn: If the report assumes "Lower pressure necessarily increases every deposition rate.", revisit the stage principle, redraw the causal chain and add a counterexample or unmeasured quantity.

steps.title: 規畫沿爐管方向的見證片
steps.titleEn: Plan witness wafers along the furnace
steps.objective: 透過本步證據判讀：軸向取樣可揭露反應物與溫度梯度。
steps.objectiveEn: Use this investigation to assess the following principle: Axial sampling reveals reactant and temperature gradients.
steps.instruction:
規畫沿爐管方向的見證片。先讀本步來源，標出其實際材料、圖形或工具適用範圍，再以教學草圖或明確假設資料完成任務。附上帶材料、方向與尺度標記的示意圖，圈出一處不能由圖單獨推論的量。最後以「軸向取樣可揭露反應物與溫度梯度。」檢查推論是否超出證據。

具體演算（全部數據為教學假設）：假設三個爐管位置的見證片膜厚為 50、55、60 nm。平均值為 55 nm；本例定義半範圍不均勻度 U=(max-min)/(2mean)=9.09%。若另一批三片皆 55 nm，平均仍相同但 U=0。只用批次平均無法判斷軸向均勻性；三片也不足以證明所有晶圓位置。
steps.instructionEn:
Plan witness wafers along the furnace. Read the step sources and identify their actual material, pattern or tool scope. Complete the task using an educational sketch or explicitly hypothetical data. Attach a diagram labeled with materials, directions and scales; circle one quantity not inferable from the drawing alone. Finally check your inference against this principle: Axial sampling reveals reactant and temperature gradients.

Worked example (all values are teaching assumptions): Three hypothetical furnace witness wafers measure 50, 55 and 60 nm. Mean is 55 nm; define half-range nonuniformity U=(max-min)/(2mean)=9.09%. Another batch with three 55 nm values has the same mean but U=0. Batch means cannot establish axial uniformity, and three wafers cannot establish every position.
steps.observation:
軸向取樣可揭露反應物與溫度梯度。 本步須保留至少一項直接觀測與一項推論的區別。
交付 55 nm、9.09% 與取樣限制，明確定義均勻度公式。
steps.observationEn:
Axial sampling reveals reactant and temperature gradients. Preserve the distinction between at least one direct observation and one inference.
Report 55 nm, 9.09% and sampling limits with the uniformity formula stated.
steps.failure: 若報告假設「同一批次所有位置自然完全相同。」，回到本階段原理重畫因果鏈，並補上反例或未量測項。
steps.failureEn: If the report assumes "Every batch position is inherently identical.", revisit the stage principle, redraw the causal chain and add a counterexample or unmeasured quantity.
steps.check:
交付「規畫沿爐管方向的見證片」的圖表或計算、採用來源、假設與單位；說明本步結論「軸向取樣可揭露反應物與溫度梯度。」可由哪些證據支持，並保留一項限制。
本例驗收：交付 55 nm、9.09% 與取樣限制，明確定義均勻度公式。
steps.checkEn:
Submit the diagram, table or calculation for "Plan witness wafers along the furnace", with sources, assumptions and units. Identify evidence supporting "Axial sampling reveals reactant and temperature gradients." and retain one limitation.
Example acceptance: Report 55 nm, 9.09% and sampling limits with the uniformity formula stated.

steps.title: 比較光激發光峰位與線寬
steps.titleEn: Compare photoluminescence peak position and width
steps.objective: 透過本步證據判讀：光譜需要結合厚度、成分與缺陷解釋。
steps.objectiveEn: Use this investigation to assess the following principle: Spectra need interpretation with thickness, composition and defects.
steps.instruction:
比較光激發光峰位與線寬。先讀本步來源，標出其實際材料、圖形或工具適用範圍，再以教學草圖或明確假設資料完成任務。建立兩種條件的對照表，分別寫出固定量、改變量與可量測的輸出。最後以「光譜需要結合厚度、成分與缺陷解釋。」檢查推論是否超出證據。

具體演算（全部數據為教學假設）：假設兩片磊晶樣品的 PL 峰位為 450 與 460 nm，以 E≈1240/λ(nm) eV 換算為 2.756 與 2.696 eV，能量下降約 0.060 eV。這個紅移可能牽涉組成、應變、溫度或量子井厚度，不能只由峰位反推唯一材料組成；提出 XRD 或厚度對照以區分。
steps.instructionEn:
Compare photoluminescence peak position and width. Read the step sources and identify their actual material, pattern or tool scope. Complete the task using an educational sketch or explicitly hypothetical data. Build a two-condition comparison table listing fixed quantities, changed quantities and measurable outputs. Finally check your inference against this principle: Spectra need interpretation with thickness, composition and defects.

Worked example (all values are teaching assumptions): Hypothetical epitaxial samples have PL peaks at 450 and 460 nm. E≈1240/λ(nm) eV gives 2.756 and 2.696 eV, a decrease of about 0.060 eV. Composition, strain, temperature or well thickness can cause such a redshift; peak position alone cannot uniquely determine composition. Propose XRD or thickness controls to distinguish causes.
steps.observation:
光譜需要結合厚度、成分與缺陷解釋。 本步須保留至少一項直接觀測與一項推論的區別。
算出約 60 meV 紅移，並保留至少兩種可能原因。
steps.observationEn:
Spectra need interpretation with thickness, composition and defects. Preserve the distinction between at least one direct observation and one inference.
Calculate an approximately 60 meV redshift and retain at least two possible causes.
steps.failure: 若報告假設「發光強度相同就代表晶體品質完全相同。」，回到本階段原理重畫因果鏈，並補上反例或未量測項。
steps.failureEn: If the report assumes "Equal emission intensity proves identical crystal quality.", revisit the stage principle, redraw the causal chain and add a counterexample or unmeasured quantity.
steps.check:
交付「比較光激發光峰位與線寬」的圖表或計算、採用來源、假設與單位；說明本步結論「光譜需要結合厚度、成分與缺陷解釋。」可由哪些證據支持，並保留一項限制。
本例驗收：算出約 60 meV 紅移，並保留至少兩種可能原因。
steps.checkEn:
Submit the diagram, table or calculation for "Compare photoluminescence peak position and width", with sources, assumptions and units. Identify evidence supporting "Spectra need interpretation with thickness, composition and defects." and retain one limitation.
Example acceptance: Calculate an approximately 60 meV redshift and retain at least two possible causes.

steps.objective: 透過本步證據判讀：超薄膜可能未形成連續導電路徑。

steps.instruction:
量測薄膜片電阻與連續性。先讀本步來源，標出其實際材料、圖形或工具適用範圍，再以教學草圖或明確假設資料完成任務。完成一頁審查紀錄，列出接受條件、證據缺口與不應外推的範圍。最後以「超薄膜可能未形成連續導電路徑。」檢查推論是否超出證據。

具體演算（全部數據為教學假設）：假設均勻且連續的濺鍍膜厚 50 nm，片電阻 20 Ω/□。由 ρ=Rs t 得 ρ=1.0×10⁻⁶ Ω·m=100 μΩ·cm。若厚度估計偏高 10%，推算電阻率也偏高 10%。此關係假設連續膜與適當幾何修正；不連續島狀膜不能直接用同一塊材模型解釋。
steps.instructionEn:
Measure sheet resistance and continuity. Read the step sources and identify their actual material, pattern or tool scope. Complete the task using an educational sketch or explicitly hypothetical data. Complete a one-page review listing acceptance criteria, evidence gaps and limits on extrapolation. Finally check your inference against this principle: Ultrathin films may lack continuous conducting paths.

Worked example (all values are teaching assumptions): Assume a uniform continuous sputtered film 50 nm thick with sheet resistance 20 Ω/□. ρ=Rs t gives 1.0×10⁻⁶ Ω·m=100 μΩ·cm. A 10% high thickness estimate makes inferred resistivity 10% high. The relation assumes a continuous film and proper geometry correction; disconnected islands cannot be interpreted with the same bulk-film model.

Report 100 μΩ·cm, error propagation and the continuous-film assumption.

title: 鎢插塞製作
summary: 以四階段、24 個工程判讀工作包，逐步研究接點與材料、成核與填充、平坦化與介面、電性與可靠度；每步交付圖表、對照、計算或驗證紀錄。
summaryEn: Work through 24 engineering investigations in four stages: contacts and materials, nucleation and fill, planarization and interfaces, electrical quality and reliability. Each step produces a diagram, comparison, calculation or verification record.
scope: 依公開原理編寫的教學課程；24 步是研究與工程判讀任務，不是完整晶圓廠配方或設備操作指令。自訂數據須標示假設，數值不代表任何廠商製程。課程內容完整提供繁體中文與英文。
scopeEn: Educational investigations based on public principles. These 24 steps are research and engineering-review tasks, not complete fab recipes or equipment operating instructions. Hypothetical data must be labeled and do not represent any vendor process. Full content is supplied in Traditional Chinese and English.

steps.instruction:

具體演算（全部數據為教學假設）：假設圓柱插塞長 100 nm、直徑 20 nm、有效電阻率 2.0×10⁻⁷ Ω·m。R=ρL/[π(d/2)²]≈63.7 Ω；上下介面各 10 Ω 時總計約 83.7 Ω。直徑減半時主體電阻變為約 254.6 Ω，總計 274.6 Ω，而不是 83.7 的四倍；介面在此簡化例中假設固定。
steps.instructionEn:
Separate bulk and interface resistance. Read the step sources and identify their actual material, pattern or tool scope. Complete the task using an educational sketch or explicitly hypothetical data. Build a cause–measurement table separating direct observations, model inferences and conclusions needing more evidence. Finally check your inference against this principle: Interfaces can dominate at small dimensions.

Worked example (all values are teaching assumptions): Assume a cylindrical plug with length 100 nm, diameter 20 nm and effective resistivity 2.0×10⁻⁷ Ω·m. R=ρL/[π(d/2)²]≈63.7 Ω. With 10 Ω at each interface, total is about 83.7 Ω. Halving diameter raises bulk resistance to about 254.6 Ω and total to 274.6 Ω, not four times 83.7; interfaces are held constant in this simplified model.

title: 銅雙鑲嵌互連
summary: 以四階段、24 個工程判讀工作包，逐步研究線孔整合、蝕刻與襯層、填銅與平坦化、RC 與可靠度；每步交付圖表、對照、計算或驗證紀錄。
summaryEn: Work through 24 engineering investigations in four stages: line–via integration, etch and liners, copper fill and planarization, rc and reliability. Each step produces a diagram, comparison, calculation or verification record.
scope: 依公開原理編寫的教學課程；24 步是研究與工程判讀任務，不是完整晶圓廠配方或設備操作指令。自訂數據須標示假設，數值不代表任何廠商製程。課程內容完整提供繁體中文與英文。
scopeEn: Educational investigations based on public principles. These 24 steps are research and engineering-review tasks, not complete fab recipes or equipment operating instructions. Hypothetical data must be labeled and do not represent any vendor process. Full content is supplied in Traditional Chinese and English.

stages.description: 雙鑲嵌先在介電層形成線槽與通孔，再以金屬填入。
stages.descriptionEn: Dual damascene forms trenches and vias in dielectric before metal filling.

steps.title: 畫出兩金屬層之間的通孔與線槽
steps.titleEn: Draw a via and trench between metal levels
steps.objective: 透過本步證據判讀：垂直與水平連接具有不同幾何。
steps.objectiveEn: Use this investigation to assess the following principle: Vertical and horizontal connections have different geometry.
steps.instruction: 畫出兩金屬層之間的通孔與線槽。先讀本步來源，標出其實際材料、圖形或工具適用範圍，再以教學草圖或明確假設資料完成任務。附上帶材料、方向與尺度標記的示意圖，圈出一處不能由圖單獨推論的量。最後以「垂直與水平連接具有不同幾何。」檢查推論是否超出證據。
steps.instructionEn: Draw a via and trench between metal levels. Read the step sources and identify their actual material, pattern or tool scope. Complete the task using an educational sketch or explicitly hypothetical data. Attach a diagram labeled with materials, directions and scales; circle one quantity not inferable from the drawing alone. Finally check your inference against this principle: Vertical and horizontal connections have different geometry.
steps.observation: 垂直與水平連接具有不同幾何。 本步須保留至少一項直接觀測與一項推論的區別。

steps.check: 交付「畫出兩金屬層之間的通孔與線槽」的圖表或計算、採用來源、假設與單位；說明本步結論「垂直與水平連接具有不同幾何。」可由哪些證據支持，並保留一項限制。

steps.instruction:

具體演算（全部數據為教學假設）：假設線槽寬 40 nm、高 60 nm，兩側與底部各由 3 nm 非銅襯層占用，不計頂部帽層。銅截面為 (40-6)(60-3)=1938 nm²，而外部截面為 2400 nm²。若銅電阻率與長度固定，襯層占用使電阻相對理想全銅增加 2400/1938-1≈23.8%。這尚未計入尺寸散射與接觸電阻。
steps.instructionEn:
Separate geometric and material contributions to line resistance. Read the step sources and identify their actual material, pattern or tool scope. Complete the task using an educational sketch or explicitly hypothetical data. Attach a diagram labeled with materials, directions and scales; circle one quantity not inferable from the drawing alone. Finally check your inference against this principle: Effective cross section accounts for liner occupancy.

Worked example (all values are teaching assumptions): Assume a 40 nm wide, 60 nm tall trench with 3 nm non-copper liners on both sides and bottom, excluding a top cap. Copper area is (40-6)(60-3)=1938 nm² versus 2400 nm² external area. With fixed copper resistivity and length, liner occupancy raises resistance by 2400/1938-1≈23.8% over ideal all-copper. Size scattering and contact resistance are excluded.

交付 1938 nm² 與 23.8%，標出襯層位於兩側和底部。
steps.observationEn:
Effective cross section accounts for liner occupancy. Preserve the distinction between at least one direct observation and one inference.
Report 1938 nm² and 23.8%, marking liners on both sides and bottom.

steps.title: 建立相同有效截面的公平基準
steps.titleEn: Build a fair benchmark at matched conducting area

steps.instruction:
建立相同有效截面的公平基準。先讀本步來源，標出其實際材料、圖形或工具適用範圍，再以教學草圖或明確假設資料完成任務。完成一頁審查紀錄，列出接受條件、證據缺口與不應外推的範圍。最後以「名目線寬相同未必導電面積相同。」檢查推論是否超出證據。

具體演算（全部數據為教學假設）：以同一外框 20×30 nm² 比較假想材料。Cu 有兩側與底部 3 nm 襯層，導電面積 14×27=378 nm²，有效ρ=4 μΩ·cm；無襯層候選金屬面積600 nm²、有效ρ=6 μΩ·cm。相同線長下比較 ρ/A，比例為 (6/600)/(4/378)=0.945；較高ρ的候選反而低阻約5.5%。這不證明無襯層可靠，須另驗證擴散與附著。
steps.instructionEn:
Build a fair benchmark at matched conducting area. Read the step sources and identify their actual material, pattern or tool scope. Complete the task using an educational sketch or explicitly hypothetical data. Complete a one-page review listing acceptance criteria, evidence gaps and limits on extrapolation. Finally check your inference against this principle: Equal nominal width need not mean equal conducting area.

Worked example (all values are teaching assumptions): Compare hypothetical materials in the same 20×30 nm² footprint. Cu has 3 nm side/bottom liners, conducting area 14×27=378 nm² and effective ρ=4 μΩ·cm. A linerless candidate has area 600 nm² and effective ρ=6 μΩ·cm. At equal length, resistance ratio is (6/600)/(4/378)=0.945: the higher-ρ candidate is about 5.5% lower in resistance. This does not prove linerless reliability; diffusion and adhesion need separate tests.

steps.title: 建立 RC 延遲的簡化比較
steps.objective: 透過本步證據判讀：低 k 的收益需與導線電阻共同評估。
steps.objectiveEn: Use this investigation to assess the following principle: Low-k benefits need evaluation with line resistance.
steps.instruction:
建立 RC 延遲的簡化比較。先讀本步來源，標出其實際材料、圖形或工具適用範圍，再以教學草圖或明確假設資料完成任務。建立因果與量測對照表，區分直接觀測、模型推論與尚需額外證據的結論。最後以「低 k 的收益需與導線電阻共同評估。」檢查推論是否超出證據。

具體演算（全部數據為教學假設）：假設幾何不變，介電常數從 4.0 降為 2.8，電容比 C₂/C₁=0.70。若電阻保持不變，RC 降低30%；但若新整合使電阻增加50%，RC 比值變為 1.5×0.70=1.05，反而增加5%。本例以集中參數 RC 說明取捨，不等於完整訊號時序模擬。
steps.instructionEn:
Build a simplified RC-delay comparison. Read the step sources and identify their actual material, pattern or tool scope. Complete the task using an educational sketch or explicitly hypothetical data. Build a cause–measurement table separating direct observations, model inferences and conclusions needing more evidence. Finally check your inference against this principle: Low-k benefits need evaluation with line resistance.

Worked example (all values are teaching assumptions): At fixed geometry, lowering permittivity from 4.0 to 2.8 gives capacitance ratio 0.70. With unchanged resistance, RC falls 30%; if the new integration raises resistance by 50%, RC ratio becomes 1.5×0.70=1.05, a 5% increase. This lumped-RC example illustrates tradeoffs rather than full timing simulation.

須同時給出 0.70 與 1.05，避免把低 k 等同更低延遲。

title: 阻障層與種子層沉積
summary: 以四階段、24 個工程判讀工作包，逐步研究功能與截面、沉積與連續性、介面與填充、擴散與可靠度；每步交付圖表、對照、計算或驗證紀錄。
summaryEn: Work through 24 engineering investigations in four stages: functions and sections, deposition and continuity, interfaces and filling, diffusion and reliability. Each step produces a diagram, comparison, calculation or verification record.
scope: 依公開原理編寫的教學課程；24 步是研究與工程判讀任務，不是完整晶圓廠配方或設備操作指令。自訂數據須標示假設，數值不代表任何廠商製程。課程內容完整提供繁體中文與英文。
scopeEn: Educational investigations based on public principles. These 24 steps are research and engineering-review tasks, not complete fab recipes or equipment operating instructions. Hypothetical data must be labeled and do not represent any vendor process. Full content is supplied in Traditional Chinese and English.

stages.descriptionEn: Barriers block diffusion; seeds enable plating and electrical continuity; the roles differ.

steps.title: 估算襯層占用的導電截面

steps.objective: 透過本步證據判讀：尺度縮小時占比會提高。

steps.instruction:
估算襯層占用的導電截面。先讀本步來源，標出其實際材料、圖形或工具適用範圍，再以教學草圖或明確假設資料完成任務。用自訂並標明的假設資料做一個計算或分類例，保留單位、分母與中間結果。最後以「尺度縮小時占比會提高。」檢查推論是否超出證據。

具體演算（全部數據為教學假設）：假設矩形溝槽外框 20×40 nm²，襯層只占兩側與底部。厚度 2 nm 時導電截面為 16×38=608 nm²；厚度 3 nm 時為14×37=518 nm²。固定ρ與長度後，電阻比為608/518≈1.174，增加17.4%。但較薄層若有針孔，不能只憑低電阻選用；補上擴散可靠度關卡。
steps.instructionEn:
Estimate conducting area consumed by liners. Read the step sources and identify their actual material, pattern or tool scope. Complete the task using an educational sketch or explicitly hypothetical data. Use explicitly hypothetical data for one calculation or classification; retain units, denominators and intermediate results. Finally check your inference against this principle: The fractional occupancy grows as dimensions shrink.

Worked example (all values are teaching assumptions): Assume a 20×40 nm² trench with liners on both sides and bottom. At 2 nm thickness, conducting area is 16×38=608 nm²; at 3 nm it is 14×37=518 nm². With fixed ρ and length, resistance ratio is 608/518≈1.174, a 17.4% increase. A thinner layer with pinholes cannot be selected on resistance alone; add diffusion-reliability gates.
steps.observation:
尺度縮小時占比會提高。 本步須保留至少一項直接觀測與一項推論的區別。
交付 608、518 nm²與17.4%，且不得省略阻障完整性。
steps.observationEn:
The fractional occupancy grows as dimensions shrink. Preserve the distinction between at least one direct observation and one inference.
Report 608 and 518 nm² and 17.4%, retaining barrier-integrity requirements.

title: 晶圓電化學銅填孔
summary: 以四階段、24 個工程判讀工作包，逐步研究電化學與供電、傳質與添加劑、超共形填充、缺陷與後段；每步交付圖表、對照、計算或驗證紀錄。
summaryEn: Work through 24 engineering investigations in four stages: electrochemistry and current, transport and additives, superconformal filling, defects and downstream processing. Each step produces a diagram, comparison, calculation or verification record.
scope: 依公開原理編寫的教學課程；24 步是研究與工程判讀任務，不是完整晶圓廠配方或設備操作指令。自訂數據須標示假設，數值不代表任何廠商製程。課程內容完整提供繁體中文與英文。
scopeEn: Educational investigations based on public principles. These 24 steps are research and engineering-review tasks, not complete fab recipes or equipment operating instructions. Hypothetical data must be labeled and do not represent any vendor process. Full content is supplied in Traditional Chinese and English.

steps.title: 用法拉第定律估算理想沉積質量
steps.titleEn: Estimate ideal deposited mass with Faraday's law
steps.objective: 透過本步證據判讀：實際質量還依賴電流效率。
steps.objectiveEn: Use this investigation to assess the following principle: Actual mass also depends on current efficiency.
steps.instruction:
用法拉第定律估算理想沉積質量。先讀本步來源，標出其實際材料、圖形或工具適用範圍，再以教學草圖或明確假設資料完成任務。建立兩種條件的對照表，分別寫出固定量、改變量與可量測的輸出。最後以「實際質量還依賴電流效率。」檢查推論是否超出證據。

具體演算（全部數據為教學假設）：用純粹教學電荷帳本：Cu²⁺還原為 Cu，假設 Q=0.10 C，M=63.546 g/mol，F=96485 C/mol，z=2。理想質量 m=MQ/(zF)=32.93 μg；若電流效率90%，則為29.64 μg。這不包含任何鍍液組成或操作條件；需再用截面體積與銅密度檢查電荷、體積及損失是否一致。
steps.instructionEn:
Estimate ideal deposited mass with Faraday's law. Read the step sources and identify their actual material, pattern or tool scope. Complete the task using an educational sketch or explicitly hypothetical data. Build a two-condition comparison table listing fixed quantities, changed quantities and measurable outputs. Finally check your inference against this principle: Actual mass also depends on current efficiency.

Worked example (all values are teaching assumptions): For an educational charge ledger, reduce Cu²⁺ to Cu with Q=0.10 C, M=63.546 g/mol, F=96485 C/mol and z=2. Ideal mass m=MQ/(zF)=32.93 μg; at 90% current efficiency it is 29.64 μg. No bath composition or operating conditions are supplied. Check consistency against cross-sectional volume and copper density to account for charge, volume and losses.

title: 化學機械平坦化
summary: 從移除量與平坦度、碟陷與侵蝕到整合驗收：以 12 項工程決策、24 個模型與診斷工作包建立證據。
summaryEn: From Removal versus planarity and Dishing and erosion to Integration acceptance: build evidence through twelve engineering decisions and twenty-four modeling/diagnostic work packages.
scope: 公開原理的教學拆解：12 個技術主題各有模型／分析及故障／驗證兩步，共四階段 24 步。不是 24 道實際製造配方，也不是任何廠商量產流程。數值由學員自訂並標示為假設；涉及材料加工、高壓、雷射或化學品的活動僅做圖上與資料分析，不由網頁授權實機操作。
scopeEn: A public-principles educational decomposition: twelve technical topics each have a model/analysis step and a diagnosis/verification step, organized as four stages and twenty-four work packages. These are not twenty-four fabrication recipes or a manufacturer flow. Learner-selected numbers are hypothetical; materials processing, high voltage, lasers and chemicals are studied through diagrams/data, not authorized physical operation.

stages.title: 移除量與平坦度 → 晶圓徑向控制
stages.titleEn: Removal versus planarity to Radial wafer control
stages.description: 把「移除量與平坦度」「Preston 近似」「晶圓徑向控制」各拆成模型與診斷兩項工作，保留可檢查成果。
stages.descriptionEn: Develop model and diagnostic deliverables for Removal versus planarity, Preston approximation, Radial wafer control.

steps.title: 移除量與平坦度：建立模型
steps.titleEn: Removal versus planarity: construct and analyze
steps.objective: 用可檢查的成果說明「均勻移除不保證原有地形被平坦化」。
steps.objectiveEn: Demonstrate the following with inspectable work: Uniform removal need not flatten existing topography.
steps.instruction:
畫三點研磨前後高度並分算移除量和剩餘高差。先標出輸入、輸出與適用假設；依圖形、計算或比較表完成推理；把估算、來源事實與待量測項分開。所有自行設定數值均標為教學假設。

具體算例（全部數值為教學假設）：假設同一高度基準下三個配對測點研磨前為 110、100、90 nm，研磨後為 75、70、65 nm。逐點移除量為 35、30、25 nm，平均 30 nm；表面高度極差由 20 降為 10 nm。請分別畫高度與移除量，不把平均移除量當成平坦度；三點不足以代表整片晶圓。
steps.instructionEn:
Draw before/after heights at three sites and calculate removal separately from residual height difference. Mark inputs, outputs and assumptions; complete the diagram, calculation or comparison; separate estimates, source facts and measurements still needed. Label all chosen values as hypothetical.

Worked example (all values are hypothetical teaching inputs): Assume three matched sites share one height datum: before polishing 110, 100 and 90 nm; after 75, 70 and 65 nm. Removal is 35, 30 and 25 nm, averaging 30 nm; surface-height range falls from 20 to 10 nm. Plot height and removal separately. Mean removal is not flatness, and three sites do not characterize a wafer.
steps.observation: 均勻移除不保證原有地形被平坦化；配對測點可降低空間錯配誤差。
steps.observationEn: Uniform removal need not flatten existing topography; Matched sites reduce spatial mismatch error.
steps.failure: 若採用「把所有位置厚度同減視為已平坦」，先回到前一步模型，檢查假設、量測條件及本步的診斷因素。
steps.failureEn: If using the claim "Treating equal thickness reduction everywhere as planarization", return to the model and check assumptions, measurement conditions and the diagnostic factor.
steps.check:
提交「移除量與平坦度」的圖表或計算、單位與至少一項假設；成果須能追溯到本步指定的輸入和輸出，並說明：均勻移除不保證原有地形被平坦化。
算例驗收：驗算平均移除 30 nm、殘餘高度極差 10 nm，並標出配對測點與共同基準。
steps.checkEn:
Submit the Removal versus planarity diagram/table or calculation with units and at least one assumption, tracing inputs to outputs and explaining: Uniform removal need not flatten existing topography.
Worked-example acceptance: Verify 30 nm mean removal and 10 nm residual height range; identify matched sites and the common datum.

knowledge.title: 移除量與平坦度／物理與模型
knowledge.titleEn: Removal versus planarity / Physics and model
knowledge.text: 機制：均勻移除不保證原有地形被平坦化。
knowledge.textEn: Mechanism: Uniform removal need not flatten existing topography.

knowledge.title: 移除量與平坦度／驗證與限制
knowledge.titleEn: Removal versus planarity / Verification and limits
knowledge.text:
模型邊界：不可由目前成果直接推出「把所有位置厚度同減視為已平坦」。
假設數值與推算：假設同一高度基準下三個配對測點研磨前為 110、100、90 nm，研磨後為 75、70、65 nm。逐點移除量為 35、30、25 nm，平均 30 nm；表面高度極差由 20 降為 10 nm。請分別畫高度與移除量，不把平均移除量當成平坦度；三點不足以代表整片晶圓。
knowledge.textEn:
Model boundary: the current result does not establish the following claim: Treating equal thickness reduction everywhere as planarization.
Hypothetical inputs and calculation: Assume three matched sites share one height datum: before polishing 110, 100 and 90 nm; after 75, 70 and 65 nm. Removal is 35, 30 and 25 nm, averaging 30 nm; surface-height range falls from 20 to 10 nm. Plot height and removal separately. Mean removal is not flatness, and three sites do not characterize a wafer.

quiz.question: 關於「移除量與平坦度」，哪項推論有物理依據？
quiz.questionEn: For Removal versus planarity, which inference has a physical basis?
options: 均勻移除不保證原有地形被平坦化
把所有位置厚度同減視為已平坦
把同一 k 套用所有膜材與漿料
optionsEn: Uniform removal need not flatten existing topography
Treating equal thickness reduction everywhere as planarization
Using one k for every film and slurry
quiz.explanation: 均勻移除不保證原有地形被平坦化；錯誤主張的問題是未保留必要條件或機制。
quiz.explanationEn: Uniform removal need not flatten existing topography. The competing claim omits a necessary condition or mechanism.

steps.title: 移除量與平坦度：故障判讀與驗證
steps.titleEn: Removal versus planarity: diagnose and verify
steps.objective: 以新增對照檢查「把所有位置厚度同減視為已平坦」這項錯誤主張。
steps.objectiveEn: Test the faulty claim: Treating equal thickness reduction everywhere as planarization.
steps.instruction: 接續前一步「移除量與平坦度」成果，先指出錯誤主張「把所有位置厚度同減視為已平坦」漏掉哪個條件。新增診斷原理：配對測點可降低空間錯配誤差。據此設計一組正常與異常對照；指定可區分兩者的觀察量、取樣位置或時間；寫下證據不足時應保留的未決結論。不得虛構實測數字。
steps.instructionEn: Continue the preceding Removal versus planarity artifact. Identify the missing condition in the faulty claim "Treating equal thickness reduction everywhere as planarization". Introduce this diagnostic principle: Matched sites reduce spatial mismatch error. Design normal/fault controls; specify a distinguishing observable, sampling location or time; state what remains undecided without evidence. Do not fabricate measurements.
steps.observation: 均勻移除不保證原有地形被平坦化；配對測點可降低空間錯配誤差。
steps.observationEn: Uniform removal need not flatten existing topography; Matched sites reduce spatial mismatch error.
steps.failure: 若採用「把所有位置厚度同減視為已平坦」，先回到前一步模型，檢查假設、量測條件及本步的診斷因素。
steps.failureEn: If using the claim "Treating equal thickness reduction everywhere as planarization", return to the model and check assumptions, measurement conditions and the diagnostic factor.
steps.check: 交出「移除量與平坦度」的正常／異常比較、可觀察量與一項仍未確定事項；必須解釋「配對測點可降低空間錯配誤差」如何改變前一步的判讀。
steps.checkEn: Submit a normal/fault comparison for Removal versus planarity, its observable and one remaining uncertainty. Explain how "Matched sites reduce spatial mismatch error" changes interpretation of the preceding artifact.

knowledge.title: 移除量與平坦度／物理與模型
knowledge.titleEn: Removal versus planarity / Physics and model
knowledge.text: 診斷機制：配對測點可降低空間錯配誤差。
knowledge.textEn: Diagnostic mechanism: Matched sites reduce spatial mismatch error.

knowledge.title: 移除量與平坦度／驗證與限制
knowledge.titleEn: Removal versus planarity / Verification and limits
knowledge.text: 可證偽性：「把所有位置厚度同減視為已平坦」與「均勻移除不保證原有地形被平坦化」不可混為同一推論；對照需能觀察兩者的差別。
knowledge.textEn: Falsifiability: "Treating equal thickness reduction everywhere as planarization" is not equivalent to "Uniform removal need not flatten existing topography"; the control must expose their difference.

把所有位置厚度同減視為已平坦

Matched sites reduce spatial mismatch error
Treating equal thickness reduction everywhere as planarization
quiz.explanation: 配對測點可降低空間錯配誤差；錯誤主張的問題是未保留必要條件或機制。
quiz.explanationEn: Matched sites reduce spatial mismatch error. The competing claim omits a necessary condition or mechanism.

steps.title: Preston 近似：建立模型
steps.objective: 用可檢查的成果說明「線性經驗式只在校正範圍內可用」。
steps.objectiveEn: Demonstrate the following with inspectable work: A linear empirical law is valid only in its calibrated range.
steps.instruction: 自訂壓力與相對速度矩陣，以 R=kPV 比較相對速率並註明 k 固定假設。先標出輸入、輸出與適用假設；依圖形、計算或比較表完成推理；把估算、來源事實與待量測項分開。所有自行設定數值均標為教學假設。
steps.instructionEn: Choose hypothetical pressure and speed pairs; compare R=kPV with a stated constant-k assumption. Mark inputs, outputs and assumptions; complete the diagram, calculation or comparison; separate estimates, source facts and measurements still needed. Label all chosen values as hypothetical.
steps.observation: 線性經驗式只在校正範圍內可用；摩擦熱可能改變經驗係數。
steps.observationEn: A linear empirical law is valid only in its calibrated range; Frictional heating can change the empirical coefficient.
steps.failure: 若採用「把同一 k 套用所有膜材與漿料」，先回到前一步模型，檢查假設、量測條件及本步的診斷因素。
steps.failureEn: If using the claim "Using one k for every film and slurry", return to the model and check assumptions, measurement conditions and the diagnostic factor.
steps.check: 提交「Preston 近似」的圖表或計算、單位與至少一項假設；成果須能追溯到本步指定的輸入和輸出，並說明：線性經驗式只在校正範圍內可用。
steps.checkEn: Submit the Preston approximation diagram/table or calculation with units and at least one assumption, tracing inputs to outputs and explaining: A linear empirical law is valid only in its calibrated range.

knowledge.title: Preston 近似／物理與模型
knowledge.text: 機制：線性經驗式只在校正範圍內可用。
knowledge.textEn: Mechanism: A linear empirical law is valid only in its calibrated range.

knowledge.title: Preston 近似／驗證與限制
knowledge.text: 模型邊界：不可由目前成果直接推出「把同一 k 套用所有膜材與漿料」。
knowledge.textEn: Model boundary: the current result does not establish the following claim: Using one k for every film and slurry.

quiz.question: 關於「Preston 近似」，哪項推論有物理依據？
quiz.questionEn: For Preston approximation, which inference has a physical basis?
options: 把同一 k 套用所有膜材與漿料
用全片平均遮住邊緣殘膜
線性經驗式只在校正範圍內可用
optionsEn: Using one k for every film and slurry
Hiding edge residue behind the wafer mean
A linear empirical law is valid only in its calibrated range
quiz.explanation: 線性經驗式只在校正範圍內可用；錯誤主張的問題是未保留必要條件或機制。
quiz.explanationEn: A linear empirical law is valid only in its calibrated range. The competing claim omits a necessary condition or mechanism.

steps.title: Preston 近似：故障判讀與驗證
steps.objective: 以新增對照檢查「把同一 k 套用所有膜材與漿料」這項錯誤主張。
steps.objectiveEn: Test the faulty claim: Using one k for every film and slurry.
steps.instruction: 接續前一步「Preston 近似」成果，先指出錯誤主張「把同一 k 套用所有膜材與漿料」漏掉哪個條件。新增診斷原理：摩擦熱可能改變經驗係數。據此設計一組正常與異常對照；指定可區分兩者的觀察量、取樣位置或時間；寫下證據不足時應保留的未決結論。不得虛構實測數字。
steps.instructionEn: Continue the preceding Preston approximation artifact. Identify the missing condition in the faulty claim "Using one k for every film and slurry". Introduce this diagnostic principle: Frictional heating can change the empirical coefficient. Design normal/fault controls; specify a distinguishing observable, sampling location or time; state what remains undecided without evidence. Do not fabricate measurements.
steps.observation: 線性經驗式只在校正範圍內可用；摩擦熱可能改變經驗係數。
steps.observationEn: A linear empirical law is valid only in its calibrated range; Frictional heating can change the empirical coefficient.
steps.failure: 若採用「把同一 k 套用所有膜材與漿料」，先回到前一步模型，檢查假設、量測條件及本步的診斷因素。
steps.failureEn: If using the claim "Using one k for every film and slurry", return to the model and check assumptions, measurement conditions and the diagnostic factor.
steps.check: 交出「Preston 近似」的正常／異常比較、可觀察量與一項仍未確定事項；必須解釋「摩擦熱可能改變經驗係數」如何改變前一步的判讀。
steps.checkEn: Submit a normal/fault comparison for Preston approximation, its observable and one remaining uncertainty. Explain how "Frictional heating can change the empirical coefficient" changes interpretation of the preceding artifact.

knowledge.title: Preston 近似／物理與模型
knowledge.text: 診斷機制：摩擦熱可能改變經驗係數。
knowledge.textEn: Diagnostic mechanism: Frictional heating can change the empirical coefficient.

knowledge.title: Preston 近似／驗證與限制
knowledge.text: 可證偽性：「把同一 k 套用所有膜材與漿料」與「線性經驗式只在校正範圍內可用」不可混為同一推論；對照需能觀察兩者的差別。

title: CMP 漿料與磨粒控制

summaryEn: From Abrasive populations and Chemical and mechanical roles to Lot release: build evidence through twelve engineering decisions and twenty-four modeling/diagnostic work packages.
scope: 公開原理的教學拆解：12 個技術主題各有模型／分析及故障／驗證兩步，共四階段 24 步。不是 24 道實際製造配方，也不是任何廠商量產流程。數值由學員自訂並標示為假設；涉及材料加工、高壓、雷射或化學品的活動僅做圖上與資料分析，不由網頁授權實機操作。
scopeEn: A public-principles educational decomposition: twelve technical topics each have a model/analysis step and a diagnosis/verification step, organized as four stages and twenty-four work packages. These are not twenty-four fabrication recipes or a manufacturer flow. Learner-selected numbers are hypothetical; materials processing, high voltage, lasers and chemicals are studied through diagrams/data, not authorized physical operation.

steps.title: 磨粒族群：建立模型
steps.objective: 用可檢查的成果說明「稀少大顆粒可能主導刮傷」。
steps.objectiveEn: Demonstrate the following with inspectable work: Rare large particles can dominate scratching.
steps.instruction:
比較相同平均粒徑但不同大粒尾端的兩個假設分布。先標出輸入、輸出與適用假設；依圖形、計算或比較表完成推理；把估算、來源事實與待量測項分開。所有自行設定數值均標為教學假設。

具體算例（全部數值為教學假設）：假設漿料 A 的離散計數為 9,999 顆直徑 100 nm 加 1 顆 1,000 nm，B 為 10,000 顆直徑 100.09 nm。兩者數目加權平均均為 100.09 nm；大於 500 nm 的顆數卻為 A=1、B=0。畫出尾端計數，說明平均值相同仍可能有不同大粒子風險；這不是實際漿料規格，亦不能單由粒徑斷定刮傷。
steps.instructionEn:
Compare hypothetical distributions with equal means but different large-particle tails. Mark inputs, outputs and assumptions; complete the diagram, calculation or comparison; separate estimates, source facts and measurements still needed. Label all chosen values as hypothetical.

Worked example (all values are hypothetical teaching inputs): Assume slurry A contains 9,999 particles of diameter 100 nm and one of 1,000 nm; B contains 10,000 particles of 100.09 nm. Both number-weighted means are 100.09 nm, but counts above 500 nm are A=1 and B=0. Plot tail counts and explain how equal means conceal large-particle differences. These are not slurry specifications, and diameter alone does not establish scratching.
steps.observation: 稀少大顆粒可能主導刮傷；尾端估計需足夠取樣體積。
steps.observationEn: Rare large particles can dominate scratching; Tail estimates require sufficient sampled volume.
steps.failure: 若採用「只用平均粒徑核准漿料」，先回到前一步模型，檢查假設、量測條件及本步的診斷因素。
steps.failureEn: If using the claim "Qualifying slurry from mean particle size alone", return to the model and check assumptions, measurement conditions and the diagnostic factor.
steps.check:
提交「磨粒族群」的圖表或計算、單位與至少一項假設；成果須能追溯到本步指定的輸入和輸出，並說明：稀少大顆粒可能主導刮傷。
算例驗收：列出平均值計算及 500 nm 門檻計數；不得把數目加權平均和體積加權平均混用。
steps.checkEn:
Submit the Abrasive populations diagram/table or calculation with units and at least one assumption, tracing inputs to outputs and explaining: Rare large particles can dominate scratching.
Worked-example acceptance: Show both mean calculations and the 500 nm threshold counts; do not interchange number- and volume-weighted means.

title: 互連電遷移可靠度
summary: 從電子流與原子遷移、加速模型到使用情境：以 12 項工程決策、24 個模型與診斷工作包建立證據。
summaryEn: From Electron flow and atomic transport and Acceleration model to Use-condition transfer: build evidence through twelve engineering decisions and twenty-four modeling/diagnostic work packages.
scope: 公開原理的教學拆解：12 個技術主題各有模型／分析及故障／驗證兩步，共四階段 24 步。不是 24 道實際製造配方，也不是任何廠商量產流程。數值由學員自訂並標示為假設；涉及材料加工、高壓、雷射或化學品的活動僅做圖上與資料分析，不由網頁授權實機操作。
scopeEn: A public-principles educational decomposition: twelve technical topics each have a model/analysis step and a diagnosis/verification step, organized as four stages and twenty-four work packages. These are not twenty-four fabrication recipes or a manufacturer flow. Learner-selected numbers are hypothetical; materials processing, high voltage, lasers and chemicals are studied through diagrams/data, not authorized physical operation.

steps.objective: 以新增對照檢查「只畫電流箭頭便確定所有空洞位置」這項錯誤主張。
steps.objectiveEn: Test the faulty claim: Locating every void from a current arrow alone.
steps.instruction: 接續前一步「電子流與原子遷移」成果，先指出錯誤主張「只畫電流箭頭便確定所有空洞位置」漏掉哪個條件。新增診斷原理：通量散度對應局部堆積與耗空。據此設計一組正常與異常對照；指定可區分兩者的觀察量、取樣位置或時間；寫下證據不足時應保留的未決結論。不得虛構實測數字。
steps.instructionEn: Continue the preceding Electron flow and atomic transport artifact. Identify the missing condition in the faulty claim "Locating every void from a current arrow alone". Introduce this diagnostic principle: Flux divergence tracks accumulation or depletion. Design normal/fault controls; specify a distinguishing observable, sampling location or time; state what remains undecided without evidence. Do not fabricate measurements.
steps.observation: 原子通量與通量散度不是同一量；通量散度對應局部堆積與耗空。
steps.observationEn: Atomic flux and its divergence are different quantities; Flux divergence tracks accumulation or depletion.
steps.failure: 若採用「只畫電流箭頭便確定所有空洞位置」，先回到前一步模型，檢查假設、量測條件及本步的診斷因素。
steps.failureEn: If using the claim "Locating every void from a current arrow alone", return to the model and check assumptions, measurement conditions and the diagnostic factor.
steps.check: 交出「電子流與原子遷移」的正常／異常比較、可觀察量與一項仍未確定事項；必須解釋「通量散度對應局部堆積與耗空」如何改變前一步的判讀。
steps.checkEn: Submit a normal/fault comparison for Electron flow and atomic transport, its observable and one remaining uncertainty. Explain how "Flux divergence tracks accumulation or depletion" changes interpretation of the preceding artifact.

steps.title: 電流密度：建立模型
steps.objective: 用可檢查的成果說明「相同電流不代表相同電流密度」。
steps.objectiveEn: Demonstrate the following with inspectable work: Equal current does not imply equal current density.
steps.instruction:
對兩種截面計算 J=I/A，並分別記錄總電流與截面。先標出輸入、輸出與適用假設；依圖形、計算或比較表完成推理；把估算、來源事實與待量測項分開。所有自行設定數值均標為教學假設。

具體算例（全部數值為教學假設）：假設矩形互連寬 100 nm、厚 50 nm，電流 1 mA，均勻截面 A=5×10⁻¹⁵ m²；J=I/A=2×10¹¹ A/m²=2×10⁷ A/cm²，即 20 MA/cm²。再把厚度改為 40 nm，J 升為 25 MA/cm²。此例只練習單位與幾何敏感度，不是允許電流或可靠度門檻，也忽略局部電流擁擠。
steps.instructionEn:
Calculate J=I/A for two cross-sections while recording current and area separately. Mark inputs, outputs and assumptions; complete the diagram, calculation or comparison; separate estimates, source facts and measurements still needed. Label all chosen values as hypothetical.

Worked example (all values are hypothetical teaching inputs): Assume a rectangular line 100 nm wide and 50 nm thick carrying 1 mA uniformly. A=5×10⁻¹⁵ m²; J=I/A=2×10¹¹ A/m²=2×10⁷ A/cm², or 20 MA/cm². At 40 nm thickness J becomes 25 MA/cm². This exercises units and geometry sensitivity, not permitted current or a reliability limit; it ignores local current crowding.
steps.observation: 相同電流不代表相同電流密度；膜厚誤差直接傳到電流密度。
steps.observationEn: Equal current does not imply equal current density; Thickness error propagates into current density.
steps.failure: 若採用「用額定電流直接比較不同線寬壽命」，先回到前一步模型，檢查假設、量測條件及本步的診斷因素。
steps.failureEn: If using the claim "Comparing different widths by rated current alone", return to the model and check assumptions, measurement conditions and the diagnostic factor.
steps.check:
提交「電流密度」的圖表或計算、單位與至少一項假設；成果須能追溯到本步指定的輸入和輸出，並說明：相同電流不代表相同電流密度。
算例驗收：驗算 20 與 25 MA/cm²，註明 A/m² 轉 A/cm² 要除以 10,000。
steps.checkEn:
Submit the Current density diagram/table or calculation with units and at least one assumption, tracing inputs to outputs and explaining: Equal current does not imply equal current density.
Worked-example acceptance: Verify 20 and 25 MA/cm², noting that A/m² converts to A/cm² by division by 10,000.

title: 時間相依介電崩潰量測
summary: 從電場與厚度、時間解析度到可靠度報告：以 12 項工程決策、24 個模型與診斷工作包建立證據。
summaryEn: From Field and thickness and Time resolution to Reliability report: build evidence through twelve engineering decisions and twenty-four modeling/diagnostic work packages.
scope: 公開原理的教學拆解：12 個技術主題各有模型／分析及故障／驗證兩步，共四階段 24 步。不是 24 道實際製造配方，也不是任何廠商量產流程。數值由學員自訂並標示為假設；涉及材料加工、高壓、雷射或化學品的活動僅做圖上與資料分析，不由網頁授權實機操作。
scopeEn: A public-principles educational decomposition: twelve technical topics each have a model/analysis step and a diagnosis/verification step, organized as four stages and twenty-four work packages. These are not twenty-four fabrication recipes or a manufacturer flow. Learner-selected numbers are hypothetical; materials processing, high voltage, lasers and chemicals are studied through diagrams/data, not authorized physical operation.

steps.title: 電場與厚度：建立模型
steps.titleEn: Field and thickness: construct and analyze
steps.objective: 用可檢查的成果說明「端點及多層介質的局部場可能不同」。
steps.objectiveEn: Demonstrate the following with inspectable work: Edge and multilayer local fields may differ.
steps.instruction:
用假設 V、t 算 E=V/t 並標註均勻平板近似。先標出輸入、輸出與適用假設；依圖形、計算或比較表完成推理；把估算、來源事實與待量測項分開。所有自行設定數值均標為教學假設。

具體算例（全部數值為教學假設）：假設單一均勻介質厚 5 nm、實際介質壓降 1 V，E=V/t=2×10⁸ V/m=2 MV/cm；厚度若為 4 nm 而電壓不變，場增為 2.5 MV/cm。用圖標明壓降與厚度。這不是 TDDB 壽命預測；多層介質、固定電荷與局部場增強未納入。
steps.instructionEn:
Calculate E=V/t from hypothetical values and state the uniform planar approximation. Mark inputs, outputs and assumptions; complete the diagram, calculation or comparison; separate estimates, source facts and measurements still needed. Label all chosen values as hypothetical.

Worked example (all values are hypothetical teaching inputs): Assume a uniform 5 nm dielectric with an actual 1 V drop: E=V/t=2×10⁸ V/m=2 MV/cm. At 4 nm and the same voltage the field becomes 2.5 MV/cm. Label voltage drop and thickness on a sketch. This is not a TDDB lifetime prediction; multilayers, fixed charge and local field enhancement are excluded.
steps.observation: 端點及多層介質的局部場可能不同；多層介質分壓依介電常數而變。
steps.observationEn: Edge and multilayer local fields may differ; Multilayer voltage division depends on permittivity.
steps.failure: 若採用「直接用總堆疊厚度推斷每層相同電場」，先回到前一步模型，檢查假設、量測條件及本步的診斷因素。
steps.failureEn: If using the claim "Inferring equal field in every layer from total thickness", return to the model and check assumptions, measurement conditions and the diagnostic factor.
steps.check:
提交「電場與厚度」的圖表或計算、單位與至少一項假設；成果須能追溯到本步指定的輸入和輸出，並說明：端點及多層介質的局部場可能不同。
算例驗收：驗算兩個電場並說明為何單憑電場不能給出崩潰時間。
steps.checkEn:
Submit the Field and thickness diagram/table or calculation with units and at least one assumption, tracing inputs to outputs and explaining: Edge and multilayer local fields may differ.
Worked-example acceptance: Verify both fields and explain why field alone does not determine time to breakdown.

summaryEn: From One-transistor one-capacitor storage and Sidewall conformality to Capacitor integration review: build evidence through twelve engineering decisions and twenty-four modeling/diagnostic work packages.
scope: 公開原理的教學拆解：12 個技術主題各有模型／分析及故障／驗證兩步，共四階段 24 步。不是 24 道實際製造配方，也不是任何廠商量產流程。數值由學員自訂並標示為假設；涉及材料加工、高壓、雷射或化學品的活動僅做圖上與資料分析，不由網頁授權實機操作。
scopeEn: A public-principles educational decomposition: twelve technical topics each have a model/analysis step and a diagnosis/verification step, organized as four stages and twenty-four work packages. These are not twenty-four fabrication recipes or a manufacturer flow. Learner-selected numbers are hypothetical; materials processing, high voltage, lasers and chemicals are studied through diagrams/data, not authorized physical operation.

stages.title: 1T1C 儲存 → 立體表面

stages.descriptionEn: Develop model and diagnostic deliverables for One-transistor one-capacitor storage, Capacitance budget, Three-dimensional surface.

steps.title: 1T1C 儲存：建立模型
steps.titleEn: One-transistor one-capacitor storage: construct and analyze
steps.objective: 用可檢查的成果說明「讀出擾動儲存電荷並需要恢復」。
steps.objectiveEn: Demonstrate the following with inspectable work: Readout disturbs stored charge and requires restoration.
steps.instruction: 畫存取電晶體、儲存電容與位元線並追蹤寫入讀出。先標出輸入、輸出與適用假設；依圖形、計算或比較表完成推理；把估算、來源事實與待量測項分開。所有自行設定數值均標為教學假設。
steps.instructionEn: Draw access transistor, capacitor and bitline and trace write/read paths. Mark inputs, outputs and assumptions; complete the diagram, calculation or comparison; separate estimates, source facts and measurements still needed. Label all chosen values as hypothetical.
steps.observation: 讀出擾動儲存電荷並需要恢復；位元線電容影響電荷共享電壓。
steps.observationEn: Readout disturbs stored charge and requires restoration; Bitline capacitance affects charge-sharing voltage.
steps.failure: 若採用「把 DRAM 讀取當成完全不改變電容電荷」，先回到前一步模型，檢查假設、量測條件及本步的診斷因素。
steps.failureEn: If using the claim "Treating DRAM read as entirely nondisturbing", return to the model and check assumptions, measurement conditions and the diagnostic factor.
steps.check: 提交「1T1C 儲存」的圖表或計算、單位與至少一項假設；成果須能追溯到本步指定的輸入和輸出，並說明：讀出擾動儲存電荷並需要恢復。
steps.checkEn: Submit the One-transistor one-capacitor storage diagram/table or calculation with units and at least one assumption, tracing inputs to outputs and explaining: Readout disturbs stored charge and requires restoration.

quiz.question: 關於「1T1C 儲存」，哪項推論有物理依據？
quiz.questionEn: For One-transistor one-capacitor storage, which inference has a physical basis?
options: 讀出擾動儲存電荷並需要恢復
把 DRAM 讀取當成完全不改變電容電荷
只把介電層無限變薄當成可行最佳解

quiz.explanationEn: Readout disturbs stored charge and requires restoration. The competing claim omits a necessary condition or mechanism.

steps.title: 1T1C 儲存：故障判讀與驗證
steps.titleEn: One-transistor one-capacitor storage: diagnose and verify
steps.objective: 以新增對照檢查「把 DRAM 讀取當成完全不改變電容電荷」這項錯誤主張。
steps.objectiveEn: Test the faulty claim: Treating DRAM read as entirely nondisturbing.
steps.instruction: 接續前一步「1T1C 儲存」成果，先指出錯誤主張「把 DRAM 讀取當成完全不改變電容電荷」漏掉哪個條件。新增診斷原理：位元線電容影響電荷共享電壓。據此設計一組正常與異常對照；指定可區分兩者的觀察量、取樣位置或時間；寫下證據不足時應保留的未決結論。不得虛構實測數字。
steps.instructionEn: Continue the preceding One-transistor one-capacitor storage artifact. Identify the missing condition in the faulty claim "Treating DRAM read as entirely nondisturbing". Introduce this diagnostic principle: Bitline capacitance affects charge-sharing voltage. Design normal/fault controls; specify a distinguishing observable, sampling location or time; state what remains undecided without evidence. Do not fabricate measurements.
steps.observation: 讀出擾動儲存電荷並需要恢復；位元線電容影響電荷共享電壓。
steps.observationEn: Readout disturbs stored charge and requires restoration; Bitline capacitance affects charge-sharing voltage.
steps.failure: 若採用「把 DRAM 讀取當成完全不改變電容電荷」，先回到前一步模型，檢查假設、量測條件及本步的診斷因素。
steps.failureEn: If using the claim "Treating DRAM read as entirely nondisturbing", return to the model and check assumptions, measurement conditions and the diagnostic factor.
steps.check: 交出「1T1C 儲存」的正常／異常比較、可觀察量與一項仍未確定事項；必須解釋「位元線電容影響電荷共享電壓」如何改變前一步的判讀。
steps.checkEn: Submit a normal/fault comparison for One-transistor one-capacitor storage, its observable and one remaining uncertainty. Explain how "Bitline capacitance affects charge-sharing voltage" changes interpretation of the preceding artifact.

steps.title: 電容預算：建立模型
steps.objective: 用可檢查的成果說明「薄介電層的電容收益必須和漏電一起評估」。
steps.objectiveEn: Demonstrate the following with inspectable work: Capacitance gains from thinning require leakage assessment.
steps.instruction:
用 C=εA/t 比較面積、介電常數與厚度三種假設改善。先標出輸入、輸出與適用假設；依圖形、計算或比較表完成推理；把估算、來源事實與待量測項分開。所有自行設定數值均標為教學假設。

具體算例（全部數值為教學假設）：假設理想平板電容 εr=20、A=1 µm²、t=10 nm，取 ε0=8.854×10⁻¹² F/m，C=ε0εrA/t=17.708 fF。厚度不變而面積加倍時為 35.416 fF。這是幾何練習；未含邊緣場、死層、漏電與位元線負載，不是量產 DRAM 單元規格。
steps.instructionEn:
Use C=εA/t to compare hypothetical area, permittivity and thickness changes. Mark inputs, outputs and assumptions; complete the diagram, calculation or comparison; separate estimates, source facts and measurements still needed. Label all chosen values as hypothetical.

Worked example (all values are hypothetical teaching inputs): Assume an ideal parallel-plate capacitor with εr=20, A=1 µm² and t=10 nm. Using ε0=8.854×10⁻¹² F/m gives C=ε0εrA/t=17.708 fF; doubling area at fixed thickness gives 35.416 fF. This geometry exercise excludes fringing, dead layers, leakage and bitline loading and is not a production DRAM-cell specification.
steps.observation: 薄介電層的電容收益必須和漏電一起評估；邊緣場使平板公式成為近似。
steps.observationEn: Capacitance gains from thinning require leakage assessment; Fringing makes the parallel-plate formula approximate.
steps.failure: 若採用「只把介電層無限變薄當成可行最佳解」，先回到前一步模型，檢查假設、量測條件及本步的診斷因素。
steps.failureEn: If using the claim "Treating unlimited dielectric thinning as feasible optimization", return to the model and check assumptions, measurement conditions and the diagnostic factor.
steps.check:
提交「電容預算」的圖表或計算、單位與至少一項假設；成果須能追溯到本步指定的輸入和輸出，並說明：薄介電層的電容收益必須和漏電一起評估。
算例驗收：將 µm² 換算為 10⁻¹² m²，驗算 17.708 fF，另列一項公式未包含的影響。
steps.checkEn:
Submit the Capacitance budget diagram/table or calculation with units and at least one assumption, tracing inputs to outputs and explaining: Capacitance gains from thinning require leakage assessment.
Worked-example acceptance: Convert µm² to 10⁻¹² m², verify 17.708 fF and list one excluded effect.

stages.descriptionEn: Develop model and diagnostic deliverables for High-aspect-ratio openings, Sidewall conformality, Bottom-electrode continuity.

steps.title: 高深寬比開口：建立模型
steps.objective: 用可檢查的成果說明「孔口尺寸不能完整描述深孔形貌」。
steps.objectiveEn: Demonstrate the following with inspectable work: Opening CD does not fully describe a deep feature.
steps.instruction: 將頂部、中部和底部寬度標在假設剖面，計算各段收縮。先標出輸入、輸出與適用假設；依圖形、計算或比較表完成推理；把估算、來源事實與待量測項分開。所有自行設定數值均標為教學假設。
steps.instructionEn: Mark top, middle and bottom widths on a hypothetical section and quantify narrowing. Mark inputs, outputs and assumptions; complete the diagram, calculation or comparison; separate estimates, source facts and measurements still needed. Label all chosen values as hypothetical.
steps.observation: 孔口尺寸不能完整描述深孔形貌；蝕刻停止可發生在孔底而孔口正常。
steps.observationEn: Opening CD does not fully describe a deep feature; Bottom etch stop can coexist with normal openings.
steps.failure: 若採用「量到孔口正確就判定整孔合格」，先回到前一步模型，檢查假設、量測條件及本步的診斷因素。
steps.failureEn: If using the claim "Accepting the whole hole from the opening CD", return to the model and check assumptions, measurement conditions and the diagnostic factor.
steps.check: 提交「高深寬比開口」的圖表或計算、單位與至少一項假設；成果須能追溯到本步指定的輸入和輸出，並說明：孔口尺寸不能完整描述深孔形貌。
steps.checkEn: Submit the High-aspect-ratio openings diagram/table or calculation with units and at least one assumption, tracing inputs to outputs and explaining: Opening CD does not fully describe a deep feature.

knowledge.title: 高深寬比開口／物理與模型
knowledge.text: 機制：孔口尺寸不能完整描述深孔形貌。
knowledge.textEn: Mechanism: Opening CD does not fully describe a deep feature.

knowledge.title: 高深寬比開口／驗證與限制
knowledge.text: 模型邊界：不可由目前成果直接推出「量到孔口正確就判定整孔合格」。
knowledge.textEn: Model boundary: the current result does not establish the following claim: Accepting the whole hole from the opening CD.

quiz.question: 關於「高深寬比開口」，哪項推論有物理依據？
quiz.questionEn: For High-aspect-ratio openings, which inference has a physical basis?
options: 孔口尺寸不能完整描述深孔形貌
量到孔口正確就判定整孔合格
把 ALD 名稱當成百分百深孔均勻的保證
optionsEn: Opening CD does not fully describe a deep feature
Accepting the whole hole from the opening CD
Treating the ALD label as guaranteed deep-hole uniformity
quiz.explanation: 孔口尺寸不能完整描述深孔形貌；錯誤主張的問題是未保留必要條件或機制。
quiz.explanationEn: Opening CD does not fully describe a deep feature. The competing claim omits a necessary condition or mechanism.

steps.title: 高深寬比開口：故障判讀與驗證
steps.objective: 以新增對照檢查「量到孔口正確就判定整孔合格」這項錯誤主張。
steps.objectiveEn: Test the faulty claim: Accepting the whole hole from the opening CD.
steps.instruction: 接續前一步「高深寬比開口」成果，先指出錯誤主張「量到孔口正確就判定整孔合格」漏掉哪個條件。新增診斷原理：蝕刻停止可發生在孔底而孔口正常。據此設計一組正常與異常對照；指定可區分兩者的觀察量、取樣位置或時間；寫下證據不足時應保留的未決結論。不得虛構實測數字。
steps.instructionEn: Continue the preceding High-aspect-ratio openings artifact. Identify the missing condition in the faulty claim "Accepting the whole hole from the opening CD". Introduce this diagnostic principle: Bottom etch stop can coexist with normal openings. Design normal/fault controls; specify a distinguishing observable, sampling location or time; state what remains undecided without evidence. Do not fabricate measurements.
steps.observation: 孔口尺寸不能完整描述深孔形貌；蝕刻停止可發生在孔底而孔口正常。
steps.observationEn: Opening CD does not fully describe a deep feature; Bottom etch stop can coexist with normal openings.
steps.failure: 若採用「量到孔口正確就判定整孔合格」，先回到前一步模型，檢查假設、量測條件及本步的診斷因素。
steps.failureEn: If using the claim "Accepting the whole hole from the opening CD", return to the model and check assumptions, measurement conditions and the diagnostic factor.
steps.check: 交出「高深寬比開口」的正常／異常比較、可觀察量與一項仍未確定事項；必須解釋「蝕刻停止可發生在孔底而孔口正常」如何改變前一步的判讀。
steps.checkEn: Submit a normal/fault comparison for High-aspect-ratio openings, its observable and one remaining uncertainty. Explain how "Bottom etch stop can coexist with normal openings" changes interpretation of the preceding artifact.

knowledge.title: 高深寬比開口／物理與模型
knowledge.text: 診斷機制：蝕刻停止可發生在孔底而孔口正常。
knowledge.textEn: Diagnostic mechanism: Bottom etch stop can coexist with normal openings.

knowledge.title: 高深寬比開口／驗證與限制
knowledge.text: 可證偽性：「量到孔口正確就判定整孔合格」與「孔口尺寸不能完整描述深孔形貌」不可混為同一推論；對照需能觀察兩者的差別。
knowledge.textEn: Falsifiability: "Accepting the whole hole from the opening CD" is not equivalent to "Opening CD does not fully describe a deep feature"; the control must expose their difference.

quiz.question: 檢查「高深寬比開口」時，哪個新增因素應納入？
quiz.questionEn: Which additional factor belongs in a check of High-aspect-ratio openings?
options: 把 ALD 名稱當成百分百深孔均勻的保證

Accepting the whole hole from the opening CD
quiz.explanation: 蝕刻停止可發生在孔底而孔口正常；錯誤主張的問題是未保留必要條件或機制。
quiz.explanationEn: Bottom etch stop can coexist with normal openings. The competing claim omits a necessary condition or mechanism.

steps.checkEn: Submit the Sidewall conformality diagram/table or calculation with units and at least one assumption, tracing inputs to outputs and explaining: Surface-limited reactions still need precursor access to depth.

knowledge.title: 側壁共形性／物理與模型
knowledge.text: 機制：表面限制反應仍需足夠前驅物流入深處。

title: 垂直 NAND 記憶體堆疊
summary: 從垂直字串、階梯接點到良率地圖：以 12 項工程決策、24 個模型與診斷工作包建立證據。
summaryEn: From Vertical strings and Staircase contacts to Yield map: build evidence through twelve engineering decisions and twenty-four modeling/diagnostic work packages.
scope: 公開原理的教學拆解：12 個技術主題各有模型／分析及故障／驗證兩步，共四階段 24 步。不是 24 道實際製造配方，也不是任何廠商量產流程。數值由學員自訂並標示為假設；涉及材料加工、高壓、雷射或化學品的活動僅做圖上與資料分析，不由網頁授權實機操作。
scopeEn: A public-principles educational decomposition: twelve technical topics each have a model/analysis step and a diagnosis/verification step, organized as four stages and twenty-four work packages. These are not twenty-four fabrication recipes or a manufacturer flow. Learner-selected numbers are hypothetical; materials processing, high voltage, lasers and chemicals are studied through diagrams/data, not authorized physical operation.

stages.title: 垂直字串 → 晶圓彎曲
stages.description: 把「垂直字串」「交替薄膜」「晶圓彎曲」各拆成模型與診斷兩項工作，保留可檢查成果。
stages.descriptionEn: Develop model and diagnostic deliverables for Vertical strings, Alternating films, Wafer bow.

steps.title: 垂直字串：建立模型
steps.objective: 用可檢查的成果說明「堆疊層數不同於每顆單元可儲存位元數」。
steps.objectiveEn: Demonstrate the following with inspectable work: Layer count differs from bits stored per cell.
steps.instruction:
畫穿過多層字線的通道並標示選擇閘和每層記憶單元。先標出輸入、輸出與適用假設；依圖形、計算或比較表完成推理；把估算、來源事實與待量測項分開。所有自行設定數值均標為教學假設。

具體算例（全部數值為教學假設）：假設一條 NAND 串有 64 個可儲存單元，每單元用 TLC 編碼 3 bit，原始容量為 64×3=192 bit。另有兩個選擇閘，不能計入儲存單元數；若編碼改為每單元 2 bit，則為 128 bit。未扣 ECC、備援與壞單元，也不由此推算整顆晶片密度。
steps.instructionEn:
Draw a channel through stacked wordlines with select gates and per-layer cells. Mark inputs, outputs and assumptions; complete the diagram, calculation or comparison; separate estimates, source facts and measurements still needed. Label all chosen values as hypothetical.

Worked example (all values are hypothetical teaching inputs): Assume one NAND string has 64 storage cells, each encoded as TLC with 3 bits: raw capacity is 64×3=192 bits. Two additional select gates are not storage cells. At 2 bits per cell the string has 128 raw bits. ECC, redundancy and bad cells are not deducted, and this does not determine whole-chip density.
steps.observation: 堆疊層數不同於每顆單元可儲存位元數；選擇閘與儲存單元的功能不同。
steps.observationEn: Layer count differs from bits stored per cell; Select gates differ from storage cells.
steps.failure: 若採用「把 3D 層數當成單元位元數」，先回到前一步模型，檢查假設、量測條件及本步的診斷因素。
steps.failureEn: If using the claim "Equating stack layers with bits per cell", return to the model and check assumptions, measurement conditions and the diagnostic factor.
steps.check:
提交「垂直字串」的圖表或計算、單位與至少一項假設；成果須能追溯到本步指定的輸入和輸出，並說明：堆疊層數不同於每顆單元可儲存位元數。
算例驗收：圖上分開 64 個儲存單元與兩個選擇閘，驗算 192 與 128 bit，說明層數與每單元位元數不同。
steps.checkEn:
Submit the Vertical strings diagram/table or calculation with units and at least one assumption, tracing inputs to outputs and explaining: Layer count differs from bits stored per cell.
Worked-example acceptance: Separate 64 storage cells from two select gates; verify 192 and 128 bits and distinguish layer count from bits per cell.

title: 電荷捕捉記憶體閘極工程

summaryEn: From Charge-storage layer and Trap depth to Memory-window acceptance: build evidence through twelve engineering decisions and twenty-four modeling/diagnostic work packages.
scope: 公開原理的教學拆解：12 個技術主題各有模型／分析及故障／驗證兩步，共四階段 24 步。不是 24 道實際製造配方，也不是任何廠商量產流程。數值由學員自訂並標示為假設；涉及材料加工、高壓、雷射或化學品的活動僅做圖上與資料分析，不由網頁授權實機操作。
scopeEn: A public-principles educational decomposition: twelve technical topics each have a model/analysis step and a diagnosis/verification step, organized as four stages and twenty-four work packages. These are not twenty-four fabrication recipes or a manufacturer flow. Learner-selected numbers are hypothetical; materials processing, high voltage, lasers and chemicals are studied through diagrams/data, not authorized physical operation.
