steps.title: 閘極耦合：建立模型
steps.objective: 用可檢查的成果說明「外加閘壓不全部降在穿隧層」。
steps.objectiveEn: Demonstrate the following with inspectable work: Not all gate voltage falls across the tunnel layer.
steps.instruction:
以串聯電容圖分配各層電壓，標註面積與介電常數。先標出輸入、輸出與適用假設；依圖形、計算或比較表完成推理；把估算、來源事實與待量測項分開。所有自行設定數值均標為教學假設。

具體算例（全部數值為教學假設）：假設兩層介質的面積電容相等、串聯且沒有固定或捕獲電荷，總壓降 4 V 時各分得 2 V。若其中穿隧層厚 5 nm，其平均場為 2 V/5 nm=4 MV/cm。加入捕獲電荷後原分壓模型需重算；這不是寫入電壓建議，也未計算穿隧率。
steps.instructionEn:
Use a series-capacitor diagram to divide voltage across layers with area and permittivity. Mark inputs, outputs and assumptions; complete the diagram, calculation or comparison; separate estimates, source facts and measurements still needed. Label all chosen values as hypothetical.

Worked example (all values are hypothetical teaching inputs): Assume two dielectric layers have equal areal capacitance in series with no fixed or trapped charge. A total 4 V divides into 2 V per layer. If the tunnel layer is 5 nm thick, its average field is 2 V/5 nm=4 MV/cm. Trapped charge requires recalculating voltage division. This is not a programming-voltage recommendation and does not calculate tunneling rate.
steps.observation: 外加閘壓不全部降在穿隧層；介面電荷也會改變分壓。
steps.observationEn: Not all gate voltage falls across the tunnel layer; Interface charge also changes voltage division.
steps.failure: 若採用「以總閘壓除穿隧層厚度直接算電場」，先回到前一步模型，檢查假設、量測條件及本步的診斷因素。

算例驗收：驗算 2 V 與 4 MV/cm，指出等分壓依賴等電容而非只看等厚度。
steps.checkEn:
Submit the Gate coupling diagram/table or calculation with units and at least one assumption, tracing inputs to outputs and explaining: Not all gate voltage falls across the tunnel layer.
Worked-example acceptance: Verify 2 V and 4 MV/cm; explain that equal division requires equal capacitance, not merely equal thickness.

title: 相變化記憶體製作
summary: 從相態與電阻、脈衝能量到陣列耐久度：以 12 項工程決策、24 個模型與診斷工作包建立證據。
summaryEn: From Phase and resistance and Pulse energy to Array endurance: build evidence through twelve engineering decisions and twenty-four modeling/diagnostic work packages.
scope: 公開原理的教學拆解：12 個技術主題各有模型／分析及故障／驗證兩步，共四階段 24 步。不是 24 道實際製造配方，也不是任何廠商量產流程。數值由學員自訂並標示為假設；涉及材料加工、高壓、雷射或化學品的活動僅做圖上與資料分析，不由網頁授權實機操作。
scopeEn: A public-principles educational decomposition: twelve technical topics each have a model/analysis step and a diagnosis/verification step, organized as four stages and twenty-four work packages. These are not twenty-four fabrication recipes or a manufacturer flow. Learner-selected numbers are hypothetical; materials processing, high voltage, lasers and chemicals are studied through diagrams/data, not authorized physical operation.

knowledge.title: 相態與電阻／驗證與限制

knowledge.text: 模型邊界：不可由目前成果直接推出「把高阻態都視為燒斷導線」。
knowledge.textEn: Model boundary: the current result does not establish the following claim: Treating every high-resistance state as a burnt wire.

quiz.question: 關於「相態與電阻」，哪項推論有物理依據？
quiz.questionEn: For Phase and resistance, which inference has a physical basis?
options: 電阻對比來自材料狀態而非永久斷路
把高阻態都視為燒斷導線
只比較最大脈衝幅度判斷最終相態
optionsEn: Resistance contrast reflects material state, not necessarily permanent rupture
Treating every high-resistance state as a burnt wire
Judging final phase from maximum pulse amplitude alone
quiz.explanation: 電阻對比來自材料狀態而非永久斷路；錯誤主張的問題是未保留必要條件或機制。
quiz.explanationEn: Resistance contrast reflects material state, not necessarily permanent rupture. The competing claim omits a necessary condition or mechanism.

steps.title: 相態與電阻：故障判讀與驗證
steps.titleEn: Phase and resistance: diagnose and verify
steps.objective: 以新增對照檢查「把高阻態都視為燒斷導線」這項錯誤主張。
steps.objectiveEn: Test the faulty claim: Treating every high-resistance state as a burnt wire.
steps.instruction: 接續前一步「相態與電阻」成果，先指出錯誤主張「把高阻態都視為燒斷導線」漏掉哪個條件。新增診斷原理：電阻讀取應避免再次加熱改態。據此設計一組正常與異常對照；指定可區分兩者的觀察量、取樣位置或時間；寫下證據不足時應保留的未決結論。不得虛構實測數字。
steps.instructionEn: Continue the preceding Phase and resistance artifact. Identify the missing condition in the faulty claim "Treating every high-resistance state as a burnt wire". Introduce this diagnostic principle: Read bias should avoid reheating the state. Design normal/fault controls; specify a distinguishing observable, sampling location or time; state what remains undecided without evidence. Do not fabricate measurements.
steps.observation: 電阻對比來自材料狀態而非永久斷路；電阻讀取應避免再次加熱改態。
steps.observationEn: Resistance contrast reflects material state, not necessarily permanent rupture; Read bias should avoid reheating the state.
steps.failure: 若採用「把高阻態都視為燒斷導線」，先回到前一步模型，檢查假設、量測條件及本步的診斷因素。
steps.failureEn: If using the claim "Treating every high-resistance state as a burnt wire", return to the model and check assumptions, measurement conditions and the diagnostic factor.
steps.check: 交出「相態與電阻」的正常／異常比較、可觀察量與一項仍未確定事項；必須解釋「電阻讀取應避免再次加熱改態」如何改變前一步的判讀。
steps.checkEn: Submit a normal/fault comparison for Phase and resistance, its observable and one remaining uncertainty. Explain how "Read bias should avoid reheating the state" changes interpretation of the preceding artifact.

steps.title: SET 與 RESET：建立模型
steps.titleEn: SET and RESET: construct and analyze
steps.objective: 用可檢查的成果說明「峰值溫度與冷卻歷史共同決定相態」。
steps.objectiveEn: Demonstrate the following with inspectable work: Peak temperature and cooling history jointly determine phase.
steps.instruction: 畫結晶保溫與熔融後快冷的概念溫度時間曲線。先標出輸入、輸出與適用假設；依圖形、計算或比較表完成推理；把估算、來源事實與待量測項分開。所有自行設定數值均標為教學假設。
steps.instructionEn: Draw conceptual crystallizing dwell and melt-quench temperature trajectories. Mark inputs, outputs and assumptions; complete the diagram, calculation or comparison; separate estimates, source facts and measurements still needed. Label all chosen values as hypothetical.
steps.observation: 峰值溫度與冷卻歷史共同決定相態；冷卻速率會影響非晶化。
steps.observationEn: Peak temperature and cooling history jointly determine phase; Cooling rate affects amorphization.
steps.failure: 若採用「只比較最大脈衝幅度判斷最終相態」，先回到前一步模型，檢查假設、量測條件及本步的診斷因素。
steps.failureEn: If using the claim "Judging final phase from maximum pulse amplitude alone", return to the model and check assumptions, measurement conditions and the diagnostic factor.
steps.check: 提交「SET 與 RESET」的圖表或計算、單位與至少一項假設；成果須能追溯到本步指定的輸入和輸出，並說明：峰值溫度與冷卻歷史共同決定相態。
steps.checkEn: Submit the SET and RESET diagram/table or calculation with units and at least one assumption, tracing inputs to outputs and explaining: Peak temperature and cooling history jointly determine phase.

steps.title: 脈衝能量：建立模型
steps.objective: 用可檢查的成果說明「相同能量不同時間形狀可形成不同溫度軌跡」。

steps.instruction:

具體算例（全部數值為教學假設）：假設在 PCM 元件端量到理想矩形脈衝，V=2 V、I=0.5 mA、持續 20 ns，電能 E=VIt=20 pJ。保持 V、I 不變而時間加倍，電能為 40 pJ。這不等於材料吸收熱量，亦不能證明 RESET；熱損失、脈衝邊緣及動態電阻另需量測。
steps.instructionEn:
Integrate hypothetical V(t)I(t) and distinguish peak power from total energy. Mark inputs, outputs and assumptions; complete the diagram, calculation or comparison; separate estimates, source facts and measurements still needed. Label all chosen values as hypothetical.

Worked example (all values are hypothetical teaching inputs): Assume an ideal rectangular pulse measured at a PCM device: V=2 V, I=0.5 mA for 20 ns. Electrical energy E=VIt=20 pJ; doubling duration at fixed V and I gives 40 pJ. This is not absorbed material heat and does not prove RESET; thermal loss, pulse edges and dynamic resistance need separate evidence.
steps.observation: 相同能量不同時間形狀可形成不同溫度軌跡；波形線纜損失會改變晶片實際脈衝。
steps.observationEn: Equal energies with different shapes can yield different thermal histories; Cable loss changes the actual die pulse.

steps.failureEn: If using the claim "Equating joules with identical material states", return to the model and check assumptions, measurement conditions and the diagnostic factor.
steps.check:

算例驗收：以瓦特與秒核對 20 pJ，區分電能、溫度與相態三個不同量。
steps.checkEn:
Submit the Pulse energy diagram/table or calculation with units and at least one assumption, tracing inputs to outputs and explaining: Equal energies with different shapes can yield different thermal histories.
Worked-example acceptance: Check 20 pJ using watts and seconds and distinguish electrical energy, temperature and phase.

title: 磁阻式記憶體磁穿隧接面
summary: 從MTJ 分層、STT 路徑到記憶體用途：以 12 項工程決策、24 個模型與診斷工作包建立證據。
summaryEn: From MTJ stack and STT pathway to Memory application: build evidence through twelve engineering decisions and twenty-four modeling/diagnostic work packages.
scope: 公開原理的教學拆解：12 個技術主題各有模型／分析及故障／驗證兩步，共四階段 24 步。不是 24 道實際製造配方，也不是任何廠商量產流程。數值由學員自訂並標示為假設；涉及材料加工、高壓、雷射或化學品的活動僅做圖上與資料分析，不由網頁授權實機操作。
scopeEn: A public-principles educational decomposition: twelve technical topics each have a model/analysis step and a diagnosis/verification step, organized as four stages and twenty-four work packages. These are not twenty-four fabrication recipes or a manufacturer flow. Learner-selected numbers are hypothetical; materials processing, high voltage, lasers and chemicals are studied through diagrams/data, not authorized physical operation.

steps.title: TMR 定義：建立模型
steps.objective: 用可檢查的成果說明「電阻比的分母必須一致」。
steps.objectiveEn: Demonstrate the following with inspectable work: The resistance-ratio denominator must be consistent.
steps.instruction:
以假設 RP、RAP 計算 (RAP-RP)/RP 並註明慣例。先標出輸入、輸出與適用假設；依圖形、計算或比較表完成推理；把估算、來源事實與待量測項分開。所有自行設定數值均標為教學假設。

具體算例（全部數值為教學假設）：假設同一偏壓與溫度下 MTJ 平行電阻 RP=5 kΩ、反平行 RAP=10 kΩ，TMR=(RAP−RP)/RP=100%。若錯用 RAP 當分母會得到 50%。本例不含讀取電路雜訊或電阻分布，不能由平均 TMR 直接宣告可靠讀取。
steps.instructionEn:
Compute (RAP-RP)/RP from hypothetical values with the convention stated. Mark inputs, outputs and assumptions; complete the diagram, calculation or comparison; separate estimates, source facts and measurements still needed. Label all chosen values as hypothetical.

Worked example (all values are hypothetical teaching inputs): Assume MTJ resistances measured at the same bias and temperature are RP=5 kΩ and RAP=10 kΩ. TMR=(RAP−RP)/RP=100%; incorrectly using RAP as denominator gives 50%. Noise and resistance distributions are absent, so mean TMR does not establish reliable reading.
steps.observation: 電阻比的分母必須一致；RA 需註明有效接面面積。
steps.observationEn: The resistance-ratio denominator must be consistent; Resistance-area values need effective junction area.
steps.failure: 若採用「不註明分母便比較不同 TMR 百分比」，先回到前一步模型，檢查假設、量測條件及本步的診斷因素。

算例驗收：驗算 100%，標示分母 RP，並畫出兩態分布可能重疊的情況。
steps.checkEn:
Submit the TMR definition diagram/table or calculation with units and at least one assumption, tracing inputs to outputs and explaining: The resistance-ratio denominator must be consistent.
Worked-example acceptance: Verify 100%, label RP as denominator and sketch a possible overlap of the two state distributions.

title: 電阻式記憶體製作
summary: 從阻變截面、SET 與 RESET到權重漂移：以 12 項工程決策、24 個模型與診斷工作包建立證據。
summaryEn: From Resistive-switching section and SET and RESET to Weight drift: build evidence through twelve engineering decisions and twenty-four modeling/diagnostic work packages.
scope: 公開原理的教學拆解：12 個技術主題各有模型／分析及故障／驗證兩步，共四階段 24 步。不是 24 道實際製造配方，也不是任何廠商量產流程。數值由學員自訂並標示為假設；涉及材料加工、高壓、雷射或化學品的活動僅做圖上與資料分析，不由網頁授權實機操作。
scopeEn: A public-principles educational decomposition: twelve technical topics each have a model/analysis step and a diagnosis/verification step, organized as four stages and twenty-four work packages. These are not twenty-four fabrication recipes or a manufacturer flow. Learner-selected numbers are hypothetical; materials processing, high voltage, lasers and chemicals are studied through diagrams/data, not authorized physical operation.

stages.title: 阻變截面 → 電流限制

stages.descriptionEn: Develop model and diagnostic deliverables for Resistive-switching section, Electroforming, Current compliance.

steps.title: 阻變截面：建立模型
steps.objective: 用可檢查的成果說明「不同 RRAM 材料系統未必使用同一機制」。
steps.objectiveEn: Demonstrate the following with inspectable work: Different RRAM material systems need not share one mechanism.
steps.instruction: 畫兩電極與氧化物，標出細絲型假說及不適用的均勻模型。先標出輸入、輸出與適用假設；依圖形、計算或比較表完成推理；把估算、來源事實與待量測項分開。所有自行設定數值均標為教學假設。
steps.instructionEn: Draw electrodes/oxide and label filamentary assumptions versus uniform switching. Mark inputs, outputs and assumptions; complete the diagram, calculation or comparison; separate estimates, source facts and measurements still needed. Label all chosen values as hypothetical.
steps.observation: 不同 RRAM 材料系統未必使用同一機制；電極活性會改變離子交換。
steps.observationEn: Different RRAM material systems need not share one mechanism; Electrode reactivity changes ion exchange.
steps.failure: 若採用「把所有阻變元件都視為金屬熔斷」，先回到前一步模型，檢查假設、量測條件及本步的診斷因素。
steps.failureEn: If using the claim "Treating all resistive switches as metal fuses", return to the model and check assumptions, measurement conditions and the diagnostic factor.
steps.check: 提交「阻變截面」的圖表或計算、單位與至少一項假設；成果須能追溯到本步指定的輸入和輸出，並說明：不同 RRAM 材料系統未必使用同一機制。
steps.checkEn: Submit the Resistive-switching section diagram/table or calculation with units and at least one assumption, tracing inputs to outputs and explaining: Different RRAM material systems need not share one mechanism.

knowledge.title: 阻變截面／物理與模型
knowledge.text: 機制：不同 RRAM 材料系統未必使用同一機制。
knowledge.textEn: Mechanism: Different RRAM material systems need not share one mechanism.

knowledge.title: 阻變截面／驗證與限制
knowledge.text: 模型邊界：不可由目前成果直接推出「把所有阻變元件都視為金屬熔斷」。
knowledge.textEn: Model boundary: the current result does not establish the following claim: Treating all resistive switches as metal fuses.

steps.title: 阻變截面：故障判讀與驗證

steps.instructionEn: Continue the preceding Resistive-switching section artifact. Identify the missing condition in the faulty claim "Treating all resistive switches as metal fuses". Introduce this diagnostic principle: Electrode reactivity changes ion exchange. Design normal/fault controls; specify a distinguishing observable, sampling location or time; state what remains undecided without evidence. Do not fabricate measurements.

steps.title: 交叉陣列：建立模型
steps.objective: 用可檢查的成果說明「陣列輸出不只由單元導電值決定」。
steps.objectiveEn: Demonstrate the following with inspectable work: Array output depends on more than cell conductance.
steps.instruction:
用小型電阻矩陣計算理想列電流，再加入線阻和偷流。先標出輸入、輸出與適用假設；依圖形、計算或比較表完成推理；把估算、來源事實與待量測項分開。所有自行設定數值均標為教學假設。

具體算例（全部數值為教學假設）：假設理想交叉陣列的一個求和節點具有 G1=10 µS、G2=20 µS，輸入 V1=0.1 V、V2=0.2 V。兩支路電流為 1 與 4 µA，總和 5 µA。請依 I=ΣGV 列式；線阻、非線性、偷漏路徑與 ADC 誤差均未納入，結果不是實際神經網路精度。
steps.instructionEn:
Compute ideal column current for a small conductance matrix, then add line resistance/sneak paths. Mark inputs, outputs and assumptions; complete the diagram, calculation or comparison; separate estimates, source facts and measurements still needed. Label all chosen values as hypothetical.

Worked example (all values are hypothetical teaching inputs): Assume an ideal crossbar summing node with G1=10 µS, G2=20 µS and inputs V1=0.1 V, V2=0.2 V. Branch currents are 1 and 4 µA, totaling 5 µA by I=ΣGV. Line resistance, nonlinearity, sneak paths and ADC errors are excluded; the result is not real neural-network accuracy.
steps.observation: 陣列輸出不只由單元導電值決定；列電壓因線阻而沿線下降。
steps.observationEn: Array output depends on more than cell conductance; Line resistance changes local column voltages.
steps.failure: 若採用「單元線性就假定整陣列乘法精確」，先回到前一步模型，檢查假設、量測條件及本步的診斷因素。
steps.failureEn: If using the claim "Assuming linear cells guarantee exact array multiplication", return to the model and check assumptions, measurement conditions and the diagnostic factor.
steps.check:
提交「交叉陣列」的圖表或計算、單位與至少一項假設；成果須能追溯到本步指定的輸入和輸出，並說明：陣列輸出不只由單元導電值決定。
算例驗收：驗算兩支路與 5 µA 總和，並在電路圖上加一個可能破壞理想求和的寄生元件。
steps.checkEn:
Submit the Crossbar array diagram/table or calculation with units and at least one assumption, tracing inputs to outputs and explaining: Array output depends on more than cell conductance.
Worked-example acceptance: Verify the branch currents and 5 µA sum, then add a parasitic element that could break ideal summation.

steps.title: 交叉陣列：故障判讀與驗證

steps.objectiveEn: Test the faulty claim: Assuming linear cells guarantee exact array multiplication.
steps.instruction: 接續前一步「交叉陣列」成果，先指出錯誤主張「單元線性就假定整陣列乘法精確」漏掉哪個條件。新增診斷原理：列電壓因線阻而沿線下降。據此設計一組正常與異常對照；指定可區分兩者的觀察量、取樣位置或時間；寫下證據不足時應保留的未決結論。不得虛構實測數字。
steps.instructionEn: Continue the preceding Crossbar array artifact. Identify the missing condition in the faulty claim "Assuming linear cells guarantee exact array multiplication". Introduce this diagnostic principle: Line resistance changes local column voltages. Design normal/fault controls; specify a distinguishing observable, sampling location or time; state what remains undecided without evidence. Do not fabricate measurements.
steps.observation: 陣列輸出不只由單元導電值決定；列電壓因線阻而沿線下降。

steps.failureEn: If using the claim "Assuming linear cells guarantee exact array multiplication", return to the model and check assumptions, measurement conditions and the diagnostic factor.
steps.check: 交出「交叉陣列」的正常／異常比較、可觀察量與一項仍未確定事項；必須解釋「列電壓因線阻而沿線下降」如何改變前一步的判讀。
steps.checkEn: Submit a normal/fault comparison for Crossbar array, its observable and one remaining uncertainty. Explain how "Line resistance changes local column voltages" changes interpretation of the preceding artifact.

knowledge.title: 交叉陣列／驗證與限制
knowledge.text: 可證偽性：「單元線性就假定整陣列乘法精確」與「陣列輸出不只由單元導電值決定」不可混為同一推論；對照需能觀察兩者的差別。

title: 鐵電記憶體氧化鉿薄膜
titleEn: Hafnia thin films for ferroelectric memory
summary: 從晶相與鐵電性、摻雜與比例到整合證據：以 12 項工程決策、24 個模型與診斷工作包建立證據。
summaryEn: From Phase and ferroelectricity and Dopants and composition to Integration evidence: build evidence through twelve engineering decisions and twenty-four modeling/diagnostic work packages.
scope: 公開原理的教學拆解：12 個技術主題各有模型／分析及故障／驗證兩步，共四階段 24 步。不是 24 道實際製造配方，也不是任何廠商量產流程。數值由學員自訂並標示為假設；涉及材料加工、高壓、雷射或化學品的活動僅做圖上與資料分析，不由網頁授權實機操作。
scopeEn: A public-principles educational decomposition: twelve technical topics each have a model/analysis step and a diagnosis/verification step, organized as four stages and twenty-four work packages. These are not twenty-four fabrication recipes or a manufacturer flow. Learner-selected numbers are hypothetical; materials processing, high voltage, lasers and chemicals are studied through diagrams/data, not authorized physical operation.

steps.title: 厚度與場：建立模型

steps.objective: 用可檢查的成果說明「相同電壓對不同膜厚並非相同應力」。
steps.objectiveEn: Demonstrate the following with inspectable work: Equal voltage across different thicknesses is not equal stress.
steps.instruction:
將假設施加電壓轉為場，分開物理膜厚與介面分壓。先標出輸入、輸出與適用假設；依圖形、計算或比較表完成推理；把估算、來源事實與待量測項分開。所有自行設定數值均標為教學假設。

具體算例（全部數值為教學假設）：假設均勻 HZO 薄膜厚 10 nm，真正跨薄膜電壓為 1 V，平均場 E=1 MV/cm；改為 20 nm 則為 0.5 MV/cm。這個換算不能證明鐵電性或矯頑場；介面層分壓、漏電和量測波形需另外檢查。
steps.instructionEn:
Convert hypothetical voltage to field while separating film thickness/interface division. Mark inputs, outputs and assumptions; complete the diagram, calculation or comparison; separate estimates, source facts and measurements still needed. Label all chosen values as hypothetical.

Worked example (all values are hypothetical teaching inputs): Assume a uniform 10 nm HZO film with an actual 1 V drop: average E=1 MV/cm; at 20 nm it is 0.5 MV/cm. This conversion does not demonstrate ferroelectricity or a coercive field; interface voltage division, leakage and the measurement waveform require separate checks.
steps.observation: 相同電壓對不同膜厚並非相同應力；局部薄點的電場高於平均。
steps.observationEn: Equal voltage across different thicknesses is not equal stress; Local thin spots have higher fields.
steps.failure: 若採用「用電壓相同就宣稱不同厚度測試公平」，先回到前一步模型，檢查假設、量測條件及本步的診斷因素。
steps.failureEn: If using the claim "Claiming fair thickness comparison from equal voltage", return to the model and check assumptions, measurement conditions and the diagnostic factor.
steps.check:
提交「厚度與場」的圖表或計算、單位與至少一項假設；成果須能追溯到本步指定的輸入和輸出，並說明：相同電壓對不同膜厚並非相同應力。
算例驗收：驗算兩個場值並指出要驗證可切換極化仍需要哪類對照量測。
steps.checkEn:
Submit the Thickness and field diagram/table or calculation with units and at least one assumption, tracing inputs to outputs and explaining: Equal voltage across different thicknesses is not equal stress.
Worked-example acceptance: Verify both fields and identify a control measurement still needed to establish switchable polarization.

steps.objectiveEn: Demonstrate the following with inspectable work: Phase stabilization and leakage need joint assessment.
steps.instruction: 以假設 Hf/Zr 比例矩陣規劃結構、極化和漏電共同量測。先標出輸入、輸出與適用假設；依圖形、計算或比較表完成推理；把估算、來源事實與待量測項分開。所有自行設定數值均標為教學假設。
steps.instructionEn: Plan structural, polarization and leakage measurements over hypothetical Hf/Zr ratios. Mark inputs, outputs and assumptions; complete the diagram, calculation or comparison; separate estimates, source facts and measurements still needed. Label all chosen values as hypothetical.
steps.observation: 相穩定化和漏電必須共同評估；晶粒尺寸也可能影響相穩定。
steps.observationEn: Phase stabilization and leakage need joint assessment; Grain size can affect phase stability.
steps.failure: 若採用「只最大化剩餘極化而不看漏電」，先回到前一步模型，檢查假設、量測條件及本步的診斷因素。
steps.failureEn: If using the claim "Maximizing remanence without examining leakage", return to the model and check assumptions, measurement conditions and the diagnostic factor.
steps.check: 提交「摻雜與比例」的圖表或計算、單位與至少一項假設；成果須能追溯到本步指定的輸入和輸出，並說明：相穩定化和漏電必須共同評估。
steps.checkEn: Submit the Dopants and composition diagram/table or calculation with units and at least one assumption, tracing inputs to outputs and explaining: Phase stabilization and leakage need joint assessment.

knowledge.textEn: Model boundary: the current result does not establish the following claim: Maximizing remanence without examining leakage.

quiz.question: 關於「摻雜與比例」，哪項推論有物理依據？
quiz.questionEn: For Dopants and composition, which inference has a physical basis?
options: 只最大化剩餘極化而不看漏電
更換電極只計算片電阻變化
相穩定化和漏電必須共同評估
optionsEn: Maximizing remanence without examining leakage
Considering only sheet resistance when changing electrodes
Phase stabilization and leakage need joint assessment
quiz.explanation: 相穩定化和漏電必須共同評估；錯誤主張的問題是未保留必要條件或機制。
quiz.explanationEn: Phase stabilization and leakage need joint assessment. The competing claim omits a necessary condition or mechanism.

steps.title: 摻雜與比例：故障判讀與驗證
steps.titleEn: Dopants and composition: diagnose and verify
steps.objective: 以新增對照檢查「只最大化剩餘極化而不看漏電」這項錯誤主張。
steps.objectiveEn: Test the faulty claim: Maximizing remanence without examining leakage.
steps.instruction: 接續前一步「摻雜與比例」成果，先指出錯誤主張「只最大化剩餘極化而不看漏電」漏掉哪個條件。新增診斷原理：晶粒尺寸也可能影響相穩定。據此設計一組正常與異常對照；指定可區分兩者的觀察量、取樣位置或時間；寫下證據不足時應保留的未決結論。不得虛構實測數字。
steps.instructionEn: Continue the preceding Dopants and composition artifact. Identify the missing condition in the faulty claim "Maximizing remanence without examining leakage". Introduce this diagnostic principle: Grain size can affect phase stability. Design normal/fault controls; specify a distinguishing observable, sampling location or time; state what remains undecided without evidence. Do not fabricate measurements.
steps.observation: 相穩定化和漏電必須共同評估；晶粒尺寸也可能影響相穩定。
steps.observationEn: Phase stabilization and leakage need joint assessment; Grain size can affect phase stability.
steps.failure: 若採用「只最大化剩餘極化而不看漏電」，先回到前一步模型，檢查假設、量測條件及本步的診斷因素。
steps.failureEn: If using the claim "Maximizing remanence without examining leakage", return to the model and check assumptions, measurement conditions and the diagnostic factor.
steps.check: 交出「摻雜與比例」的正常／異常比較、可觀察量與一項仍未確定事項；必須解釋「晶粒尺寸也可能影響相穩定」如何改變前一步的判讀。
steps.checkEn: Submit a normal/fault comparison for Dopants and composition, its observable and one remaining uncertainty. Explain how "Grain size can affect phase stability" changes interpretation of the preceding artifact.

title: CMOS 影像感測器製作
summary: 從像素訊號鏈、完整電荷轉移到感測器驗收：以 12 項工程決策、24 個模型與診斷工作包建立證據。
summaryEn: From Pixel signal chain and Complete charge transfer to Sensor acceptance: build evidence through twelve engineering decisions and twenty-four modeling/diagnostic work packages.
scope: 公開原理的教學拆解：12 個技術主題各有模型／分析及故障／驗證兩步，共四階段 24 步。不是 24 道實際製造配方，也不是任何廠商量產流程。數值由學員自訂並標示為假設；涉及材料加工、高壓、雷射或化學品的活動僅做圖上與資料分析，不由網頁授權實機操作。
scopeEn: A public-principles educational decomposition: twelve technical topics each have a model/analysis step and a diagnosis/verification step, organized as four stages and twenty-four work packages. These are not twenty-four fabrication recipes or a manufacturer flow. Learner-selected numbers are hypothetical; materials processing, high voltage, lasers and chemicals are studied through diagrams/data, not authorized physical operation.

steps.objective: 用可檢查的成果說明「更高電壓轉換增益不等於更高滿井容量」。
steps.objectiveEn: Demonstrate the following with inspectable work: Higher voltage conversion gain does not imply greater full well.
steps.instruction:
用假設浮接電容算 ΔV=Q/C，比較訊號增益和容量需求。先標出輸入、輸出與適用假設；依圖形、計算或比較表完成推理；把估算、來源事實與待量測項分開。所有自行設定數值均標為教學假設。

具體算例（全部數值為教學假設）：假設 1,000 個電子完整轉移到 10 fF 的感測節點，q=1.602×10⁻¹⁹ C，Q=1.602×10⁻¹⁶ C，電壓變化幅度 ΔV=Q/C=16.02 mV。若電容增為 20 fF，幅度為 8.01 mV。忽略寄生、漏失與放大器增益；這不是滿井容量或量子效率。
steps.instructionEn:
Use hypothetical floating-node capacitance to compare ΔV=Q/C and capacity. Mark inputs, outputs and assumptions; complete the diagram, calculation or comparison; separate estimates, source facts and measurements still needed. Label all chosen values as hypothetical.

Worked example (all values are hypothetical teaching inputs): Assume 1,000 electrons transfer completely to a 10 fF sense node. With q=1.602×10⁻¹⁹ C, Q=1.602×10⁻¹⁶ C and voltage-change magnitude ΔV=Q/C=16.02 mV. At 20 fF it becomes 8.01 mV. Parasitics, charge loss and amplifier gain are excluded; this is neither full-well capacity nor quantum efficiency.
steps.observation: 更高電壓轉換增益不等於更高滿井容量；讀噪需換算到同一電子或電壓單位。
steps.observationEn: Higher voltage conversion gain does not imply greater full well; Read noise needs consistent electron or voltage units.

steps.failureEn: If using the claim "Representing dynamic range by gain alone", return to the model and check assumptions, measurement conditions and the diagnostic factor.

knowledge.title: 飽和與轉換增益／驗證與限制
knowledge.titleEn: Saturation and conversion gain / Verification and limits
knowledge.text:
模型邊界：不可由目前成果直接推出「用單一增益數值代表動態範圍」。
假設數值與推算：假設 1,000 個電子完整轉移到 10 fF 的感測節點，q=1.602×10⁻¹⁹ C，Q=1.602×10⁻¹⁶ C，電壓變化幅度 ΔV=Q/C=16.02 mV。若電容增為 20 fF，幅度為 8.01 mV。忽略寄生、漏失與放大器增益；這不是滿井容量或量子效率。
knowledge.textEn:
Model boundary: the current result does not establish the following claim: Representing dynamic range by gain alone.
Hypothetical inputs and calculation: Assume 1,000 electrons transfer completely to a 10 fF sense node. With q=1.602×10⁻¹⁹ C, Q=1.602×10⁻¹⁶ C and voltage-change magnitude ΔV=Q/C=16.02 mV. At 20 fF it becomes 8.01 mV. Parasitics, charge loss and amplifier gain are excluded; this is neither full-well capacity nor quantum efficiency.

title: 雪崩光二極體製作
summary: 從吸收與倍增、暗電流來源到偵測系統：以 12 項工程決策、24 個模型與診斷工作包建立證據。
summaryEn: From Absorption and multiplication and Dark-current sources to Detection system: build evidence through twelve engineering decisions and twenty-four modeling/diagnostic work packages.
scope: 公開原理的教學拆解：12 個技術主題各有模型／分析及故障／驗證兩步，共四階段 24 步。不是 24 道實際製造配方，也不是任何廠商量產流程。數值由學員自訂並標示為假設；涉及材料加工、高壓、雷射或化學品的活動僅做圖上與資料分析，不由網頁授權實機操作。
scopeEn: A public-principles educational decomposition: twelve technical topics each have a model/analysis step and a diagnosis/verification step, organized as four stages and twenty-four work packages. These are not twenty-four fabrication recipes or a manufacturer flow. Learner-selected numbers are hypothetical; materials processing, high voltage, lasers and chemicals are studied through diagrams/data, not authorized physical operation.

stages.title: 吸收與倍增 → 場形塑

stages.descriptionEn: Develop model and diagnostic deliverables for Absorption and multiplication, Linear mode, Field shaping.

steps.title: 吸收與倍增：建立模型

steps.objective: 用可檢查的成果說明「光吸收與雪崩倍增可有不同空間要求」。
steps.objectiveEn: Demonstrate the following with inspectable work: Absorption and avalanche multiplication have different spatial requirements.
steps.instruction: 畫吸收區與高電場倍增區，追蹤一對光生載子。先標出輸入、輸出與適用假設；依圖形、計算或比較表完成推理；把估算、來源事實與待量測項分開。所有自行設定數值均標為教學假設。
steps.instructionEn: Draw absorption/multiplication regions and track a photogenerated pair. Mark inputs, outputs and assumptions; complete the diagram, calculation or comparison; separate estimates, source facts and measurements still needed. Label all chosen values as hypothetical.
steps.observation: 光吸收與雪崩倍增可有不同空間要求；電子和電洞游離率可能不同。
steps.observationEn: Absorption and avalanche multiplication have different spatial requirements; Electron and hole ionization rates can differ.
steps.failure: 若採用「把整個元件都畫成相同高場」，先回到前一步模型，檢查假設、量測條件及本步的診斷因素。
steps.failureEn: If using the claim "Drawing uniform high field throughout the device", return to the model and check assumptions, measurement conditions and the diagnostic factor.
steps.check: 提交「吸收與倍增」的圖表或計算、單位與至少一項假設；成果須能追溯到本步指定的輸入和輸出，並說明：光吸收與雪崩倍增可有不同空間要求。
steps.checkEn: Submit the Absorption and multiplication diagram/table or calculation with units and at least one assumption, tracing inputs to outputs and explaining: Absorption and avalanche multiplication have different spatial requirements.

steps.title: 吸收與倍增：故障判讀與驗證

steps.objective: 以新增對照檢查「把整個元件都畫成相同高場」這項錯誤主張。
steps.objectiveEn: Test the faulty claim: Drawing uniform high field throughout the device.

steps.instructionEn: Continue the preceding Absorption and multiplication artifact. Identify the missing condition in the faulty claim "Drawing uniform high field throughout the device". Introduce this diagnostic principle: Electron and hole ionization rates can differ. Design normal/fault controls; specify a distinguishing observable, sampling location or time; state what remains undecided without evidence. Do not fabricate measurements.
steps.observation: 光吸收與雪崩倍增可有不同空間要求；電子和電洞游離率可能不同。
steps.observationEn: Absorption and avalanche multiplication have different spatial requirements; Electron and hole ionization rates can differ.
steps.failure: 若採用「把整個元件都畫成相同高場」，先回到前一步模型，檢查假設、量測條件及本步的診斷因素。
steps.failureEn: If using the claim "Drawing uniform high field throughout the device", return to the model and check assumptions, measurement conditions and the diagnostic factor.
steps.check: 交出「吸收與倍增」的正常／異常比較、可觀察量與一項仍未確定事項；必須解釋「電子和電洞游離率可能不同」如何改變前一步的判讀。
steps.checkEn: Submit a normal/fault comparison for Absorption and multiplication, its observable and one remaining uncertainty. Explain how "Electron and hole ionization rates can differ" changes interpretation of the preceding artifact.

具體算例（全部數值為教學假設）：假設相同光通量下，已扣暗電流的單位增益參考光電流為 10 nA，工作偏壓下為 200 nA，雪崩增益 M=200/10=20。若未扣暗電流便用總電流相除，可能偏差。此例假定參考確為 M=1，且不提供過剩雜訊或擊穿電壓資訊。
steps.instructionEn:
Compare low-gain and operating currents at equal flux with dark subtraction. Mark inputs, outputs and assumptions; complete the diagram, calculation or comparison; separate estimates, source facts and measurements still needed. Label all chosen values as hypothetical.

Worked example (all values are hypothetical teaching inputs): Assume equal photon flux and dark-subtracted photocurrents of 10 nA at a unit-gain reference and 200 nA at operating bias. Avalanche gain M=200/10=20. Dividing total currents without dark subtraction can bias gain. The reference is assumed to have M=1; the example does not determine excess noise or breakdown voltage.
steps.observation: 光源漂移會混入增益估計；低偏壓參考仍需確認收集效率。

title: 單光子雪崩二極體陣列
summary: 從Geiger 觸發、後脈衝到熱點像素：以 12 項工程決策、24 個模型與診斷工作包建立證據。
summaryEn: From Geiger triggering and Afterpulsing to Hot pixels: build evidence through twelve engineering decisions and twenty-four modeling/diagnostic work packages.
scope: 公開原理的教學拆解：12 個技術主題各有模型／分析及故障／驗證兩步，共四階段 24 步。不是 24 道實際製造配方，也不是任何廠商量產流程。數值由學員自訂並標示為假設；涉及材料加工、高壓、雷射或化學品的活動僅做圖上與資料分析，不由網頁授權實機操作。
scopeEn: A public-principles educational decomposition: twelve technical topics each have a model/analysis step and a diagnosis/verification step, organized as four stages and twenty-four work packages. These are not twenty-four fabrication recipes or a manufacturer flow. Learner-selected numbers are hypothetical; materials processing, high voltage, lasers and chemicals are studied through diagrams/data, not authorized physical operation.

steps.title: 直接飛行時間：建立模型
steps.titleEn: Direct time of flight: construct and analyze
steps.objective: 用可檢查的成果說明「往返飛行時間須除以二」。
steps.objectiveEn: Demonstrate the following with inspectable work: Round-trip flight time requires a factor of two.
steps.instruction:
用 d=cΔt/2 算假設距離並扣除電子延遲。先標出輸入、輸出與適用假設；依圖形、計算或比較表完成推理；把估算、來源事實與待量測項分開。所有自行設定數值均標為教學假設。

具體算例（全部數值為教學假設）：假設直接 ToF 系統已扣除電子延遲，測得往返時間 10 ns，取 c=3×10⁸ m/s，距離 d=ct/2=1.5 m。若時間誤差為 1 ns，對應距離誤差幅度 0.15 m。未處理多重路徑、光子統計及介質折射率；不可省略往返的二分之一。
steps.instructionEn:
Compute hypothetical d=cΔt/2 after subtracting electronic delay. Mark inputs, outputs and assumptions; complete the diagram, calculation or comparison; separate estimates, source facts and measurements still needed. Label all chosen values as hypothetical.

Worked example (all values are hypothetical teaching inputs): Assume a direct-ToF system has removed electronic delay and measures a 10 ns round trip. With c=3×10⁸ m/s, d=ct/2=1.5 m. A 1 ns timing-error magnitude corresponds to 0.15 m. Multipath, photon statistics and medium refractive index are excluded; the round-trip factor of one-half is essential.
steps.observation: 往返飛行時間須除以二；多重反射會產生多個距離峰。
steps.observationEn: Round-trip flight time requires a factor of two; Multipath produces multiple range peaks.
steps.failure: 若採用「直接用 cΔt 作為單程距離」，先回到前一步模型，檢查假設、量測條件及本步的診斷因素。
steps.failureEn: If using the claim "Using cΔt as one-way distance", return to the model and check assumptions, measurement conditions and the diagnostic factor.
steps.check:
提交「直接飛行時間」的圖表或計算、單位與至少一項假設；成果須能追溯到本步指定的輸入和輸出，並說明：往返飛行時間須除以二。
算例驗收：驗算 1.5 m 與 0.15 m，畫出發射及返回兩段光路。
steps.checkEn:
Submit the Direct time of flight diagram/table or calculation with units and at least one assumption, tracing inputs to outputs and explaining: Round-trip flight time requires a factor of two.
Worked-example acceptance: Verify 1.5 m and 0.15 m and draw the outgoing and returning optical paths.

steps.title: 熱點像素：故障判讀與驗證

title: 碳化矽磊晶與缺陷控制
summary: 從多型與基板、穿通差排到磊晶放行：以 12 項工程決策、24 個模型與診斷工作包建立證據。
summaryEn: From Polytype and substrate and Threading dislocations to Epitaxy release: build evidence through twelve engineering decisions and twenty-four modeling/diagnostic work packages.
scope: 公開原理的教學拆解：12 個技術主題各有模型／分析及故障／驗證兩步，共四階段 24 步。不是 24 道實際製造配方，也不是任何廠商量產流程。數值由學員自訂並標示為假設；涉及材料加工、高壓、雷射或化學品的活動僅做圖上與資料分析，不由網頁授權實機操作。
scopeEn: A public-principles educational decomposition: twelve technical topics each have a model/analysis step and a diagnosis/verification step, organized as four stages and twenty-four work packages. These are not twenty-four fabrication recipes or a manufacturer flow. Learner-selected numbers are hypothetical; materials processing, high voltage, lasers and chemicals are studied through diagrams/data, not authorized physical operation.

steps.instructionEn: Distinguish 4H from other polytypes and label orientation/epitaxial face. Mark inputs, outputs and assumptions; complete the diagram, calculation or comparison; separate estimates, source facts and measurements still needed. Label all chosen values as hypothetical.
steps.observation: 化學成分相同不代表晶體堆疊相同；相同多型仍可能有不同晶面。
steps.observationEn: Equal chemistry does not imply identical stacking; The same polytype can have different crystal faces.
steps.failure: 若採用「只看 Si:C 比就確認多型」，先回到前一步模型，檢查假設、量測條件及本步的診斷因素。
steps.failureEn: If using the claim "Identifying polytype from Si:C ratio alone", return to the model and check assumptions, measurement conditions and the diagnostic factor.
steps.check: 提交「多型與基板」的圖表或計算、單位與至少一項假設；成果須能追溯到本步指定的輸入和輸出，並說明：化學成分相同不代表晶體堆疊相同。

steps.title: 厚度均勻度：建立模型
steps.objective: 用可檢查的成果說明「一個中心點無法代表全片漂移層」。
steps.objectiveEn: Demonstrate the following with inspectable work: One center point cannot represent the whole drift layer.
steps.instruction:
建立徑向厚度圖並分開片內與片間偏差。先標出輸入、輸出與適用假設；依圖形、計算或比較表完成推理；把估算、來源事實與待量測項分開。所有自行設定數值均標為教學假設。

具體算例（全部數值為教學假設）：假設三個外延厚度測點為 99、100、101 µm，平均 100 µm、極差 2 µm。若僅描述這三點、使用母體定義，標準差 sqrt(2/3)=0.8165 µm，變異係數 0.8165%；若作樣本估計則標準差為 1 µm。必須寫明分母，且三點不能推論整片缺陷密度。
steps.instructionEn:
Map radial thickness and separate within-wafer from wafer-to-wafer variation. Mark inputs, outputs and assumptions; complete the diagram, calculation or comparison; separate estimates, source facts and measurements still needed. Label all chosen values as hypothetical.

Worked example (all values are hypothetical teaching inputs): Assume three epitaxial thickness readings of 99, 100 and 101 µm. Mean is 100 µm and range 2 µm. Describing just these points with the population definition gives standard deviation sqrt(2/3)=0.8165 µm and CV=0.8165%; the sample estimate instead gives 1 µm. State the denominator; three sites cannot establish wafer-wide defect density.
steps.observation: 一個中心點無法代表全片漂移層；厚度與摻雜分布可能相互相關。
steps.observationEn: One center point cannot represent the whole drift layer; Thickness and doping variations may correlate.
steps.failure: 若採用「中心厚度合格就代表全片耐壓一致」，先回到前一步模型，檢查假設、量測條件及本步的診斷因素。
steps.failureEn: If using the claim "Inferring uniform blocking capability from center thickness", return to the model and check assumptions, measurement conditions and the diagnostic factor.
steps.check:
提交「厚度均勻度」的圖表或計算、單位與至少一項假設；成果須能追溯到本步指定的輸入和輸出，並說明：一個中心點無法代表全片漂移層。
算例驗收：驗算平均、極差及兩種標準差，並在圖上註明取樣位置不足的限制。
steps.checkEn:
Submit the Thickness uniformity diagram/table or calculation with units and at least one assumption, tracing inputs to outputs and explaining: One center point cannot represent the whole drift layer.
Worked-example acceptance: Verify mean, range and both standard-deviation definitions and mark the sampling limitation on the map.

title: 碳化矽 MOSFET 製程
summary: 從垂直元件路徑、植入與活化到晶片到模組：以 12 項工程決策、24 個模型與診斷工作包建立證據。
summaryEn: From Vertical device path and Implantation and activation to Die-to-module validation: build evidence through twelve engineering decisions and twenty-four modeling/diagnostic work packages.
scope: 公開原理的教學拆解：12 個技術主題各有模型／分析及故障／驗證兩步，共四階段 24 步。不是 24 道實際製造配方，也不是任何廠商量產流程。數值由學員自訂並標示為假設；涉及材料加工、高壓、雷射或化學品的活動僅做圖上與資料分析，不由網頁授權實機操作。
scopeEn: A public-principles educational decomposition: twelve technical topics each have a model/analysis step and a diagnosis/verification step, organized as four stages and twenty-four work packages. These are not twenty-four fabrication recipes or a manufacturer flow. Learner-selected numbers are hypothetical; materials processing, high voltage, lasers and chemicals are studied through diagrams/data, not authorized physical operation.

steps.title: 動態損耗：建立模型
steps.objective: 用可檢查的成果說明「低 RDS(on) 不保證最低總損耗」。
steps.objectiveEn: Demonstrate the following with inspectable work: Low on-resistance does not guarantee minimum total loss.
steps.instruction:
以假設 V(t)I(t) 積分比較切換損耗與導通損耗。先標出輸入、輸出與適用假設；依圖形、計算或比較表完成推理；把估算、來源事實與待量測項分開。所有自行設定數值均標為教學假設。

具體算例（全部數值為教學假設）：假設功率開關在特定溫度的 RDS(on)=10 mΩ，導通電流 10 A、占空比先設為 100%，導通損耗 I²R=1 W。若熱態電阻加倍，損耗為 2 W。這不含切換、閘極驅動或反向恢復損耗；若占空比為 50% 且電流維持矩形 10 A，平均導通損耗才各減半。另假設每周期切換能量 Eon+Eoff=10 µJ、頻率 100 kHz，切換功率為 1 W，冷態 50% 導通加切換合計 1.5 W，仍未含驅動損耗。
steps.instructionEn:
Integrate hypothetical V(t)I(t) and compare switching/conduction losses. Mark inputs, outputs and assumptions; complete the diagram, calculation or comparison; separate estimates, source facts and measurements still needed. Label all chosen values as hypothetical.

Worked example (all values are hypothetical teaching inputs): Assume a power switch has RDS(on)=10 mΩ at a specified temperature and conducts 10 A continuously: I²R=1 W. Doubling hot-state resistance gives 2 W. Switching, gate-drive and reverse-recovery losses are excluded. At 50% duty with rectangular 10 A current, average conduction loss halves in each case. Also assume switching energy Eon+Eoff=10 µJ per cycle at 100 kHz: switching power is 1 W, so the cold 50%-duty conduction-plus-switching total is 1.5 W, still excluding drive losses.
steps.observation: 低 RDS(on) 不保證最低總損耗；電壓電流探棒時間偏移會誤算能量。
steps.observationEn: Low on-resistance does not guarantee minimum total loss; Probe timing mismatch biases switching energy.
steps.failure: 若採用「只按室溫導通電阻選最高頻方案」，先回到前一步模型，檢查假設、量測條件及本步的診斷因素。

算例驗收：驗算連續導通 1 W、熱態 2 W、50% 占空比下 0.5/1 W 及冷態含切換的 1.5 W，勿用平均電流直接平方取代 RMS。
steps.checkEn:
Submit the Dynamic losses diagram/table or calculation with units and at least one assumption, tracing inputs to outputs and explaining: Low on-resistance does not guarantee minimum total loss.
Worked-example acceptance: Verify 1 W continuous, 2 W hot, 0.5/1 W at 50% duty and the cold 1.5 W total including switching; do not square average current instead of using RMS current.

title: 氮化鎵高電子遷移率電晶體
summary: 從異質接面、緩衝層到整合驗證：以 12 項工程決策、24 個模型與診斷工作包建立證據。
summaryEn: From Heterojunction and Buffer layer to Integration verification: build evidence through twelve engineering decisions and twenty-four modeling/diagnostic work packages.
scope: 公開原理的教學拆解：12 個技術主題各有模型／分析及故障／驗證兩步，共四階段 24 步。不是 24 道實際製造配方，也不是任何廠商量產流程。數值由學員自訂並標示為假設；涉及材料加工、高壓、雷射或化學品的活動僅做圖上與資料分析，不由網頁授權實機操作。
scopeEn: A public-principles educational decomposition: twelve technical topics each have a model/analysis step and a diagnosis/verification step, organized as four stages and twenty-four work packages. These are not twenty-four fabrication recipes or a manufacturer flow. Learner-selected numbers are hypothetical; materials processing, high voltage, lasers and chemicals are studied through diagrams/data, not authorized physical operation.

具體算例（全部數值為教學假設）：假設線性 TLM 回歸 Rtotal(L) 的零距離截距為 0.4 Ω，兩端接觸相同且寄生已扣除，截距=2Rc，所以每個接觸 Rc=0.2 Ω。未給接觸寬度，不能報成 Ω·mm；若 I-V 非線性或兩接觸不同，此抽取就需修改。
steps.instructionEn:
Separate contact and channel resistance with hypothetical TLM data. Mark inputs, outputs and assumptions; complete the diagram, calculation or comparison; separate estimates, source facts and measurements still needed. Label all chosen values as hypothetical.

Worked example (all values are hypothetical teaching inputs): Assume a linear TLM fit Rtotal(L) has a zero-spacing intercept of 0.4 Ω, with identical contacts and parasitics removed. The intercept is 2Rc, giving Rc=0.2 Ω per contact. Without width, do not report Ω·mm; nonlinear I-V or unequal contacts invalidates the simple extraction.

steps.title: 歐姆接觸：故障判讀與驗證

steps.objectiveEn: Test the faulty claim: Eliminating all series loss by increasing mobility alone.

steps.instructionEn: Continue the preceding Ohmic contacts artifact. Identify the missing condition in the faulty claim "Eliminating all series loss by increasing mobility alone". Introduce this diagnostic principle: Contact normalization needs width conventions. Design normal/fault controls; specify a distinguishing observable, sampling location or time; state what remains undecided without evidence. Do not fabricate measurements.
steps.observation: 接觸電阻影響導通和 RF 性能；接觸正規化需註明單位寬度。
steps.observationEn: Contact resistance affects conduction and RF performance; Contact normalization needs width conventions.

steps.instructionEn: Continue the preceding Reverse conduction artifact. Identify the missing condition in the faulty claim "Copying a silicon diode recovery model unchanged". Introduce this diagnostic principle: Reverse drop depends on gate bias. Design normal/fault controls; specify a distinguishing observable, sampling location or time; state what remains undecided without evidence. Do not fabricate measurements.

title: 氮化鎵發光二極體磊晶
summary: 從直接能隙、組成與波長到磊晶驗收：以 12 項工程決策、24 個模型與診斷工作包建立證據。
summaryEn: From Direct bandgap and Composition and wavelength to Epitaxy acceptance: build evidence through twelve engineering decisions and twenty-four modeling/diagnostic work packages.
scope: 公開原理的教學拆解：12 個技術主題各有模型／分析及故障／驗證兩步，共四階段 24 步。不是 24 道實際製造配方，也不是任何廠商量產流程。數值由學員自訂並標示為假設；涉及材料加工、高壓、雷射或化學品的活動僅做圖上與資料分析，不由網頁授權實機操作。
scopeEn: A public-principles educational decomposition: twelve technical topics each have a model/analysis step and a diagnosis/verification step, organized as four stages and twenty-four work packages. These are not twenty-four fabrication recipes or a manufacturer flow. Learner-selected numbers are hypothetical; materials processing, high voltage, lasers and chemicals are studied through diagrams/data, not authorized physical operation.

steps.title: 直接能隙：建立模型

steps.instructionEn: Compare radiative/nonradiative recombination and energy destinations. Mark inputs, outputs and assumptions; complete the diagram, calculation or comparison; separate estimates, source facts and measurements still needed. Label all chosen values as hypothetical.

steps.observationEn: Not all current becomes emitted light; Nonradiative recombination produces heat.
steps.failure: 若採用「以注入電流直接等同光子流」，先回到前一步模型，檢查假設、量測條件及本步的診斷因素。

title: 砷化鎵射頻元件製作
summary: 從HBT 與 pHEMT、閘長與寄生到技術選擇：以 12 項工程決策、24 個模型與診斷工作包建立證據。
summaryEn: From HBT versus pHEMT and Gate length and parasitics to Technology selection: build evidence through twelve engineering decisions and twenty-four modeling/diagnostic work packages.
scope: 公開原理的教學拆解：12 個技術主題各有模型／分析及故障／驗證兩步，共四階段 24 步。不是 24 道實際製造配方，也不是任何廠商量產流程。數值由學員自訂並標示為假設；涉及材料加工、高壓、雷射或化學品的活動僅做圖上與資料分析，不由網頁授權實機操作。
scopeEn: A public-principles educational decomposition: twelve technical topics each have a model/analysis step and a diagnosis/verification step, organized as four stages and twenty-four work packages. These are not twenty-four fabrication recipes or a manufacturer flow. Learner-selected numbers are hypothetical; materials processing, high voltage, lasers and chemicals are studied through diagrams/data, not authorized physical operation.

steps.titleEn: Channel sheet charge: construct and analyze
steps.objective: 用可檢查的成果說明「片密度與體密度單位不同」。

steps.instruction:

具體算例（全部數值為教學假設）：假設單一載子通道的面密度 ns=10¹² cm⁻²、遷移率 μ=5,000 cm²/(V·s)，q=1.602×10⁻¹⁹ C。片電阻 Rs=1/(qnsμ)≈1,248.4 Ω/□。此式忽略平行通道及接觸電阻；不能直接當成整顆射頻元件導通電阻。
steps.instructionEn:
Separate sheet density, mobility and resistance with unit checks. Mark inputs, outputs and assumptions; complete the diagram, calculation or comparison; separate estimates, source facts and measurements still needed. Label all chosen values as hypothetical.

Worked example (all values are hypothetical teaching inputs): Assume a single-carrier channel with sheet density ns=10¹² cm⁻² and mobility μ=5,000 cm²/(V·s), using q=1.602×10⁻¹⁹ C. Sheet resistance Rs=1/(qnsμ)≈1,248.4 Ω/square. Parallel channels and contact resistance are excluded; this is not whole-device RF on-resistance.
steps.observation: 片密度與體密度單位不同；Hall 量測也需要幾何校正。
steps.observationEn: Sheet and volume density have different units; Hall measurements need geometry corrections.

steps.failureEn: If using the claim "Treating cm^-2 as cm^-3", return to the model and check assumptions, measurement conditions and the diagnostic factor.
steps.check:
提交「通道片電荷」的圖表或計算、單位與至少一項假設；成果須能追溯到本步指定的輸入和輸出，並說明：片密度與體密度單位不同。
算例驗收：驗算約 1.25 kΩ/□，保留面密度單位，勿把 cm⁻² 當成 cm⁻³。
steps.checkEn:
Submit the Channel sheet charge diagram/table or calculation with units and at least one assumption, tracing inputs to outputs and explaining: Sheet and volume density have different units.
Worked-example acceptance: Verify approximately 1.25 kΩ/square and keep sheet-density units distinct from volume density.

steps.objective: 以新增對照檢查「只用閘長倒數預測模組頻寬」這項錯誤主張。
steps.objectiveEn: Test the faulty claim: Predicting module bandwidth solely from inverse gate length.
steps.instruction: 接續前一步「閘長與寄生」成果，先指出錯誤主張「只用閘長倒數預測模組頻寬」漏掉哪個條件。新增診斷原理：外在 gm 小於理想內在 gm。據此設計一組正常與異常對照；指定可區分兩者的觀察量、取樣位置或時間；寫下證據不足時應保留的未決結論。不得虛構實測數字。
steps.instructionEn: Continue the preceding Gate length and parasitics artifact. Identify the missing condition in the faulty claim "Predicting module bandwidth solely from inverse gate length". Introduce this diagnostic principle: Extrinsic transconductance differs from intrinsic values. Design normal/fault controls; specify a distinguishing observable, sampling location or time; state what remains undecided without evidence. Do not fabricate measurements.
steps.observation: 短閘不自動消除封裝與接觸寄生；外在 gm 小於理想內在 gm。
steps.observationEn: Short gates do not eliminate package/contact parasitics; Extrinsic transconductance differs from intrinsic values.
steps.failure: 若採用「只用閘長倒數預測模組頻寬」，先回到前一步模型，檢查假設、量測條件及本步的診斷因素。
steps.failureEn: If using the claim "Predicting module bandwidth solely from inverse gate length", return to the model and check assumptions, measurement conditions and the diagnostic factor.
steps.check: 交出「閘長與寄生」的正常／異常比較、可觀察量與一項仍未確定事項；必須解釋「外在 gm 小於理想內在 gm」如何改變前一步的判讀。
steps.checkEn: Submit a normal/fault comparison for Gate length and parasitics, its observable and one remaining uncertainty. Explain how "Extrinsic transconductance differs from intrinsic values" changes interpretation of the preceding artifact.

steps.instructionEn: Compare contact/line contributions with hypothetical TLM and Kelvin structures. Mark inputs, outputs and assumptions; complete the diagram, calculation or comparison; separate estimates, source facts and measurements still needed. Label all chosen values as hypothetical.
steps.observation: 量測連接方式會影響所見電阻；電流擁擠會影響接觸抽取。

steps.failure: 若採用「用二線電阻代表去嵌入後接觸」，先回到前一步模型，檢查假設、量測條件及本步的診斷因素。
steps.failureEn: If using the claim "Calling two-wire resistance a de-embedded contact result", return to the model and check assumptions, measurement conditions and the diagnostic factor.
steps.check: 提交「接觸測試」的圖表或計算、單位與至少一項假設；成果須能追溯到本步指定的輸入和輸出，並說明：量測連接方式會影響所見電阻。

任意空白焊墊都能精確去除全部寄生

Assuming any empty pad removes every parasitic exactly

steps.title: 去嵌入：建立模型
steps.objective: 用可檢查的成果說明「不匹配的 dummy 可引入新誤差」。
steps.objectiveEn: Demonstrate the following with inspectable work: Mismatched dummy structures can introduce errors.
steps.instruction: 畫 open/short dummy 結構並列明它們移除的寄生。先標出輸入、輸出與適用假設；依圖形、計算或比較表完成推理；把估算、來源事實與待量測項分開。所有自行設定數值均標為教學假設。
steps.instructionEn: Draw open/short dummies and list removed parasitics. Mark inputs, outputs and assumptions; complete the diagram, calculation or comparison; separate estimates, source facts and measurements still needed. Label all chosen values as hypothetical.
steps.observation: 不匹配的 dummy 可引入新誤差；去嵌入後非物理解提示模型問題。
steps.observationEn: Mismatched dummy structures can introduce errors; Nonphysical de-embedded results flag model issues.
steps.failure: 若採用「任意空白焊墊都能精確去除全部寄生」，先回到前一步模型，檢查假設、量測條件及本步的診斷因素。
steps.failureEn: If using the claim "Assuming any empty pad removes every parasitic exactly", return to the model and check assumptions, measurement conditions and the diagnostic factor.
steps.check: 提交「去嵌入」的圖表或計算、單位與至少一項假設；成果須能追溯到本步指定的輸入和輸出，並說明：不匹配的 dummy 可引入新誤差。
steps.checkEn: Submit the De-embedding diagram/table or calculation with units and at least one assumption, tracing inputs to outputs and explaining: Mismatched dummy structures can introduce errors.

knowledge.title: 去嵌入／物理與模型

knowledge.textEn: Model boundary: the current result does not establish the following claim: Assuming any empty pad removes every parasitic exactly.

steps.title: 去嵌入：故障判讀與驗證
steps.objective: 以新增對照檢查「任意空白焊墊都能精確去除全部寄生」這項錯誤主張。
steps.objectiveEn: Test the faulty claim: Assuming any empty pad removes every parasitic exactly.
steps.instruction: 接續前一步「去嵌入」成果，先指出錯誤主張「任意空白焊墊都能精確去除全部寄生」漏掉哪個條件。新增診斷原理：去嵌入後非物理解提示模型問題。據此設計一組正常與異常對照；指定可區分兩者的觀察量、取樣位置或時間；寫下證據不足時應保留的未決結論。不得虛構實測數字。
steps.instructionEn: Continue the preceding De-embedding artifact. Identify the missing condition in the faulty claim "Assuming any empty pad removes every parasitic exactly". Introduce this diagnostic principle: Nonphysical de-embedded results flag model issues. Design normal/fault controls; specify a distinguishing observable, sampling location or time; state what remains undecided without evidence. Do not fabricate measurements.
steps.observation: 不匹配的 dummy 可引入新誤差；去嵌入後非物理解提示模型問題。

steps.check: 交出「去嵌入」的正常／異常比較、可觀察量與一項仍未確定事項；必須解釋「去嵌入後非物理解提示模型問題」如何改變前一步的判讀。
steps.checkEn: Submit a normal/fault comparison for De-embedding, its observable and one remaining uncertainty. Explain how "Nonphysical de-embedded results flag model issues" changes interpretation of the preceding artifact.

knowledge.title: 去嵌入／物理與模型
knowledge.text: 診斷機制：去嵌入後非物理解提示模型問題。
knowledge.textEn: Diagnostic mechanism: Nonphysical de-embedded results flag model issues.

knowledge.title: 去嵌入／驗證與限制
knowledge.text: 可證偽性：「任意空白焊墊都能精確去除全部寄生」與「不匹配的 dummy 可引入新誤差」不可混為同一推論；對照需能觀察兩者的差別。

title: 氧化鎵功率元件研究
summary: 從材料潛力與實現、橫向與垂直到研究成熟度：以 12 項工程決策、24 個模型與診斷工作包建立證據。
summaryEn: From Material potential versus realization and Lateral versus vertical to Research maturity: build evidence through twelve engineering decisions and twenty-four modeling/diagnostic work packages.
scope: 公開原理的教學拆解：12 個技術主題各有模型／分析及故障／驗證兩步，共四階段 24 步。不是 24 道實際製造配方，也不是任何廠商量產流程。數值由學員自訂並標示為假設；涉及材料加工、高壓、雷射或化學品的活動僅做圖上與資料分析，不由網頁授權實機操作。
scopeEn: A public-principles educational decomposition: twelve technical topics each have a model/analysis step and a diagnosis/verification step, organized as four stages and twenty-four work packages. These are not twenty-four fabrication recipes or a manufacturer flow. Learner-selected numbers are hypothetical; materials processing, high voltage, lasers and chemicals are studied through diagrams/data, not authorized physical operation.

stages.descriptionEn: Develop model and diagnostic deliverables for Material potential versus realization, Phase and orientation, Bulk and epitaxy.

steps.failureEn: If using the claim "Ranking product efficiency by ideal materials alone", return to the model and check assumptions, measurement conditions and the diagnostic factor.

steps.instruction: 畫施體、深受體及自由載子，區分補償和電洞導電。先標出輸入、輸出與適用假設；依圖形、計算或比較表完成推理；把估算、來源事實與待量測項分開。所有自行設定數值均標為教學假設。
steps.instructionEn: Draw donors, deep acceptors and carriers and distinguish compensation from hole conduction. Mark inputs, outputs and assumptions; complete the diagram, calculation or comparison; separate estimates, source facts and measurements still needed. Label all chosen values as hypothetical.

steps.failureEn: If using the claim "Assuming acceptor implantation guarantees mobile holes", return to the model and check assumptions, measurement conditions and the diagnostic factor.
steps.check: 提交「摻雜與補償」的圖表或計算、單位與至少一項假設；成果須能追溯到本步指定的輸入和輸出，並說明：補償區不自動等於成熟 p 型導電層。

steps.instruction:

具體算例（全部數值為教學假設）：假設穩態集中熱模型中耗散 P=2 W、接面至環境熱阻 Rθ=20 K/W、環境 25°C，ΔT=PRθ=40 K，接面估計 65°C。若同一路徑熱阻 30 K/W，則為 85°C。這不是氧化鎵產品額定值；暫態熱容、非均勻熱點與溫度相依性未納入。
steps.instructionEn:
Build a hypothetical thermal network separating electrical loss and conduction. Mark inputs, outputs and assumptions; complete the diagram, calculation or comparison; separate estimates, source facts and measurements still needed. Label all chosen values as hypothetical.

Worked example (all values are hypothetical teaching inputs): Assume a steady lumped thermal model with P=2 W, junction-to-ambient Rθ=20 K/W and ambient 25°C. ΔT=PRθ=40 K gives 65°C junction temperature. At 30 K/W the estimate is 85°C. These are not gallium-oxide product ratings; thermal capacitance, nonuniform hotspots and temperature dependence are excluded.
steps.observation: 低電性損失不保證低接面溫度；熱導率要連同晶向和溫度記錄。
steps.observationEn: Low electrical loss does not guarantee low junction temperature; Thermal conductivity needs orientation and temperature.

算例驗收：驗算 65°C 與 85°C，說明 K 的溫升可以加到 °C，但熱阻的路徑必須相同。
steps.checkEn:
Submit the Self-heating constraint diagram/table or calculation with units and at least one assumption, tracing inputs to outputs and explaining: Low electrical loss does not guarantee low junction temperature.
Worked-example acceptance: Verify 65°C and 85°C; explain that a kelvin rise adds to Celsius temperature but the thermal-resistance path must match.

title: 二維半導體轉移與接觸
summary: 從單層與晶粒、轉移殘留到晶圓可製造性：以 12 項工程決策、24 個模型與診斷工作包建立證據。
summaryEn: From Monolayer and grains and Transfer residue to Wafer manufacturability: build evidence through twelve engineering decisions and twenty-four modeling/diagnostic work packages.
scope: 公開原理的教學拆解：12 個技術主題各有模型／分析及故障／驗證兩步，共四階段 24 步。不是 24 道實際製造配方，也不是任何廠商量產流程。數值由學員自訂並標示為假設；涉及材料加工、高壓、雷射或化學品的活動僅做圖上與資料分析，不由網頁授權實機操作。
scopeEn: A public-principles educational decomposition: twelve technical topics each have a model/analysis step and a diagnosis/verification step, organized as four stages and twenty-four work packages. These are not twenty-four fabrication recipes or a manufacturer flow. Learner-selected numbers are hypothetical; materials processing, high voltage, lasers and chemicals are studied through diagrams/data, not authorized physical operation.

steps.failure: 若採用「只看顯微照片就核准原子級界面」，先回到前一步模型，檢查假設、量測條件及本步的診斷因素。
steps.failureEn: If using the claim "Accepting atomic interfaces from optical images alone", return to the model and check assumptions, measurement conditions and the diagnostic factor.
steps.check: 提交「轉移殘留」的圖表或計算、單位與至少一項假設；成果須能追溯到本步指定的輸入和輸出，並說明：光學看似潔淨不保證無有機殘留。

steps.title: 接觸抽取：建立模型
steps.objective: 用可檢查的成果說明「長度系列需要可比通道與閘偏壓」。
steps.objectiveEn: Demonstrate the following with inspectable work: Length-series extraction needs comparable channels and gate bias.
steps.instruction:
用假設不同通道長度 TLM 比較接觸截距與片電阻。先標出輸入、輸出與適用假設；依圖形、計算或比較表完成推理；把估算、來源事實與待量測項分開。所有自行設定數值均標為教學假設。

具體算例（全部數值為教學假設）：假設二維材料元件的 TLM 資料符合線性 Rtotal(L)，截距 2 kΩ，且兩接觸相同，則每個接觸為 1 kΩ。若某長度的量測總阻為 5 kΩ，模型歸於通道的部分為 3 kΩ。此分解依賴接觸與通道一致性，不適用於任意非線性注入曲線。
steps.instructionEn:
Use hypothetical channel-length TLM to separate intercept and sheet resistance. Mark inputs, outputs and assumptions; complete the diagram, calculation or comparison; separate estimates, source facts and measurements still needed. Label all chosen values as hypothetical.

Worked example (all values are hypothetical teaching inputs): Assume a 2D-device TLM dataset follows linear Rtotal(L) with intercept 2 kΩ and identical contacts: each contact is 1 kΩ. If total resistance at one spacing is 5 kΩ, the model assigns 3 kΩ to the channel. This decomposition assumes contact/channel consistency and does not apply to arbitrary nonlinear injection curves.
steps.observation: 長度系列需要可比通道與閘偏壓；尺寸縮放使接觸占比上升。
steps.observationEn: Length-series extraction needs comparable channels and gate bias; Scaling increases the contact contribution.
steps.failure: 若採用「混合不同載子密度樣本直接回歸」，先回到前一步模型，檢查假設、量測條件及本步的診斷因素。
steps.failureEn: If using the claim "Regressing samples with mixed carrier densities", return to the model and check assumptions, measurement conditions and the diagnostic factor.
steps.check:
提交「接觸抽取」的圖表或計算、單位與至少一項假設；成果須能追溯到本步指定的輸入和輸出，並說明：長度系列需要可比通道與閘偏壓。
算例驗收：驗算每接觸 1 kΩ 與通道 3 kΩ；若負截距出現，先檢查模型而非宣稱負接觸電阻。
steps.checkEn:
Submit the Contact extraction diagram/table or calculation with units and at least one assumption, tracing inputs to outputs and explaining: Length-series extraction needs comparable channels and gate bias.
Worked-example acceptance: Verify 1 kΩ per contact and 3 kΩ channel resistance; investigate a negative intercept instead of claiming negative contact resistance.

title: 微機電慣性感測器製程
summary: 從質量彈簧、深矽輪廓到溫漂校正：以 12 項工程決策、24 個模型與診斷工作包建立證據。
summaryEn: From Mass and spring and Deep-silicon profile to Temperature calibration: build evidence through twelve engineering decisions and twenty-four modeling/diagnostic work packages.
scope: 公開原理的教學拆解：12 個技術主題各有模型／分析及故障／驗證兩步，共四階段 24 步。不是 24 道實際製造配方，也不是任何廠商量產流程。數值由學員自訂並標示為假設；涉及材料加工、高壓、雷射或化學品的活動僅做圖上與資料分析，不由網頁授權實機操作。
scopeEn: A public-principles educational decomposition: twelve technical topics each have a model/analysis step and a diagnosis/verification step, organized as four stages and twenty-four work packages. These are not twenty-four fabrication recipes or a manufacturer flow. Learner-selected numbers are hypothetical; materials processing, high voltage, lasers and chemicals are studied through diagrams/data, not authorized physical operation.

stages.title: 質量彈簧 → 共振與阻尼
stages.titleEn: Mass and spring to Resonance and damping
stages.description: 把「質量彈簧」「差動梳齒」「共振與阻尼」各拆成模型與診斷兩項工作，保留可檢查成果。
stages.descriptionEn: Develop model and diagnostic deliverables for Mass and spring, Differential combs, Resonance and damping.

steps.title: 質量彈簧：建立模型
steps.titleEn: Mass and spring: construct and analyze
steps.objective: 用可檢查的成果說明「靜態近似需要低於機械共振的條件」。
steps.objectiveEn: Demonstrate the following with inspectable work: Static approximation needs operation below resonance.
steps.instruction:
用假設 m、k 畫 F=ma 與 x=ma/k 靜態關係。先標出輸入、輸出與適用假設；依圖形、計算或比較表完成推理；把估算、來源事實與待量測項分開。所有自行設定數值均標為教學假設。

具體算例（全部數值為教學假設）：假設準靜態加速度計質量 m=1 µg=10⁻⁹ kg、彈簧 k=1 N/m、加速度 a=9.81 m/s²，力 F=ma=9.81 nN，位移 x=F/k=9.81 nm。加速度加倍時位移加倍，但此例忽略阻尼、共振與非線性止擋，不能外推到衝擊量程。
steps.instructionEn:
Use hypothetical mass/stiffness to draw F=ma and x=ma/k. Mark inputs, outputs and assumptions; complete the diagram, calculation or comparison; separate estimates, source facts and measurements still needed. Label all chosen values as hypothetical.

Worked example (all values are hypothetical teaching inputs): Assume a quasistatic accelerometer mass m=1 µg=10⁻⁹ kg, spring constant k=1 N/m and acceleration a=9.81 m/s². F=ma=9.81 nN and x=F/k=9.81 nm. Doubling acceleration doubles displacement in this model. Damping, resonance and nonlinear stops are absent, so do not infer shock range.
steps.observation: 靜態近似需要低於機械共振的條件；動態方程還包含阻尼與慣性項。
steps.observationEn: Static approximation needs operation below resonance; Dynamics also include damping and inertia.
steps.failure: 若採用「把靜態位移式套到所有振動頻率」，先回到前一步模型，檢查假設、量測條件及本步的診斷因素。
steps.failureEn: If using the claim "Applying static displacement at every frequency", return to the model and check assumptions, measurement conditions and the diagnostic factor.
steps.check:
提交「質量彈簧」的圖表或計算、單位與至少一項假設；成果須能追溯到本步指定的輸入和輸出，並說明：靜態近似需要低於機械共振的條件。
算例驗收：驗算 9.81 nN 與 9.81 nm，確認 µg 到 kg 的轉換是 10⁻⁹。
steps.checkEn:
Submit the Mass and spring diagram/table or calculation with units and at least one assumption, tracing inputs to outputs and explaining: Static approximation needs operation below resonance.
Worked-example acceptance: Verify 9.81 nN and 9.81 nm and confirm the 10⁻⁹ conversion from micrograms to kilograms.
